### [145] [Bridge Damage Detection from Low-Light UAV Imagery via Degradation-Aware Mixture-of-Experts Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23136)
*Hu Wang,Hongxu Pu,Zhiqi Hu,Fangzhou Lin,Wang Wang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DaL-MoE，一个检测器无关的图像恢复前端模块，用于提升UAV桥梁图像在低光照条件下的缺陷检测性能。通过ISP感知的低光合成管道和退化感知的专家混合模块（噪声抑制、色彩调整、结构细节恢复），在合成数据上达到23.12 dB PSNR和0.8482 SSIM，并将YOLOv11m的box mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923，mask mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529，且展现出从合成退化到真实场景的迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低照度环境下UAV桥梁图像中的小尺寸、低对比度缺陷难以被检测，严重降低了自动化检测的可靠性和运行灵活性。现有方法缺乏针对低光条件下的图像退化感知恢复机制，且难以将合成退化效果迁移到真实检测场景。

Method: 提出DaL-MoE框架：1) 检测器无关的恢复前端；2) ISP感知的低光合成管道生成训练数据；3) 退化感知引导估计模块；4) 互补专家模块，分别负责噪声抑制、色彩调整和结构细节恢复。

Result: 在配对合成数据上，DaL-MoE达到23.12 dB PSNR和0.8482 SSIM；YOLOv11m的box mAP50从0.3097提升至0.4923（提升58.9%），mask mAP50从0.2281提升至0.3529（提升54.7%）。在真实低光UAV图像上，通过sim-to-real评估验证了缺陷可见性和检测完整性的提升。

Conclusion: 退化感知的图像恢复能够有效提升低光条件下UAV桥梁缺陷检测性能，且具备从合成退化到真实场景的迁移能力。未来工作将开发低光感知的桥梁损伤检测器，以增强跨场景（不同桥址、成像条件、光照水平）的泛化能力。

Abstract: Poor illumination obscures small, low-contrast defects in UAV bridge imagery, reducing the reliability and operational flexibility of automated inspection. This paper investigates whether degradation-aware image restoration can improve bridge damage detection under low-light conditions and transfer from synthetic degradations to real inspection scenes. We propose DaL- MoE, a detector-agnostic restoration front end trained with an ISP-aware low-light synthesis pipeline and equipped with degradation-aware guidance estimation and complementary experts for noise suppression, color adjustment, and structural-detail recovery. On paired synthetic data, DaL-MoE achieves 23.12 dB PSNR and 0.8482 SSIM, increasing YOLOv11m box mAP50 from 0.3097 to 0.4923 and mask mAP50 from 0.2281 to 0.3529. On real low-light UAV imagery without paired normal-light references, sim-to-real evaluation shows improved defect visibility and more complete detections than direct inference on raw low-light inputs. Future work will develop low-light-aware bridge damage detectors with stronger cross-scene generalization across bridge sites, imaging conditions, and illumination levels.

</details>


### [146] [A Simulator-Grounded Framework For Constructing Verifiable Muscle-Grounded QA From 3D Tongue Meshes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23137)
*Seungho Eum,Unsang Park*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于模拟器的数据构建框架3DTongueQA，它通过ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型将11维肌肉激活映射为固定拓扑的舌头网格，生成结构化生物力学记录和确定性的QA数据。共筛选295,115个有效网格，构建了891,156条QA记录（每种语言），支持英语和韩语等多种语言的自然化。基线模型SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B达到62.9 Muscle EM、74.0 Value Accuracy和65.9 Direction EM，而任务特定的结构化读取器达到88.7 Muscle EM和93.3 Direction EM，展示了该框架对不同解码器的适应性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的发音语料库（基于实时MRI和电磁发音描记术）虽然能捕捉舌头的形状和运动，但缺乏对驱动观察配置的肌肉过程的可追溯标签。作者希望构建一个能提供肌肉状态、几何形状和目标导向变化等可解释标签的数据集，以弥补现有语料库在肌肉驱动过程标注上的缺失。

Method: 作者提出模拟器接地（simulator-grounded）的数据构建框架：(1) 使用ArtiSynth Badin有限元模型将受控的11维肌肉激活映射到固定拓扑的舌头网格；(2) 将网格转换为结构化生物力学记录；(3) 渲染为确定性的QA数据，涵盖肌肉状态、几何形状和目标导向变化；(4) 语言自然化只改变表层形式，并通过源记录进行验证，支持英语和韩语；(5) 使用可替换的SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B基线模型和任务特定结构化读取器进行评估。

Result: 框架筛选了295,157个配置并保留295,115个有效网格，构建了每种语言891,156条QA记录。可替换基线达到62.9±9.2 Muscle EM、74.0±0.2 Value Accuracy和65.9±4.7 Direction EM；网格不匹配时Muscle EM降至2.2，验证了数据质量；锚点保留模型保留了完整库存分数的80.4-98.6%；任务特定结构化读取器达到88.7±0.7 Muscle EM和93.3±1.0 Direction EM。

Conclusion: 互补的结果表明，构建的监督信号既能支持高效的结构化预测，也能支持异构的自然语言QA，而非仅绑定于特定的解码器架构。该框架展示了构建级的可移植性（英语和韩语），为发音研究提供了可追溯的肌肉驱动标签数据。

Abstract: Existing articulatory corpora based on real-time MRI and electromagnetic articulography capture tongue shape and motion but do not provide traceable labels for the muscle-driven process that generated an observed configuration. We introduce a simulator-grounded data-construction framework and instantiate it as 3DTongueQA. Controlled 11-dimensional muscle activations are mapped to fixed-topology tongue meshes with the ArtiSynth Badin finite-element model, converted into structured biomechanical records, and rendered as deterministic QA on muscle state, geometry, and target-directed change. We screen 295,157 configurations, retain 295,115 valid meshes, and construct 891,156 QA records per language. Language naturalization changes only surface form and is verified against the source records; English and Korean instantiations demonstrate construction-level portability. A swappable SpiralNet++--Qwen3-8B baseline reaches 62.9 $\pm$ 9.2 Muscle EM, 74.0 $\pm$ 0.2 Value Accuracy, and 65.9 $\pm$ 4.7 Direction EM, while mismatching the paired mesh reduces Muscle EM to 2.2; a dataset-leakage-controlled anchor-held-out model retains 80.4--98.6\% of the full-inventory scores on unseen anchors. Task-specific structured readouts further reach 88.7 $\pm$ 0.7 Muscle EM and 93.3 $\pm$ 1.0 Direction EM. These complementary results show that the constructed supervision supports both efficient structured prediction and heterogeneous natural-language QA rather than being tied to a particular decoder architecture.

</details>


### [147] [MIVIFI: Bridging Perspective and Fisheye Domains for Training Multi-View Fisheye Image Generation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23140)
*Matthias Neuwirth-Trapp,Begüm Altunbas,Jiayi Wang,Yan Xia,Maarten Bieshaar,Xinyu Huang,Daniel Cremers*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文首次提出多视角鱼眼图像生成问题，并介绍两种方法：SyntheOcc-FE（直接适配现有架构）和MIVIFI（利用跨域学习结合等距柱状投影，通过KITTI-360与nuScenes数据桥接域差距），实现基于体素语义表示的高保真鱼眼图像生成，并支持场景内容操控及天气/光照条件渲染。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动驾驶需要360°全覆盖视觉感知，鱼眼相机是低成本方案，但多视角鱼眼数据集稀缺且合成罕见边缘场景需要昂贵的3D模拟。现有生成模型在标准透视图像上成功，但在广角畸变场景中的应用尚未被探索。

Method: 提出了两个方法：(1) SyntheOcc-FE，将SyntheOcc架构适配到鱼眼数据；(2) MIVIFI，利用等距柱状投影（Equirectangular Projection）实现跨域学习，结合KITTI-360鱼眼图像和nuScenes多视角标准图像，桥接数据域差距。框架支持对语义占用输入进行结构修改以引入或移除特定角色，并可渲染多样的气象和光照条件。

Result: 定量和定性实验表明，两种方法都能实现鲁棒的照片级多视角鱼眼图像生成，且跨域策略在处理数据稀缺问题上具有明显优势。

Conclusion: 本文验证了跨域学习策略能够有效缓解鱼眼数据集稀缺的问题，为多视角鱼眼图像的生成提供了可行且高效的解决方案。

Abstract: Achieving 360° coverage is critical for the visual perception systems of autonomous vehicles. Fisheye cameras offer a cost-effective solution by enabling full surround coverage with as few as two sensors. However, existing multi-view fisheye datasets are limited, and synthesizing rare corner cases typically requires computationally expensive 3D simulations, hindering the training. While generative models have achieved significant success in standard perspective imagery, their application to wide-angle distortion remains unexplored. In this work, we formally introduce the novel problem of multi-view fisheye image generation conditioned on volumetric semantic representations and present two distinct methods. We first propose SyntheOcc-FE, which adapts the SyntheOcc architecture to fisheye data. While effective, this method is constrained by the scarcity of fisheye datasets, which limits its generalization. To overcome these limitations, we propose our second method, MIVIFI (multi-view fisheye), which leverages cross-domain learning with Equirectangular Projections. By bridging the gap between dataset domains using KITTI-360 fisheye images alongside nuScenes multi-view standard images, our approach enables high-fidelity manipulation of scene content. This framework enables the structural modification of semantic occupancy inputs to introduce or eliminate specific actors and facilitates the rendering of diverse meteorological conditions and illumination scenarios absent in the limited fisheye datasets. Quantitative and qualitative experiments demonstrate that our methods achieve robust photorealistic multi-view fisheye image generation and highlight the specific advantages of our cross-domain strategy for handling data scarcity.

</details>


### [148] [How Merge-Tolerant Are Vision Transformers for Wheat Phenotyping?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23142)
*Simon Ravé,Pejman Rasti,David Rousseau*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文系统性地对训练免费token合并方法（ToMe和Mutual Pair Merging）在小麦视觉表型任务（生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、麦粒器官分割）上的性能进行了基准测试，涵盖任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和GPU峰值内存，并在Raspberry Pi 5上进行了额外测量。结果表明分类任务对token合并高度容忍，而检测和分割任务受重复实例、薄器官和密集边界等因素制约；此外，优化后的注意力后端可能抵消token合并带来的加速效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于视觉的小麦表型分析需要在部署约束下进行重复测量，普通Vision Transformer的二次注意力复杂度限制了高通量和边缘推理的性能。训练免费的token合并方法可以插入已训练模型而无需重新训练，具有吸引力，但缺乏系统性评估其在真实农业视觉任务中的有效性。

Method: 对ToMe和Mutual Pair Merging两种token合并方法在三个小麦表型任务（生长阶段分类、麦穗检测、麦粒器官分割）上进行系统基准测试，测量任务质量、吞吐量、token数量和GPU峰值内存，并在Raspberry Pi 5上进行额外的边缘设备测量。

Result: 基准测试揭示了明确的性能层次：分类任务对token合并高度容忍，而检测和分割任务受重复实例、薄器官、密集边界、重建和运行时间开销的限制。优化的注意力后端可以消除看似存在的加速效果，因此部署价值必须在目标运行时上进行性能分析，而非仅从token数量推断。

Conclusion: token合并方法在分类任务中效果良好，但在检测和分割任务中面临挑战；部署时必须基于实际目标运行时进行性能分析，不能仅依赖token数量来推断加速效果。

Abstract: Vision-based wheat phenotyping requires repeated measurements under deployment constraints, from growth-stage recognition to wheat-head counting and organ segmentation. Plain Vision Transformers (ViTs) provide a common architecture for these tasks, but quadratic attention limits high-throughput and edge inference. Training-free token merging is attractive because it can be inserted into trained models without retraining. We provide a systematic benchmark of ToMe and Mutual Pair Merging across growth-stage classification, wheat-head detection, and wheat-organ segmentation, measuring task quality, throughput, token count, and peak GPU memory, with additional Raspberry Pi 5 measurements. The benchmark reveals a clear hierarchy: classification is highly merge-tolerant, while detection and segmentation are constrained by repeated instances, thin organs, dense boundaries, reconstruction, and runtime overhead. Optimized attention backends can erase apparent speedups, so deployment value must be profiled on the target runtime rather than inferred from token count.

</details>


### [149] [An end-to-end-trained vision-language model for native-language prostate pathology report generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23143)
*Christian Grashei,Fabian Gülhan,Maximilian Legnar,Fabian Stögbauer,Cleo-Aron Weis,Carolin Mogler,Peter Schüffler*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个语言无关的前列腺癌切片级报告生成框架，从头训练分词器和模型（德文演示），通过本地大语言模型自动将复合报告拆分为核特异性图文对（17,344对），实现恶性检测96.2% F1和Gleason分级65.2%，并在三个外部队列上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前列腺癌是全球常见恶性肿瘤，每个活检核的结构化报告给病理医生带来沉重负担。现有工具将任务视为分类，仍需病理医生手动组装报告；且许多切片级视觉-语言模型依赖英语中心编码器，难以迁移到其他临床语言。

Method: 构建切片级框架，从零训练分词器和模型实现语言无关架构（德文演示）；利用自动化管线通过本地部署的大语言模型将复合报告拆分为核特异性图文对，从2,402个历史病例中生成17,344对无需人工标注；采用潜空间增强在外部队列上验证分级性能。

Result: 模型在临床属性评估（而非语言相似度）上，恶性检测达96.2% F1，Gleason分级达65.2%，与FDA批准的分类器相当；分级在三个外部队列上进一步验证有效。

Conclusion: 各机构可利用自家档案训练母语报告模型，实现语言无关的前列腺癌报告自动生成，减轻病理医生负担。

Abstract: Prostate cancer is among the most frequently diagnosed malignancies worldwide, and structured reporting of each biopsy core burdens pathologists. Existing tools frame this as classification, leaving pathologists to assemble coherent reports, while many slide-level vision-language models rely on English-centric encoders that transfer poorly to other clinical languages. We present a slide-level framework generating prostate biopsy reports that is language-independent by construction: tokenizer and model are trained from scratch, demonstrated here in German. To address paired-data scarcity, an automated pipeline uses a locally deployed large language model to split composite reports into core-specific image-text pairs, yielding 17,344 pairs from 2,402 historical cases without manual annotation. Evaluated for clinical attributes rather than linguistic similarity, the model achieves 96.2% F1 for malignancy detection and 65.2% for Gleason grading, competitive with an FDA-cleared classifier. Grading is further validated on three external cohorts with latent-space augmentation. Institutions can thus train native-language reporting models on their own archives.

</details>


### [150] [BenthicFlow: Generating Extensible Underwater Environments via Flow Matching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23173)
*Joaquín Figueira,Camile Lendering,Manfred Gonzalez-Hernandez,Giacomo D'Amicantonio,Erkut Akdag,Egor Bondarev*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: BenthicFlow 是一个基于单一条件流匹配模型的统一框架，用于联合生成对齐的纹理和深度图，生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克，并通过表面对齐的高斯曲面提升为显式3D水下环境。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下3D场景理解面临挑战，主要由于缺乏高质量3D数据且陆地训练的模型难以泛化到水下场景。现有生成方法通过后期拼接独立生成的瓦片来组装大场景，只能展示单个调查点内的异质景观，缺乏统一且可扩展的解决方案。

Method: 提出BenthicFlow框架，基于单一条件流匹配模型联合生成对齐的纹理和深度图。采用MultiDiffusion启发的采样过程，在生成轨迹中协调重叠窗口，无需单独的拼接模型即可生成空间可扩展的RGBD马赛克。生成的马赛克通过表面对齐的高斯曲面（Gaussian surfels）提升为显式3D水下环境。

Result: 在多个地理上不同的调查点进行实验，BenthicFlow能够保持特定地点的外观特征，同时生成连贯的大规模3D场景，且与目标分布紧密匹配。

Conclusion: BenthicFlow为水下3D场景生成提供了一种统一且可扩展的解决方案，克服了现有方法需要单独拼接模型的局限性，能够在不同地理位置生成连贯的大规模3D场景。

Abstract: Computer vision applications for 3D scene understanding in underwater environments remain challenging due to the lack of high-quality 3D data and the inability of surface-trained models to generalize to underwater scenes. To address this challenge, an emerging trend is to employ generative models to close the data domain gap. However, existing methods assemble large scenes by stitching independently generated tiles post hoc with separately trained models, while demonstrating heterogeneous landscapes only within individual survey sites. We introduce BenthicFlow, a unified framework based on a single conditional flow-matching model that jointly generates aligned textures and depth maps. A MultiDiffusion-inspired sampling procedure reconciles overlapping windows throughout the generative trajectory, enabling spatially extensible RGBD mosaics without a separate stitching model. The generated mosaics are subsequently lifted into explicit 3D benthic environments using surface-aligned Gaussian surfels. Experiments across geographically distinct survey sites demonstrate that BenthicFlow preserves site-specific appearance while generating coherent, large-scale 3D scenes that closely match the target distributions. Code and trained models are available at https://github.com/jacomof/BenthicFlow.

</details>


### [151] [Neighbor-Aware View Synthesis for Restoring Missing Views in Light-Field Camera Arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23175)
*Sakshi Goel,Ayush Goyal,K S Venkatesh,Koteswar Rao Jerripothula*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件生成对抗网络（cGAN）的生成式框架，用于修复光场相机阵列中因硬件故障导致的缺失子孔径图像。通过利用精心选择的邻近相机图像和位置编码图，该方法能够以几何一致的方式合成缺失视点，在合成和真实数据集上均优于基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 光场成像系统中相机阵列可能出现硬件故障，导致子孔径图像缺失，影响重建质量。现有方法缺乏对缺失视点修复的专门处理，需要一种鲁棒且高效的方案来恢复故障相机的视角。

Method: 提出一个生成式框架，核心流程为：(1) 从邻近相机中精心选择一组子集图像；(2) 将选定图像与位置编码图（包含相机位置和目标视点位置信息）拼接输入；(3) 使用cGAN训练生成缺失视点，确保几何一致性。

Result: 在合成和真实光场数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法能生成视觉上合理且光度精确的重建结果，在定量和定性指标上均优于视点插值基线方法。

Conclusion: 提出的框架为容错光场图像采集提供了鲁棒且高效的解决方案，能够有效应对相机阵列硬件故障带来的视角缺失问题。

Abstract: In light-field (LF) imaging systems, dense spatial sampling from a camera array enables powerful post-capture capabilities such as refocusing and depth estimation. However, real-world LF capture is often affected by hardware malfunctions, where one or more cameras in the array fail, leading to missing sub-aperture images and degraded reconstruction quality. This paper addresses the problem of defective or missing view restoration in light-field camera arrays. We propose a novel generative framework that synthesizes the absent views by exploiting information from a carefully selected subset of neighboring cameras. These selected images, along with a positional encoding map indicating both their locations and the desired target view, are fed into a conditional Generative Adversarial Network (cGAN) trained to generate the missing viewpoint in a geometrically consistent manner. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world LF datasets demonstrate that our method produces visually plausible and photometrically accurate reconstructions, outperforming baselines for view interpolation both quantitatively and qualitatively. The proposed framework thus offers a robust and efficient solution for fault-tolerant light-field image acquisition.

</details>


### [152] [EchoWM: Open and Enterable Omnimodal World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23189)
*Songchun Zhang,Yaowei Li,Junhao Zhuang,Weiyang Jin,Haoyu Wang,Xin Lu,Yilang Sun,Shiyi Zhang,Haoran Li,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yuming Li,Yijun Liu,Yaofeng Su,Yanwen Ma,Haoyu Wu,Zihan Su,Yue Ma,Lvmin Zhang,Haoyang Huang,Zeyue Xue,Anyi Rao,Nan Duan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: EchoWM是一个全模态世界模型，支持可进入的生成式媒体，能够响应连续导航并联合生成720p视频、环境音、音乐和语音。通过将离散命令和连续位姿映射到共享的度量尺度相对6-DoF轨迹，实现第一人称和第三人称场景的相机交互，并采用渐进式训练加自回归后训练实现长时程生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界模型大多仅关注视觉生成，缺乏对多模态(音视频)联合生成的支持，且难以处理第一人称与第三人称场景下的连续导航交互控制，缺乏统一的轨迹表征和跨异构数据的运动幅度校准。

Method: 1) 提出以相机意图为核心的组织方式：第一人称场景指定观察者运动，第三人称场景从数据中学习相机-角色动态。2) 将离散命令和连续位姿统一映射为共享的度量尺度相对6-DoF轨迹，并通过数据集级校准保持跨异构数据的运动幅度一致性。3) 构建互补数据引擎，采用渐进式训练和自回归后训练支持长时程生成。

Result: 在公开世界模型基准上取得强轨迹跟随能力和高视觉质量，支持第一人称和第三人称跨不同主体的交互，并在长时程生成中保持环境音和语音的同步。

Conclusion: EchoWM证明了统一6-DoF轨迹表征和渐进式多模态训练策略能有效支持可进入的、多模态(音视频+语音)长时程生成，为沉浸式生成媒体提供了可行的技术路径。

Abstract: We present EchoWM, an omnimodal world model for enterable generative media that responds to continuous navigation while jointly generating 720p video, environmental sound, music and speech. We organize interaction around camera intent: in first-person scenes, it specifies observer motion, while in third-person scenes, camera--character dynamics are learned from data without view-specific controllers. Discrete commands and continuous poses are mapped to a shared metric-scale relative 6-DoF trajectory, with dataset-level calibration preserving motion magnitude across heterogeneous data. To jointly learn audio-visual generation and trajectory control, we construct a complementary data engine and adopt progressive training followed by autoregressive post-training for long-horizon generation. Extensive evaluations show that \model achieves strong trajectory following and high visual quality on public world-model benchmarks, supporting both first- and third-person interaction across varied subjects, and maintaining synchronized environmental sound and speech over long-horizon generation.

</details>


### [153] [Toward a Foundation Plug-and-Play Prior for Computed Tomography Reconstruction via a Multimodal Diffusion Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23190)
*Haley Duba-Sullivan,Patxi Fernandez-Zelaia,Obaidullah Rahman,Amirkoushyar Ziabari*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究是否可以用一个在多个成像域上训练的扩散模型作为多种CT重建问题的通用先验。使用同一个冻结模型在三个不同数据集（不同模态、束几何、材料和退化类型）上评估，结果表明该方法在所有三个案例中都优于解析重建，朝可复用的异构CT重建基础先验迈出了一步。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统CT重建中，用于稀疏视角或低剂量重建的神经网络先验通常针对单一扫描设置训练，每当模态、几何或材料改变时就需要重新训练。作者希望探索是否能用单一扩散模型作为多种CT问题的通用先验，避免重复训练。

Method: 训练一个跨多个成像域的扩散模型作为先验，然后在三个不同数据集上使用同一个冻结的模型进行CT重建评估。数据集涵盖增材制造金属部件的锥束X射线CT和混凝土微观结构的平行束中子CT，模态、束几何、材料和退化类型均不同。

Result: 该方法在三个不同数据集上均优于解析重建，证明了单一冻结模型能够作为异构CT重建问题的有效先验。

Conclusion: 这项工作表明，跨成像域训练的扩散模型可以作为可复用的CT重建基础先验，为异构CT重建问题提供了通用解决方案，减少了针对特定扫描设置重复训练的需要。

Abstract: Computed tomography (CT) throughput is limited by scan time, which grows with both the number of projections acquired and the detector integration time for each. Reconstructing high-quality volumes from sparse-view or low-dose measurements therefore depends on an informative prior, typically a neural network trained for one specific scan setting and retrained whenever the modality, geometry, or material changes. We investigate whether a single diffusion model trained across several imaging domains can instead serve as a prior for many CT problems simultaneously. We evaluate the proposed method using the same frozen model on three datasets that differ in modality, beam geometry, material, and degradation type, spanning flaw analysis in additively manufactured metal parts imaged with cone-beam X-ray CT and concrete microstructure imaged with parallel-beam neutron CT. Our proposed method out-performs analytic reconstructions in all three cases, providing a step toward a reusable foundation prior for heterogeneous CT reconstruction problems.

</details>


### [154] [Learning Spherical Occupancy Profiles for Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23206)
*YiHsuan Tsai*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出将球面占据剖面（spherical occupancy profiles）——从多视图3D高斯重建中蒸馏出的射线级占据概率分布——作为判别式和生成式3D重建的统一中间表示，在999个物体的数据集上验证了判别式解码器和生成式扩散管线，并分析了剖面的形态学特性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多视图3D重建的判别式与生成式方法通常使用不同的中间表示，缺乏统一的、具有不确定性意识的接口。作者希望寻找一种紧凑、可学习且能表达不确定性的表示，既能用于判别式重建，也能衔接生成式先验。

Method: 1) 从多视图3D高斯重建中蒸馏出射线级占据概率剖面P(r)=T(r)o(r)。2) 判别式方法：训练一个逐射线解码器，通过FiLM条件注入全局视图平均和射线特定的图像证据。3) 生成式方法：构建剖面VAE加潜空间扩散模型，支持无条件采样和图像条件多解重建，用classifier-free guidance控制解的分散度。4) 形态学分析：对比后验功率锐化和学习锐化目标，揭示L1逐射线损失族中的单调宽度-峰值前沿。

Result: 判别式解码器在90个物体的测试集上达到中位归一化软深度误差0.035；生成式管线支持可量化和可调的多解重建。形态学分析显示锐化能恢复真实轮廓宽度而不损害深度精度。DTU真实照片验证表明管线可迁移到非合成输入。

Conclusion: 射线级占据剖面是一种紧凑、可学习且具有不确定性意识的统一表示，能在多视图重建和生成先验之间提供有效接口，并揭示了重建形态学前沿，为形态门控的重定义提供了理论依据。

Abstract: We study spherical occupancy profiles-the ray-wise occupancy probability profiles P(r) = T(r) o(r) distilled from multi-view 3D Gaussian reconstructions-as a unified intermediate representation for both discriminative and generative 3D reconstruction from images. On a 999-object subset of Google Scanned Objects with 48 turntable views each, we train (i) a discriminative per-ray decoder that injects global view-averaged and ray-specific image evidence into a FiLM-conditioned profile head, reaching median soft depth error 0.035 (normalized) on an independent 90-object test split, and (ii) a generative pipeline built on a profile VAE and a latent diffusion model, which supports unconditional sampling that matches the reconstruction manifold and image-conditioned multi-solution reconstruction whose per-object solution spread is quantifiable and tunable via classifier-free guidance. We further analyze the morphology of predicted profiles: post-hoc power sharpening and a learned sharpening target both recover ground-truth profile width without degrading depth, exposing a monotonic width-peak frontier in the L1-per-ray loss family and motivating a principled redefinition of morphology gates. Real-photo validation on two DTU scenes confirms the pipeline transfers to non-synthetic input. Our results suggest that ray-wise occupancy profiles offer a compact, learned, and uncertainty-aware interface between multi-view reconstruction and generative priors.

</details>


### [155] [Bee Detection and Tracking at Hive Entrance using YOLO11 and ByteTrack](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23213)
*Thi Thu Thao Nguyen,Johannes Reschke*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于YOLO11迁移学习和ByteTrack跟踪算法的自动蜜蜂入口监测系统，通过渐进式骨干网络解冻策略实现了97.0%的精度和98.7%的mAP50，并在独立视频中正确计数了91.5%的进入蜜蜂，但出蜂计数仅23.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 蜜蜂入口监测对于蜂群健康评估和生态研究具有重要意义，但蜜蜂体型小、运动速度快，检测和跟踪面临较大挑战。现有系统在真实条件下对小型快速移动目标的检测和计数可靠性不足，需要探索更优的训练策略和跟踪参数优化方法。

Method: 采用YOLO11迁移学习进行蜜蜂检测，结合ByteTrack算法进行目标跟踪计数。系统性地研究了数据增强策略（轻增强vs重增强）、骨干网络冻结策略（渐进式解冻vs全量微调）以及跟踪器参数优化对检测和计数性能的影响。

Result: 渐进式骨干网络解冻策略达到约97.0%的精度和98.7%的mAP50，收敛更稳定；轻增强优于重增强；优化ByteTrack参数后改善了低置信度检测下的轨迹连续性。在独立的25 FPS侧视视频中，正确计数43/47只进入蜜蜂（91.5%），但仅计数7/30只出蜂（23.3%）。误差分析显示主要误差源于运动模糊导致的漏检。

Conclusion: 中等程度的数据增强、渐进式骨干网络解冻和ByteTrack参数调优能够有效提升自动蜜蜂入口监测系统在真实录制条件下的可靠性。但出蜂计数精度仍需进一步改进，主要瓶颈在于快速运动和模糊造成的漏检问题。

Abstract: This work presents an automatic bee entrance monitoring system based on YOLO11 transfer learning and the ByteTrack tracking algorithm. The study investigates the influence of data augmentation, backbone freezing, and tracker parameter optimization on the detection and counting of small, fast-moving bees. The detector with progressive backbone unfreezing strategy achieved about 97.0% precision and 98.7% mAP50, while providing more stable convergence than full fine-tuning. Experiments also showed that light augmentation outperformed heavy augmentation. For tracking, ByteTrack parameters were optimized to improve trajectory continuity under low-confidence detections. On an independent 25 FPS side-view video, the optimized YOLO11-ByteTrack system correctly counted 43 of 47 incoming bees (91.5%) and 7 of 30 outgoing bees (23.3%). Error analysis showed that most counting errors were caused by missed detections due to rapid bee motion and motion blur, while tracking failures became less frequent after parameter optimization. Overall, the results indicate that moderate augmentation, progressive backbone unfreezing, and ByteTrack tuning improve the reliability of automatic bee entrance monitoring under realistic recording conditions.

</details>


### [156] [BenthicDINO: Physics-Informed Self-Distillation for View-Invariant Side-Scan Sonar Representations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23215)
*Taqi Hamoda,Hayat Rajani,Nuno Gracias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于物理信息的自蒸馏框架，用于侧扫声纳（SSS）图像的自动化感知。该框架基于DINOv3架构和ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干网络，通过物理驱动的数据增强（模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射校准误差）以及希尔伯特-施密特独立性准则（HSIC）惩罚来显式解耦密集补丁特征与物理观测参数，从而实现视图不变性。同时提出跨四个网络阶段的密集层次化特征融合策略，在S3Seg数据集上仅用10%标注数据即可达到峰值性能的96%，最终mIoU达71.4%，整体准确率86.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 侧扫声纳图像的自动化感知受到物理声学伪影的严重阻碍，这些伪影使得海底反射率与瞬态观测几何在表征中不可分割地混叠。现有的自监督学习框架仅依赖为自然图像设计的增强手段，未能考虑声学退化因素，也没有显式地强制视图不变性，导致在SSS场景下数据效率低下。

Method: 1) 构建基于DINOv3架构的物理信息自蒸馏框架，采用ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny骨干最大化数据效率；2) 通过两类机制强制视图不变性：物理驱动的增强（模拟散斑噪声、距离相关衰减和辐射校准误差）以及HSIC惩罚项显式解耦学习到的密集补丁特征与物理观测参数；3) 提出跨四个网络阶段的密集层次化特征融合策略，保留细粒度沉积物细节与深层语义抽象。

Result: 该框架能够无监督地将复杂海底地形自然地聚类为稳定、无噪声的语义簇，无需人工标注。在下游监督任务中，仅用10%标注数据即可达到绝对峰值性能的96%，最终在S3Seg数据集上实现71.4%的mIoU和86.5%的总体准确率。

Conclusion: 物理信息驱动的自监督学习范式在声纳图像领域具有显著优势，通过显式编码声学物理先验和特征解耦约束，能够大幅提升数据效率，为海底环境的大规模自动化感知提供了可行的路径。

Abstract: Automated perception in side-scan sonar (SSS) imagery is severely hindered by physical acoustic artifacts, resulting in representations that inextricably mix intrinsic seabed reflectivity with transient viewing geometries. Existing self-supervised learning (SSL) frameworks rely on augmentations designed for natural images, failing to account for acoustic degradation and explicitly enforce view-invariance. To address this gap, we introduce a physics-informed self-distillation framework built upon the DINOv3 architecture utilizing a ConvNeXt-v2-Tiny backbone to maximize data efficiency. The proposed methodology enforces view-invariance through two primary mechanisms: physically motivated augmentations that simulate speckle noise, range-dependent attenuation, and radiometric miscalibration; and a Hilbert-Schmidt Independence Criterion (HSIC) penalty that explicitly decouples learned dense patch features from physical viewing parameters. Furthermore, we propose a dense, hierarchical feature fusion strategy across all four network stages to preserve fine-grained sediment details alongside deep semantic abstractions. Extensive evaluation demonstrates that the framework natively groups complex benthic topographies into stable, noise-free semantic clusters without relying on manual annotations. During supervised downstream tasks on the S3Seg dataset, the fused representations exhibited exceptional data efficiency, achieving 96% of its absolute peak performance using only 10% of the available annotated data, ultimately reaching a mean Intersection over Union (mIoU) of 71.4% and an overall accuracy of 86.5%.

</details>


### [157] [MLLM-Assisted Audio VOS: A 3rd Place Report for the MeViS-Audio Track, 8th LSVOS Challenge](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23234)
*Liangtao Shi,Jinxia Xie,Xiantao Hu,Ting Liu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无需训练的训练自由框架，用于音频引导的视频目标分割任务。该框架将任务分解为多个阶段，结合多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）与基于SAM的分割模型，利用MLLMs的多模态推理能力建模文本-视觉对应关系，使用SAM模型生成精确的目标掩码。该框架在MeViS-Audio赛道中取得有竞争力的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频引导的视频目标分割是一个具有挑战性的任务，传统方法通常需要针对特定任务进行模型训练或微调，成本高昂且泛化能力有限。作者希望通过整合现有基础模型（如MLLMs和SAM）的能力，避免额外训练即可完成该任务。

Method: 将音频引导的视频目标分割任务分解为多个阶段，分别为每个阶段选择合适的现有基础模型。利用MLLMs强大的多模态推理能力来处理音频与视觉之间的文本-视觉对应关系，然后使用基于SAM的分割模型生成精确的目标掩码。整个框架不需要引入额外的模型训练或任务特定的微调。

Result: 该训练自由框架在第八届LSVOS挑战赛的MeViS-Audio赛道中取得了具有竞争力的性能表现。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了利用现有基础模型进行音频引导视频分割的有效性，展示了无需额外训练即可完成复杂多模态分割任务的潜力。

Abstract: In this technical report, we present a training-free framework for audio-guided video object segmentation, which integrates Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) with SAM-based segmentation models. We decompose the task into several stages and identify suitable foundation models for each stage. Without introducing additional model training or task-specific fine-tuning, our approach leverages the strong multimodal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs to model text-visual correspondence and employs SAM-based models for accurate object mask generation. The proposed framework demonstrates the effectiveness of leveraging foundation models for audio-guided video segmentation and achieves competitive performance in the MeViS-Audio Track of the 8th LSVOS Challenge.

</details>


### [158] [Mover360: Controllable Object Manipulation in 360° Panoramic Images](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23238)
*Haoyi Zhong,Fang-Lue Zhang,Andrew Chalmers,Taehyun Rhee*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Mover360是一个针对360°全景图像的可控物体操作框架，支持物体平移、参考引导的插入和移除任务，通过统一接口和ERP对齐指令图实现单次点击的物体重定位，并利用UE5数据生成管道构建大规模配对数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 与透视图像不同，360°全景图像（ERP投影）具有水平环绕、纬度相关畸变和全局场景连续性等特点，这使得现有的透视图像编辑器和用户难以指定和完成物体级别的编辑任务。

Method: Mover360将物体平移作为核心任务，并支持参考引导的插入和移除作为辅助任务。其接口统一了点、边界框和掩码引导控制，通过将每个任务编码为固定提示词和紧凑的ERP对齐指令图实现。在默认点模式下，单次点击即可重定位物体，模型利用全景上下文和辅助深度条件推断合理的尺寸、支撑和光照。结构上，Mover360是对预训练扩散Transformer的轻量级适配，并使用UE5数据生成管道构建表面感知物体放置和随机光照的大规模配对数据。

Result: Mover360在合成和真实全景两个测试域及两种评估协议下，在重建保真度、语义一致性和分布质量方面均优于透视编辑、插入和修复的强基线方法。

Conclusion: Mover360提供了针对360°全景图像的可控物体操作方法，并通过统一交互接口、预训练扩散Transformer轻量适配以及大规模配对数据生成，有效解决了全景图像物体编辑中的挑战。

Abstract: We present Mover360, a controllable object manipulation framework for 360° images. Unlike perspective images, 360° images in equirectangular projection (ERP) exhibit horizontal wrap-around, latitude-dependent distortion, and global scene continuity, which makes object-level edits difficult for existing perspective editors to produce and for users to specify. To address this, Mover360 centers on object Translation (relocating a specified object within an existing panorama) while supporting reference-guided Insert and Remove as auxiliary tasks. Its interface unifies point-, bbox-, and mask-guided control by encoding each task into a fixed prompt and a compact, ERP-aligned instruction map. In the default point mode, a single click relocates an object, allowing the model to infer a plausible size, support, and illumination using panoramic context and an auxiliary depth condition. Structurally, Mover360 is a lightweight adaptation of a pretrained diffusion transformer. To generate paired supervision, we construct a UE5 data-generation pipeline with surface-aware object placement and randomized illumination, yielding large-scale paired data and a dual-domain benchmark of synthetic and real panoramas with ground truth for all three tasks. Across both test domains and two evaluation protocols, Mover360 outperforms strong baselines for perspective editing, insertion, and inpainting in reconstruction fidelity, semantic consistency, and distributional quality. Code and our benchmark dataset are available at https://zhonghaoyi.github.io/Mover360/.

</details>


### [159] [Semantic Reconstruction and 3-D Detection via Learned Multi-Pair Fusion in RF Imaging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23249)
*Amir Rezaei,Wen-Xin Pan,Giuseppe Caire*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种多静态各向异性射频成像方法，利用3-D U-Net对每个Tx-Rx对的图像重建结果进行隐式融合和逐体素语义分类，再通过几何后处理得到目标实例及方向包围盒。相比传统强度重建，语义重建与3-D检测在噪声下退化更缓，且通过outlier exposure引入未知类以处理未见过的物体类别。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统多静态射频成像专注于强度重建，在信噪比低下时信号会迅速淹没于噪声之中，导致重建质量急剧退化。本文的动机是利用语义信息（对体素分配语义类别并分组为实例）来提高成像对噪声的鲁棒性，同时应对真实场景中出现的训练未知类别物体。

Method: 对每个Tx-Rx成像对使用标准逆问题求解器（BP和LASSO用于单次确定性快照；非相干BP和group-LASSO用于多次衰落快照）生成重建图像，再将六个Tx-Rx对的图像作为输入通道送入经过训练的3-D U-Net进行隐式融合和逐体素分类，最后通过聚类和主成分分析等几何后处理获得目标实例及方向包围盒。此外，通过outlier exposure训练显式未知类以拒绝未见类别物体。

Result: 在广泛信噪比范围内，语义重建（以分割IoU评估）和3-D检测的性能退化远优于经典强度重建，检测可靠性在强度重建已完全失效的噪声水平下仍能保持。outlier exposure训练的未知类能够将新异物体标记为未知而非误分类为已知类别。

Conclusion: 将语义先验与深度学习融合引入多静态射频成像，可显著提升成像在低信噪比下的稳定性与实用性，为高噪声环境下的射频感知提供了一条更具鲁棒性的技术路线。

Abstract: We consider a multistatic radio-frequency imaging problem with anisotropy, in which the reflection from a point depends on the positions of the transmit (Tx) and receive (Rx) arrays. The goal is to label the voxels of a field of view by a finite set of semantic classes and to group them into object instances. For the image formation of each Tx--Rx pair we apply a standard inverse-problem solver, and we feed the resulting per-pair reconstructions into a trained three-dimensional (3-D) U-Net that performs the fusion implicitly and the per-voxel classification explicitly. On a controlled, under-determined multistatic setup, we consider the following image formation methods: back-projection (BP) and the least absolute shrinkage and selection operator (LASSO) from a single deterministic snapshot, and incoherent BP and group-LASSO from multiple fading snapshots. For each imaging method we train a separate U-Net that fuses the six Tx--Rx pairs (its input channels) and assigns each voxel a probability vector over the classes. Taking the most probable class gives a labeled volume---the semantic reconstruction. Object instances and their oriented bounding boxes then follow by geometric post-processing (clustering and principal-component analysis). Across a wide range of signal-to-noise ratio, the semantic reconstruction (scored against ground truth by segmentation intersection-over-union) and the resulting 3-D detection degrade far more gracefully than the classical intensity reconstruction: the detection in particular stays reliable well into noise levels at which that reconstruction has dissolved. Because real scenes contain objects of classes the network was not trained on, we add an explicit unknown class trained by outlier exposure, which labels held-out novel objects as unknown instead of mislabeling them as a known class by reconstructed shape.

</details>


### [160] [E2S-Pruner: Progressive Two-Stage Evidence Fusion for Visual Token Pruning in Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23253)
*Taoyu Qian,Qi Wang,Daqian Shi,Yuanhao Jiang,Shang Gao,Hualong Yu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出E2S-Pruner，一个无需训练的两阶段证据融合框架，用于视觉token剪枝。它利用Dempster-Shafer证据理论，将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，先估计可靠性并分类token（重要/不重要/不确定），再融合多层互补证据，并引入空间新颖性约束避免token过度集中。在LLaVA-1.5-7B上保留192/128/64个token时，分别保持98.0%/96.8%/90.6%的聚合性能，推理吞吐量提升1.96x-2.09x，并在Qwen2-VL-7B上验证了跨模型泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言模型将图像编码为数百个视觉token，导致推理延迟和GPU内存开销巨大。现有剪枝方法大多依赖注意力分数，并简单跨注意力头和网络层聚合输出，难以刻画证据不确定性与冲突，剪枝效果受限。

Method: 提出渐进式两阶段证据融合框架：(1) 第一阶段将每个注意力头视为独立证据源，基于证据清晰度和头间一致性估计可靠性，将每个token表示为重要/不重要/不确定三种状态；(2) 第二阶段使用Dempster-Shafer证据理论量化层间冲突并融合多层互补证据；(3) 引入空间新颖性约束，促进token覆盖不同图像区域，防止保留token集中在少数局部显著区域。无需辅助模型、可训练参数或微调。

Result: 在LLaVA-1.5-7B上，保留192/128/64个视觉token时分别保持98.0%/96.8%/90.6%的聚合性能，128-token和64-token设置下吞吐量分别提升1.96x和2.09x；在Qwen2-VL-7B上验证了跨模型泛化能力。

Conclusion: E2S-Pruner通过证据理论框架有效刻画了视觉token剪枝中的不确定性和冲突，在保持高任务性能的同时显著提升推理效率，且具备良好的跨模型泛化性与零训练部署优势。

Abstract: Vision-language models typically encode an image into hundreds of visual tokens, incurring substantial inference latency and GPU memory overhead. Existing pruning methods largely rely on attention scores and directly aggregate outputs across attention heads and network layers, making it difficult to characterize evidential uncertainty and conflict. We propose E2S-Pruner, a progressive two-stage evidence-fusion framework for visual token pruning that requires no auxiliary model, trainable parameters, or fine-tuning. In the first stage, E2S-Pruner treats each attention head as an independent evidence source, estimates its reliability from evidence clarity and inter-head consistency, and represents each visual token using three states: important, unimportant, and uncertain. In the second stage, Dempster--Shafer evidence theory is used to quantify inter-layer conflict and fuse complementary evidence from multiple network layers. We further introduce a spatial novelty constraint that promotes coverage of distinct image regions and prevents the retained tokens from concentrating in a few locally salient areas. On LLaVA-1.5-7B, E2S-Pruner retains 98.0%, 96.8%, and 90.6% of the aggregate performance when the average numbers of retained visual tokens are 192, 128, and 64, respectively, while improving throughput by 1.96x and 2.09x under the 128-token and 64-token settings. Experiments on Qwen2-VL-7B further demonstrate cross-model generalization. Code is available at https://github.com/taoyu-qian/E2S-Pruner.git.

</details>


### [161] [Progressively Learning Heterogeneous Skills in a Unified Latent Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23258)
*Yue-Yi Zhang,Ming Gong,Linpu He,Wei-Shi Zheng,Zhilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出了HetSkills框架，在统一潜空间中渐进式学习异构技能，用于基于物理的角色控制。通过共享运动解码器实现跨任务复用，并结合运动直觉蒸馏与任务引导模块，支持运动追踪、文本生成运动、运动补全及下游任务适应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于物理的角色控制方法通常针对单一技能或任务设计独立的控制器，难以整合来自不同数据源、监督形式和任务的异构技能，缺乏统一的技能表征与可扩展性。

Method: 1) 将潜空间作为共享可执行接口，学习追踪技能以建立运动控制基础和共享运动解码器；2) 引入运动直觉蒸馏，防止文本到运动技能利用捷径路径而非学习语言语义；3) 设计任务引导模块，根据高层语言指令动态调整动作。

Result: 在运动追踪、文本生成运动、运动补全和下游任务适应方面均表现出有效性，即使在具有挑战性的条件下也取得了出色的成功率。

Conclusion: HetSkills能够在保持自然运动的同时持续扩展技能库，对长时程任务具有高度适应性，验证了统一潜空间框架在异构技能学习中的可行性。

Abstract: We propose HetSkills, a novel framework designed to progressively learn heterogeneous skills within a unified latent space for physics-based character control. The core idea is to treat this latent space as a shared executable interface, enabling seamless integration of skills learned from diverse data sources, supervision forms, and tasks. HetSkills begins by learning a tracking skill that establishes a strong foundation in motion control and creates a shared motion decoder, which can be reused across tasks without the need for retraining or separate controllers. To prevent the text-to-motion skill from exploiting shortcut pathways instead of learning language semantics, we introduce motion intuition distillation to ground text-to-motion generation in language semantics and a task-guidance module that dynamically adjusts actions based on high-level language instructions. This enables HetSkills to preserve natural motion while continuously expanding its skill repertoire, making it highly adaptable for long-horizon tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness in motion tracking, text-to-motion generation, motion completion, and downstream task adaptation, achieving impressive success rates even under challenging conditions.

</details>


### [162] [Dual-Grained Agent Memory and Shapley Context Attribution for Multimodal Agentic Learner](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23268)
*Jieke Wang,Tiancheng Shen,Yibo Yang,Ming-Hsuan Yang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: DG-Mem是一个双粒度智能体记忆框架，通过非参数化外部存储增强冻结的MLLM，无需梯度更新即可提升其科学和数学推理能力。它包含实例级样本记忆和类别级模式记忆，并通过在线概念分类器和Shapley上下文归因机制优化检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 前沿多模态大语言模型在感知任务上表现优异，但在科学和数学推理上仍显不足。参数级适配对闭源权重或端侧模型不可行，而无状态提示方式无法从已解决的相似问题中获得累积收益。

Method: DG-Mem包含三个核心组件：1) 实例级样本记忆与类别级IF-THEN模式记忆的双粒度存储结构，受互补学习系统理论启发；2) 在线概念分类器，在训练过程中增量扩展类别空间，而非预先定义固定分类体系；3) Shapley上下文归因过程，分解整个检索规则集的正确性贡献，为每条规则计算效用值并在测试时重新加权检索。

Result: 在MathVista、MMMU和MMMU-Pro三个基准上，使用四种开放权重和专有模型（Qwen3.5-27B、Qwen3.5-122B-A10B、GPT-5-Nano、Gemini-3-Flash）进行测试，DG-Mem一致优于无记忆基线和竞争性记忆基线。

Conclusion: DG-Mem证明了通过非参数化、外部存储记忆增强冻结MLLM的推理能力是可行的，无需梯度更新即可部署到闭源权重或端侧骨干模型上，在多个基准和骨干模型上实现稳定的性能提升。

Abstract: Frontier multimodal large language models (MLLMs) deliver impressive perception yet still falter on scientific and mathematical reasoning. Parameter-level adaptation is unavailable for closed-weight or on-device backbones, and stateless prompting forfeits any compounding benefit from problems already solved. We propose \textbf{DG-Mem}, a dual-grained agentic memory framework that augments a frozen MLLM with a non-parametric, externally stored memory built once from training-time rollouts and consulted read-only at test time. Motivated by the Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) account of human memory, DG-Mem factors its store into an instance-grounded exemplar memory and a category-level schema memory of IF-THEN rules, with a transient reflection store mediating their construction so that schemas are synthesized only from abstract reflections, never from exemplar text. Two design choices distinguish DG-Mem: an online concept categorizer that grows the category space incrementally during training rather than committing to a predefined taxonomy, and a Shapley context attribution procedure that decomposes correctness across the entire retrieved rule set and yields a per-rule utility that re-weights retrieval at test time. The pipeline introduces no gradient updates and is deployable on closed-weight or on-device backbones. Across MathVista, MMMU, and MMMU-Pro on four open-weight and proprietary backbones (Qwen3.5-27B, Qwen3.5-122B-A10B, GPT-5-Nano, Gemini-3-Flash), DG-Mem improves consistently over no-memory and competitive memory baselines.

</details>


### [163] [Spatiotemporally Decoupled Autoregressive Diffusion Model for Human Motion Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23279)
*Chengqun Yang,Liang Xu,Yanping Li,Fulong Liu,Jingnan Gao,Weili Zeng,Yichao Yan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DeMoDiff，一个统一的时空解耦框架，通过空间-时间VAE对每个身体关节进行编码（而非整体压缩）以增强表示提取和部分级控制，并引入空间-时间掩码与注意力机制到自回归扩散生成器中，在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上取得SOTA重建与生成性能，同时具备强大的时空编辑能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有动作表示方法存在显著局限：VQ-based方法存在固有信息丢失，损害生成质量、多样性和泛化性；连续表示作用于全身整体动作，阻碍了部分级灵活性。同时，现有扩散架构在个体身体部位的细粒度可控性方面有限。

Method: 提出DeMoDiff统一框架：1) 提出空间-时间VAE，对每个身体关节进行编码而非将全身运动压缩到单一潜空间，增强表示提取能力并提供部分级控制；2) 在自回归扩散生成器中引入空间-时间掩码和注意力机制，同时实现生成能力和可控编辑性。

Result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML数据集上达到SOTA重建性能和令人信服的动作生成结果，并展现出强大的时间和空间编辑能力。

Conclusion: 通过联合重新设计表示与架构（时空解耦），DeMoDiff有效克服了VQ信息丢失与整体连续表示缺乏部分级灵活性的问题，在生成质量、可控性与可编辑性方面均得到验证。

Abstract: Text-driven human motion synthesis has made substantial development with two core modules of motion representation and generative architecture. For representation, Vector Quantization (VQ)-based methods compress motion data into discrete tokens while latent-based models operate directly in continuous space. However, both of these representations exhibit significant limitations. VQ-based methods suffer from inherent information loss, which compromises the quality, diversity, and generalization of generated motions, while continuous representation on holistic whole-body motion hinders part-level flexibility. For architecture, diffusion and autoregressive diffusion models have demonstrated their superiority, yet the fine-grained controllability over individual body parts is also limited. Thus, we propose a unified spatiotemporally decoupled framework named DeMoDiff, which jointly redesigns representation and architecture. To enhance representation extraction capabilities and offer greater part-level controllability, we present a spatial-temporal VAE that encodes each body joint rather than compressing the whole-body motion into a single latent space. Then, we incorporate spatial-temporal masking and attention mechanisms into an autoregressive diffusion generator, achieving both generative capability and controllable editability. Extensive experiments on the HumanML3D and KIT-ML datasets demonstrate that our model achieves state-of-the-art reconstruction performance and compelling motion generation results. Moreover, our framework demonstrates strong temporal and spatial editing capabilities, further validating its effectiveness. Our project page: https://rex0191.github.io/DeMoDiff/

</details>


### [164] [Spotter: Efficient Urban Visual Localization via Geo-Referenced Facade Landmarks in GPS-Degraded Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23290)
*Antoni Valls,Jordi Sanchez-Riera*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: Spotter是一种鲁棒且实时的视觉定位框架，利用建筑立面作为全局地理参考源，解决密集城市场景中GPS信号退化导致的定位漂移和计算负担问题。离线阶段处理Google街景全景图构建紧凑度量数据库，运行时通过级联检索与几何验证恢复全局相机定位，在巴塞罗那智能眼镜数据集上超越里程计基线，达到与最先进基于地图方法相当的精度且帧率更高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 密集城市环境中GPS信号因多径传播频繁退化，视觉里程计漂移无法消除，地图匹配方法依赖可靠的GPS先验且计算量大，无法满足实时边缘执行需求，亟需一种不依赖GPS、轻量且实时的全局视觉定位方案。

Method: 离线阶段：从Google街景全景图中语义分割建筑立面，将多视立体深度与制图数据配对，构建紧凑的度量数据库。运行时：通过级联检索与几何验证流程匹配查询图像，恢复细粒度的全局相机定位，同时保留在GPS可用时整合GPS信号的能力。

Result: 在巴塞罗那多个区域采集的智能眼镜行人序列数据集上，Spotter优于里程计基线方法，定位精度与最先进的基于地图方法相当，同时以显著更高的帧率运行。

Conclusion: Spotter验证了建筑立面作为全局地理参考源的可行性，在精度与实时性之间取得了良好平衡，为密集城市环境中的可穿戴和机器人平台提供了一种实用且高效的视觉定位解决方案。

Abstract: Accurate visual localization on robotic and wearable platforms remains challenging in dense urban environments. Existing methodologies typically rely on GPS for absolute positioning, yet GPS signals frequently degrade in urban canyons due to multipath propagation. Consequently, standard solutions like visual odometry suffer from unmitigated drift over time, while map-matching techniques struggle to acquire the reliable GPS priors they need, on top of being too computationally heavy for real-time edge execution. To address these limitations, we propose Spotter, a robuts and real-time visual localization framework that uses building facades as a reliable source of global geo-reference, while retaining the capability to integrate GPS signals when available. In an offline stage, Spotter processes Google Street View panoramas by semantically segmenting facades and pairing multi-view stereo depth with cartographic data to build a compact metric database. At runtime, query images are matched via a cascaded retrieval and geometric verification pipeline to recover fine-grained global camera localization. We benchmark Spotter on a newly collected dataset of pedestrian sequences acquired with wearable smart glasses across several districts of Barcelona. Experimental results show that Spotter outperforms odometry-based baselines and achieves localization accuracy comparable to state-of-the-art map-based methods while operating at significantly higher frame rates.

</details>


### [165] [What Memory Composition Does Not Tell Us About Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23295)
*Joongwon Chae,Runming Wang,Peiwu Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器中，记忆选择策略与训练数据污染的关系。发现全局覆盖选择会过度代表稀疏污染，提出的CLEANCON门控方法可将最终记忆污染降至接近零，并在全部12个对比中提升P-AP，但记忆污染度与最终性能P-AP并非单调对应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于记忆的异常检测器将训练补丁存入记忆库作为正常参考，但选择覆盖补丁时未单独校验其几何稀有性是否安全可信。在稀疏训练污染条件下，这一耦合可能导致污染补丁被不当纳入记忆。

Method: 在固定表征和记忆预算下，比较随机、质心（medoid）、局部和全局覆盖选择器；提出CLEANCON——一种基于袋外交叉图像的支持门控方法，在固定表征、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则的前提下，改变候选图像的入选资格。

Result: 全局覆盖选择严重过度代表稀疏污染。CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降至约零，并在全部12组匹配比较中提升类别宏平均P-AP。但在保留扫描中，最低污染记忆并未达到最高P-AP，性能随污染上升继续改善。

Conclusion: 记忆污染程度并不能按P-AP排序最终记忆的性能——最低污染并不对应最优检测能力，表明污染度与检测性能之间是非单调关系。

Abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP

</details>


### [166] [What Remains Normal? Clean Images Miss Useful Near-Defect Normal Patches for Anomaly Detection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23299)
*Joongwon Chae,Runming Wang,Peiwu Qin*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于记忆的异常检测器中，记忆覆盖选择器与稀疏训练污染之间的关系。作者提出CLEANCON，一种袋外交叉图像支持门控机制，能降低最终记忆污染并提升所有12组对比中的类别宏平均P-AP，但发现记忆污染程度与最终P-AP性能并非单调相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有记忆型异常检测器在选取记忆补丁时，缺乏对"几何稀有性"的检查，导致稀疏训练污染可能被过度代表为正常参考。作者希望探究覆盖选择策略如何影响污染传播，以及是否能在不改变表示、记忆大小、构建器和推理规则的前提下改善性能。

Method: 在固定表示和记忆预算下，比较随机、质心、局部和全局四种覆盖选择器；提出CLEANCON——一种袋外交叉图像支持门控机制，通过改变候选图像的资格来过滤污染记忆，同时保持表示、绝对记忆大小、构建器和推理规则不变。

Result: 全局覆盖策略会强烈过度代表稀疏污染。CLEANCON将最终记忆污染降至约零，并在全部12组匹配对比中提升类别宏平均P-AP。但沿保留扫描发现，最低污染的并非最高P-AP，性能在污染上升时仍持续改善。

Conclusion: 记忆污染程度不能作为排序记忆质量的单一标准——污染更低的记忆不一定P-AP更高。这挑战了"污染必须降至最低"的直觉，表明异常检测中记忆质量评估还需考虑其他维度。

Abstract: Memory-based anomaly detectors store nominal training patches and score test patches against this memory. A patch selected for coverage therefore becomes a nor- mal reference without a separate check that geometric rarity makes it safe to trust. We probe this coupling with sparse training contamination. Under fixed representa- tions and memory budgets, we compare random, medoid, local, and global coverage selectors. We then use CLEANCON, an out-of-bag cross-image support gate that changes candidate-image eligibility while fixing the representation, absolute mem- ory size, builder, and inference rule. Global coverage strongly over-represents sparse contamination. CLEANCON reduces final-memory contamination to approx- imately zero and increases category-macro P-AP in all 12 matched comparisons. Yet along a retention sweep, the lowest-contamination memory does not attain the highest P-AP; performance continues to improve while contamination rises. Mem- ory contamination therefore does not order the resulting memories by P-AP.Code is publicly available at https://github.com/jw-chae/cleancon.

</details>


### [167] [Grounding Free-Form Instructions for Fashion Complementary Image Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23302)
*Matteo Attimonelli,Claudio Pomo,Alessandro De Bellis,Danilo Danese,Dietmar Jannach,Tommaso Di Noia*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出时尚互补图像生成任务，使用自由形式指令替代僵化的模板提示，并引入StyleFlow模型——一个在单一多模态Transformer中同时以种子图像和自然语言指令为条件的Rectified Flow Matching模型，在生成指令对齐且风格连贯的服装的同时降低架构复杂性和推理成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有CIG基准依赖僵化的模板提示（如"一张裙子的照片"），无法反映真实用户查询，也掩盖了模型在不同语言特异性水平下的行为表现。需要更自然的多模态语言接地设定。

Method: 1) 用视觉语言模型生成低、中、高三种特异性指令，并通过人工标注验证，扩充三个CIG基准；2) 提出StyleFlow模型，采用Rectified Flow Matching，在单个多模态Transformer中联合条件化种子图像和指令。

Result: 在图像质量指标、目录对齐分析、消融实验和人工评估中，StyleFlow一致地生成指令对齐且风格连贯的服装，同时相比辅助模块方法减少了架构复杂性和推理成本。

Conclusion: 自由形式指令设定更好地反映自然用户查询，StyleFlow验证了在单一多模态架构下进行有效语言接地生成的可能性，兼顾生成质量与效率。

Abstract: Fashion complementary image generation (CIG) aims to create garments that stylistically match a seed item based on user intent, making it a natural multimodal grounding problem where models must interpret language in visual context. Existing CIG benchmarks rely on rigid template prompts (e.g., "a photo of a skirt"), failing to reflect natural user queries and obscuring model behavior across levels of linguistic specificity. We introduce fashion complementary image generation with free-form instructions, a multimodal language-grounding setting where a model generates a compatible garment from a seed image and a natural-language instruction. To this end, we enrich three CIG benchmarks with low-, medium-, and high-specificity instructions generated by a vision-language model and validated by human annotators. We instantiate the task with StyleFlow, a Rectified Flow Matching model that jointly conditions on the seed image and instruction within a single multimodal transformer. Across image quality metrics, catalog-alignment analysis, ablations, and human evaluation, StyleFlow consistently produces instruction-aligned and stylistically coherent garments while reducing architectural complexity and inference cost relative to auxiliary-module approaches.

</details>


### [168] [Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23329)
*Wenqi Liu,Shijie Ma,Yunxiao Wang,Meng Liu,Qile Su,Han Liu,Bohan Hou,Xuanyu Zheng,Changyi Liu,Tianke Zhang,Haonan Fan,Kaiyu Jiang,Yingxin Li,Jiankang Chen,Xu Wang,Bin Wen,Tingting Gao,Han Li,Jianhua Yin,Yinwei Wei,Xuemeng Song*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: VideoRover是一个统一的视频深度研究框架，通过迭代协调视频裁剪、多模态搜索和网页浏览，实现开放世界视频理解。它构建了26K验证SFT轨迹和3K挑战性RL实例的数据管线，并推出VideoRover-Bench基准。8B参数模型在直接回答设置下可与专有模型相媲美，且在相同工具套件下超越更大的开源模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开放世界视频理解通常需要定位稀疏视觉证据并获取视频及其参数记忆之外的外部知识。现有方法将Thinking-with-Videos（主动时间感知）和Deep Research（多步信息搜寻）分开开发，缺乏统一框架来协调视频内部感知与外部检索。

Method: VideoRover采用迭代框架，根据每个工具结果选择下一动作：局部视频片段引导外部检索，检索证据触发进一步视频检查和验证。通过自动化数据整理管线构建26K SFT轨迹和3K RL实例进行训练，并设计按视频时长和研究难度分层的基准。

Result: VideoRover-8B-RL在直接回答设置下无需工具使用即可达到与专有模型相当的性能，同时在配备相同工具套件时超越更大的开源模型。消融研究和训练动态验证了主动视频定位、外部检索和长时程强化学习的互补作用。

Conclusion: 统一的视频深度研究框架以及主动视频定位、外部检索和长时程RL的协同组合，是提升开放世界视频理解能力的关键路径。

Abstract: Open-world video understanding often requires a model to locate sparse visual evidence and acquire external knowledge that is absent from the video and its parametric memory. While Thinking-with-Videos enables active temporal perception and Deep Research supports multi-step information seeking, the two capabilities are typically developed in isolation. We introduce VideoRover, a unified Video Deep Research framework that iteratively coordinates video cropping, multimodal search, and webpage browsing. Given a video-question pair, VideoRover uses each tool result to select the next action, so localized video clips guide external retrieval and retrieved evidence triggers further video inspection and verification. To develop this capability, we construct an automated data curation pipeline, producing 26K verified SFT trajectories and 3K challenging RL instances. We also introduce VideoRover-Bench, a benchmark stratified by video duration and research difficulty. Experiments on VideoDR and VideoRover-Bench show that our VideoRover-8B-RL achieves performance comparable to proprietary models in the direct-answer setting without tool use while outperforming larger open-source models equipped with the same tool suite. Ablation studies and training dynamics further validate the complementary roles of active video grounding, external retrieval, and long-horizon reinforcement learning.

</details>


### [169] [IntentQA: Intent Question Answering in Videos by Cognitive Context Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23330)
*Jiapeng Li,Ping Wei,Wenjuan Han,Song-Chun Zhu,Lifeng Fan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个新的视频问答任务IntentQA和相应的大规模数据集，用于理解人类行为背后的意图（称之为社会智能的"暗物质"）。作者通过LLM生成五种对比集并引入"Contrast Performance Decline"指标来评估模型鲁棒性，同时提出了X-CaVIR框架，利用三种认知上下文（情境、对比、常识）增强视频分析，并通过透明化的LLM集成管线实现可解释的推理过程。实验表明X-CaVIR优于现有基线且对扰动具有稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频理解方法主要关注视觉事实的识别，忽略了人类行为背后的意图理解（社会智能的"暗物质"）。此外，标准评估指标可能因数据集偏差而高估模型能力，需要更严格的鲁棒性评估和可解释的推理框架。

Method: 1) 提出IntentQA任务和大规模视频问答数据集；2) 使用LLM生成五种对比集并引入Contrast Performance Decline指标；3) 提出X-CaVIR框架，包含跨模态Video Query Language模块（情境上下文）、对比学习模块（对比上下文）、常识推理模块（常识上下文）；4) 采用透明管线集成LLM，将视频描述与VQA模型输出相结合，实现可解释推理。

Result: 大量实验表明各组件有效，X-CaVIR在意图理解任务上优于现有最优基线，并且在对比集上表现出对扰动的稳定性。

Conclusion: 通过融合三种认知上下文和透明化的LLM集成，X-CaVIR不仅提升了视频意图理解的性能，还使推理过程具有可解释性，为解决视频理解中的意图推理这一深层次问题提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Video understanding requires intelligent agents to transcend mere recognition of visual facts and comprehend the underlying intents behind human actions (often termed the "dark matter" of social intelligence). To bridge the gap between visual observation and intent reasoning, we introduce a novel task, IntentQA, and contribute a large-scale VideoQA dataset specifically tailored for this purpose. However, recognizing that standard metrics may overestimate capabilities due to dataset biases, we go beyond simple accuracy to rigorously evaluate model robustness. We augment the benchmark by generating five distinct contrast sets via Large Language Models (LLMs) and introducing a "Contrast Performance Decline" metric. We propose the X-CaVIR (eXplainable Context-aware Video Intent Reasoning) framework, which leverages three types of "Cognitive Context" to enhance video analysis: i) Situational Context via a cross-modal Video Query Language (VQL) module, ii) Contrastive Context via a Contrastive Learning module, and iii) Commonsense Context via a Commonsense Reasoning module. Crucially, to overcome the opacity of traditional black-box models, we refine the integration of LLMs within X-CaVIR by employing a transparent pipeline that synergizes video captions with VQA model outputs. This approach not only improves performance by effectively utilizing rich commonsense knowledge but also renders the reasoning process explicitly interpretable. Extensive experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of our components, the superiority of X-CaVIR over state-of-the-art baselines, and its stability against perturbations on the contrast sets.

</details>


### [170] [Can Coding Agents Build Robust Baselines? A Skill-Based Approach for Automating the Medical Imaging Model-Development Pipeline](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23336)
*Eugenia Moris,José Ignacio Orlando*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种名为"智能体AI科学家"的工作流程，将文献引导推理、自动代码生成和假设驱动实验相结合，自动生成医学影像挑战的竞争性基线模型。该框架在分割、分类和检测任务的四个公开基准上评估，在PUMA两个赛道（15队）均获第6名，MILK10k（125队）获第31名，并展现出良好的跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的域泛化能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 开发竞争性的医学影像深度学习基线是一个高度迭代的过程，需要文献综述、实现、实验和专家改进，而现有自动化方法仅优化孤立组件（如架构搜索或超参数调优），无法覆盖完整的基线开发流程。

Method: 构建一个智能体AI科学家工作流，包含三个核心组件：文献引导推理（literature-guided reasoning）、自动代码生成（automated code generation）和假设驱动实验（hypothesis-driven experimentation），以端到端方式自动化基线模型开发。

Result: 在四个公开基准（覆盖分割、分类、检测）上，实验管道持续提升验证性能，取得竞争性排行榜成绩：PUMA两个赛道均获第6名（15队）、MILK10k获第31名（125队）；MIDOG25模型展示了跨扫描仪、肿瘤类型和物种的强域泛化能力。

Conclusion: 采用相同工作流且无需任务特定重新设计，即可在所有挑战中取得竞争性结果，证明基于技能和文献引导的智能体工作流能大幅减少开发竞争性医学影像基线所需的工程工作量。

Abstract: Developing competitive deep learning baselines for medical imaging remains a highly iterative process requiring literature review, implementation, experimentation, and expert refinement. Existing automation approaches typically optimize isolated components, such as architecture search or hyperparameter tuning, rather than the complete baseline development process. We present an agentic AI Scientist workflow that combines literature-guided reasoning, automated code generation, and hypothesis-driven experimentation to generate competitive baseline models for medical imaging challenges. The framework is evaluated on four public benchmarks spanning segmentation, classification, and detection. Across all tasks, the Experimentation Pipeline consistently improves validation performance, achieving competitive leaderboard results, including 6th place on both PUMA tracks (15 teams) and 31st place on MILK10k (125 teams). On MIDOG25, the resulting model also demonstrates strong domain generalization across scanners, tumor types, and species. Using the same workflow across all challenges without task-specific redesign, we demonstrate that skill-based, literature-guided agentic workflows can substantially reduce the engineering effort required to develop competitive medical imaging baselines.

</details>


### [171] [Controllable blind deblurring with diffusion models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23343)
*Imane Si Salah,Emile Cribelier,Thomas Veit,Wolf Hauser,Arthur Leclaire*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出SuperSharpen，一种基于扩散模型的盲去模糊方法，通过模糊度量实现恢复强度的显式控制，适用于专业摄影中的各向同性模糊去除。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 相机成像过程中会因光学系统、传感器或低级处理引入多种退化，特别是未知的各向同性模糊。在逆问题中，高频信息丢失使得生成模型难以在保持输入忠实性的同时产生逼真细节，需要在真实感与输入保真度之间取得平衡。

Method: 提出SuperSharpen扩散模型去模糊框架，通过模糊度量提供恢复强度的显式控制。比较两种条件化策略：在冻结主干网络上使用ControlNet风格适配器，以及对扩散先验进行全参数微调。

Result: 实验表明全参数微调相比ControlNet风格适配器能获得更好的保真度并减少幻觉细节；在合成和真实模糊数据上均验证了方法的有效性，展现出改进的感知质量和可控的恢复强度。

Conclusion: SuperSharpen通过可控的去模糊强度与扩散模型结合，在盲去模糊任务中实现了感知质量与输入忠实性的良好平衡，其中全微调策略优于冻结主干加适配器策略。

Abstract: Image acquisition with a camera involves several degradations due to the optical system, sensor, or low-level processing steps. We address blind deblurring in professional photography: we aim to invert unknown isotropic blur without knowledge of the degradation kernel.For such inverse problems,where some high-frequency information is lost, it is challenging to use generative models to produce details that are both photo-realistic and faithful to the input. We propose SuperSharpen, a diffusion-based blind deblurring method offering explicit control over restoration strength through a blur measure. We compare two conditioning strategies: a ControlNet-style adapter on a frozen backbone, and full finetuning of the diffusion prior. Our experiments show that finetuning achieves better fidelity with fewer hallucinated details. We validate our approach on synthetic and real-world blur, demonstrating improved perceptual quality and controllable restoration strength.

</details>


### [172] [DF-MoE: Generalizable Deepfake Detection via Multimodal Sparse Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23363)
*Vlad Hondru,Florinel Alin Croitoru,Iuliana Georgescu,A. Sophia Koepke,Radu Tudor Ionescu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出DF-MoE框架，通过集成多种预训练模型提取音频和视觉模态的多样化高层线索（如嘴部运动、面部解析、表情、头部姿态、注视追踪、心率、音频情绪和语音活动），并利用Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络融合单模态和多模态线索进行深度伪造检测。在五个基准数据集上的域内和跨域实验表明，DF-MoE优于所有现有最先进方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音视频深度伪造检测的主要挑战是开发能够跨伪造生成方法泛化的检测器，而现有的方法容易过拟合。作者推测可以通过从音频和视觉模态中提取多种高层线索来缓解过拟合问题。

Method: 1) 组装多种预训练模型来提取嘴部运动、面部解析、面部表情、头部姿态、注视追踪、心率、音频情绪和语音活动等多维特征；2) 通过Mixture-of-Experts（MoE）骨干网络集成单模态和多模态线索进行深度伪造检测。

Result: 在MAVOS-DD、AVLips、PolyGlotFake、BioDeepAV、FakeAVCeleb五个基准数据集上进行了域内和跨域实验，DF-MoE在深度伪造检测中取得了优于所有对比方法的性能。

Conclusion: DF-MoE通过多线索提取和MoE融合机制有效提升了深度伪造检测的准确性和泛化能力，超越了现有最先进方法，并开源了代码。

Abstract: Audio-visual deepfake detection is an actively studied topic, where one of the main challenges is to develop detectors able to generalize across deepfake generation methods. We conjecture that overfitting can be mitigated by extracting multiple high-level cues from the available audio and visual modalities via pre-trained models. We therefore assemble a wide variety of pre-trained models to extract features that encode mouth movements, face parsing, facial expressions, head pose, gaze tracking, heart rate, audio emotion and speech activity. We further integrate both unimodal and multimodal cues via a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) backbone to detect deepfakes. We perform in-domain and cross-domain experiments on five benchmarks for deepfake detection (MAVOS-DD, AVLips, PolyGlotFake, BioDeepAV, FakeAVCeleb) to compare our framework (DF-MoE) with state-of-the-art methods. Our results indicate that DF-MoE obtains superior deepfake detection results, surpassing all competing methods. We release our code at https://github.com/vladhondru25/DF-MoE.

</details>


### [173] [Long-Horizon Audio-Visual Generation for Persistent Stories and Interactive Worlds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23383)
*Nan Duan,Haoyang Huang,Weiyang Jin,Haoran Li,Yaowei Li,Yuming Li,Yijun Liu,Xin Lu,Xiaoxiao Ma,Yanwen Ma,Yaofeng Su,Yilang Sun,Haoyu Wang,Zeyue Xue,Songchun Zhang,Junhao Zhuang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: JoyAI-Echo-1.5是一个统一的音视频生成系统，包含长视频和世界模型两个变体，分别通过可组合跨镜头记忆和几何感知的6自由度相机控制实现长时程叙事与交互世界的生成，并采用渐进式教师强制和自梯度强制训练实现高效的长时程生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频生成正从独立短片向长篇叙事和交互式世界发展，现有模型难以在长时间生成中保持角色身份一致性、遵循用户控制并维持稳定性。

Method: 提出两个变体：(1) 长视频变体引入可组合跨镜头记忆，聚合多镜头视觉证据和基于语音过滤的说话人线索，保持角色外观和语音身份；(2) 世界模型变体将异构导航输入转换为校准的度量6自由度相机轨迹，通过几何感知条件通路注入，支持跨控制器的灵活视角交互。训练方面将双向音视频主干转换为因果少步生成器，采用渐进式教师强制和短/长时程自梯度强制。

Result: 长视频变体在跨镜头一致性、视觉质量、文本对齐和语音保真度上超越现有基线；世界模型变体在WBench上排名第一（平均81.7分），在SANA-WM-Bench上获得领先的视觉质量和长时程持续性。

Conclusion: 记忆、几何控制和滚动感知训练为生成连贯故事和持续演变的交互世界提供了实用基础。

Abstract: Video generation is progressing beyond isolated clips toward long-form narratives and interactive worlds, requiring models to preserve identities, follow user controls, and remain stable over extended rollouts. We present JoyAI-Echo-1.5, a unified audio-visual generation system with two purpose-built variants. The long-video variant introduces composable cross-shot memory that aggregates visual evidence across multiple prior shots and speaker cues derived from speech-filtered full-shot audio, enabling persistent character appearance and voice identity across flexible combinations of text, image, and memory conditioning. The world-model variant converts heterogeneous navigation inputs into calibrated metric 6-DoF camera trajectories and injects them through a geometry-aware conditioning pathway, enabling controller-agnostic interaction across flexible viewpoints. To support efficient long-horizon generation, we transform a bidirectional audio-visual backbone into a causal few-step generator using progressive teacher forcing and short- and long-horizon Self-Gradient Forcing on self-generated rollouts. Experiments demonstrate strong performance in both settings. JoyAI-Echo-1.5 achieves improvements over existing long-video baselines in cross-shot consistency, visual quality, text alignment, and speech fidelity. Its world-model variant ranks first on WBench, with an average score of 81.7, and achieves leading visual quality and long-horizon persistence on SANA-WM-Bench. Together, these results indicate that memory, geometric control, and rollout-aware training provide a practical foundation for generating coherent stories and continuously evolving interactive worlds. Project page: https://echo-team-joy-future-academy-jd.github.io/Echo-1.5-Page/.

</details>


### [174] [MomADv2: Reliable Temporal Memory for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23405)
*Ziying Song,Shengkai Zhang,Lin Liu,Peiliang Wu,Lei Yang,Dongyang Xu,Bin Sun,Li Wang,Shaoqing Xu,Caiyan Jia,Yadan Luo*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出MomADv2，一个可靠的状态空间记忆框架，用于长时域端到端自动驾驶规划。通过选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块过滤与当前驾驶指令不一致的历史信息，并引入流匹配轨迹残差精化器减少轨迹偏差和误差累积。实验表明在6秒规划下碰撞率较MomAD降低15.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长时域规划对安全自动驾驶至关重要，现有方法虽通过时间记忆提升规划连续性，但当驾驶指令变化时，历史记忆可能失效并误导决策。因此，如何选择性利用有用的历史信息、同时抑制与当前指令不一致的记忆，是亟需解决的关键挑战。

Method: 1) 提出选择性状态空间规划记忆查询模块：根据时间连续性和指令一致性过滤历史规划查询，选择与当前指令相关的规划模式，并通过选择性状态空间机制建模规划意图的演化。2) 设计流匹配轨迹残差精化器：学习从精化规划输出到专家轨迹的连续残差校正场，实现细粒度轨迹精化，同时保持基于锚点规划的稳定性。

Result: 在闭环NAVSIM和Bench2Drive以及开环nuScenes上进行了大量实验，MomADv2提升了长时域规划一致性，在6秒规划下平均碰撞率较MomAD降低了15.6%。

Conclusion: MomADv2通过选择性记忆机制和残差精化策略有效解决了驾驶指令变化时历史记忆失效的问题，显著提升了长时域自动驾驶规划的可靠性和安全性。

Abstract: Long-horizon planning is critical for safe autonomous driving in complex scenarios. Existing methods improve planning continuity with temporal memory, but such memory may become invalid and mislead decisions when the driving command changes. Thus, selectively leveraging useful history while suppressing command-inconsistent memory remains a key challenge. To address this issue, we propose MomADv2, a reliable state-space memory framework for long-horizon end-to-end autonomous driving. At its core, MomADv2 introduces a Selective State-Space Planning Memory Query Module, which filters historical planning queries based on temporal continuity and command consistency, selects planning modes relevant to the current command, and models the evolution of planning intentions through a selective state-space mechanism. To further alleviate local trajectory deviations and error accumulation in long-horizon planning, we design a Flow-Matching Trajectory Residual Refiner. It learns a continuous residual correction field from the refined planning output to the expert trajectory, enabling fine-grained trajectory refinement while preserving the stability of anchor-based planning. Extensive experiments on closed-loop NAVSIM and Bench2Drive, as well as open-loop nuScenes, demonstrate that MomADv2 improves long-horizon planning consistency and reduces the average collision rate by 15.6% over MomAD under 6-second planning.

</details>


### [175] [Photorealistic Novel View Synthesis of Human Faces using Next-Scale Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23410)
*Federico Stella,Fei Jiang,Zhongshi Jiang,Zohar Barzelay,Emanuel Garbin,Amin Jourabloo,Liuhao Ge*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于"下一尺度自回归"（next-scale autoregressive）范式的人像新视角合成方法。该方法支持高分辨率、多视角输出和跨视角一致性，在合成人脸数据集上训练，无需2D预训练，仅需较少的任务特定数据即可收敛，并能与3D高斯提升模型结合生成逼真的3D人脸模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高分辨率、多目标相机条件下的人像新视角合成仍然充满挑战，关键在于保持身份、细节和几何一致性。现有扩散模型需要2D预训练且数据需求大，作者希望探索更高效的自回归范式来解决这一问题。

Method: 1) 构建在下一尺度自回归范式之上，扩展至高分辨率、多视角输出和跨视角一致性；2) 利用低分辨率通用预训练，仅在最后训练阶段使用高分辨率任务特定数据，从而减少任务数据需求；3) 在合成人脸数据集（多样身份和服饰）上训练；4) 与基于Transformer的像素对齐3D高斯提升模型耦合，生成3D人脸。

Result: 实验表明该方法在人像感知保真度和跨视角一致性上取得提升，生成锐利逼真的视图，支持同步合成多个新视角，并能与3D高斯模型结合重建准确且逼真的人脸3D模型。

Conclusion: 下一尺度自回归是一种高效且可扩展的多输出人像视角合成骨干框架，在数据效率上优于扩散模型，并能支持3D重建下游任务。

Abstract: Photorealistic novel view synthesis of people remains challenging at high spatial resolutions and across multiple target cameras, where preserving identity, fine appearance details, and geometric coherence is critical. We build on the next-scale autoregressive paradigm and adapt it for human-centric view synthesis by enabling higher image resolutions, multi-view outputs and stronger cross-view consistency in a single forward pass. We train on a synthetic dataset of human faces spanning diverse identities and apparel. Contrary to diffusion models, this paradigm does not need 2D pre-training and, thanks to its next-scale architecture, it benefits from lower-resolution, general-purpose pre-trainings, with the full-sized purpose-specific images being used only in the last training stages. This enables our architecture to converge with a smaller amount of purpose-specific training data, allowing us to use a smaller but more realistic training dataset. The resulting model produces sharp and realistic views, with the option to synthesize multiple novel viewpoints simultaneously for improved agreement across views. Empirically, we observe gains in perceptual fidelity and cross-view coherence on human subjects, demonstrating that next-scale autoregression is an effective backbone for scalable, multi-output human view synthesis. We also couple our pipeline with an existing transformer-based model for pixel-aligned 3D gaussian lifting from multi-view facial inputs, resulting in accurate and photorealistic 3D models of human faces.

</details>


### [176] [Image-Conditioned Diffusion Models for Quality Assurance of Organ-at-Risk Segmentations in Radiotherapy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23432)
*Clea Dronne,Catharine H Clark,Xavier Loizeau,Elizabeth Miles,Peter Hoskin,Jamie R McClelland*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究了用于头颈部CT放疗中器官危及器官（OAR）分割错误检测的规范建模方法，比较了VAE框架与图像条件分割扩散模型的性能。在RADCURE数据集上通过模拟边界和宽度扰动进行评估，结果表明扩散模型在定位细微边界错误方面表现更稳定，支持其作为分割质量保证（QA）的有效框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 放疗规划中器官分割的准确性至关重要，但人工审查分割结果既耗时又主观。现有方法缺乏自动化的、解剖学感知的错误检测手段，需要更可靠的计算框架来辅助分割质量保证。

Method: 比较两种规范建模框架：(1) VAE框架；(2) 图像条件分割扩散模型。在RADCURE数据集上对脑干和脊髓分割进行测试，通过模拟边界扰动和宽度扰动生成错误，使用Dice相似系数和Distance to Agreement (DTA)评估输入与重建分割之间的差异来检测错误。

Result: 两种模型都能检测到部分模拟错误，但通过区域DTA评估发现，扩散模型在定位细微边界错误方面表现更加一致和稳定。

Conclusion: 图像条件扩散重建是一种有前景的框架，能够实现局部的、解剖学感知的分割质量保证，优于传统VAE方法。

Abstract: Accurate organ-at-risk segmentation is essential for radiotherapy planning, but reviewing segmentations is time-consuming and subjective. We investigate normative modelling for segmentation error detection in head-and-neck CT, comparing a VAE framework with an image-conditioned segmentation diffusion model. Models were evaluated on RADCURE brainstem and spinal cord segmentations using simulated boundary and width perturbations. Error detection was assessed using the Dice similarity coefficient and the Distance to Agreement (DTA) between the input and reconstructed segmentations. While both models detected some simulated errors, regional DTA showed that the diffusion model localised subtle boundary errors more consistently. These results support image-conditioned diffusion reconstruction as a promising framework for localised, anatomy-aware segmentation QA.

</details>


### [177] [Towards Comprehensive Basketball Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23435)
*Yirong Hu,Jiayuan Rao,Yu Zhang,Shangzhe Di,Weidi Xie*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出了BasketballBench，一个包含7,980个问题、涵盖文本/图像/视频十项任务的篮球多模态基准，并提出了BasketballSkills智能体，通过组合八种篮球感知与检索工具（四种可复用技能）来提升篮球比赛的全面理解能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基准大多单独评估比赛识别、动作定位、球员识别或结构化知识关联等能力，缺乏对这些能力之间交互作用的深入探索，无法全面衡量多模态大语言模型(MLLM)对篮球比赛的综合性理解。

Method: 构建BasketballBench基准（基于2025-2026 NBA赛季的官方play-by-play数据、530名球员名册与资料、2,501个控球级转播片段），并提出BasketballSkills智能体，将八种篮球专用感知与检索工具组合为四种可复用技能，技能中明确规定了工具调用顺序、证据绑定和停止条件。

Result: 实验表明，当前MLLM在需要多种能力整合的问题上表现尤其困难，而BasketballSkills在这些任务上优于现有MLLM，验证了显式组合领域专用能力的有效性。

Conclusion: 显式地组合领域专用能力对于实现全面的篮球比赛理解是有效且必要的，为多模态体育理解提供了新的基准和智能体范式的启示。

Abstract: Understanding a basketball game requires recognizing events, localizing actions, identifying players, and relating these to structured game knowledge. Existing benchmarks primarily evaluate these abilities one at a time, leaving the interactions among these abilities under-explored. We introduce BasketballBench, a multimodal benchmark comprising 7,980 questions across ten tasks in text, image, and video. It is built from the 2025-2026 NBA season and includes official playby-play, rosters and profiles for 530 active players, and 2,501 possession-level broadcast clips. We further propose BasketballSkills, an agent that composes eight basketball-specific perception and retrieval tools under four reusable skills that specify tool order, evidence bindings, and stopping conditions. Experiments show that current MLLMs struggle particularly on questions requiring the integration of multiple capabilities, whereas BasketballSkills outperforms them, highlighting the effectiveness of explicitly composing domain-specific capabilities for comprehensive basketball understanding.

</details>


### [178] [Geometry-Driven Opti-Acoustic Co-Registration and View-Invariant Reflectivity Mapping for Side-Scan Sonar](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23479)
*Taqi Hamoda,Nuno Gracias*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于几何驱动的框架，用于侧扫声呐(Side-Scan Sonar)与光学图像的像素级跨模态配准。该方法利用SfM重建海底三维网格作为几何锚点，通过首次海底回波(FBR)提取算法校正高度漂移，并采用逆朗伯模型和双高斯权重函数分离固有海底反射率，最终实现严格的跨模态配准和视点不变的反射率映射。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 侧扫声呐是海底大规模测绘的主要手段，但声学成像中的斑点噪声、阴影和极端视点依赖性严重制约了自动化感知和跨模态对齐。传统手工特征描述子和现代深度学习匹配器无法在没有3D几何约束的情况下弥合光学与声学图像之间的物理域差距。

Method: 1) 利用SfM从光学图像重建稠密3D海底网格，作为视觉域与声学域之间的几何锚点；2) 提出首海底回波(FBR)提取算法，动态校正未标定SfM重建引起的非线性高度漂移；3) 应用逆朗伯模型和双高斯加权函数，隔离固有海底反射率，中和斜距传播损耗和几何视点依赖性；4) 将隔离后的声学属性与光学像素确定性关联，生成严格共配准的多模态数据集。

Result: 该方法能够生成高精度、严格共配准的多模态数据集，实现自动化、物理引导的跨模态配准，无需人工标注。

Conclusion: 该自动化、物理引导的方法消除对手动标注的需求，为底栖生境测绘中的高级自监督学习铺平道路。

Abstract: Side-Scan Sonar (SSS) is a primary modality for large-scale underwater mapping, yet automated perception and cross-modal alignment are severely bottlenecked by acoustic complexities such as speckle noise, shadows, and extreme viewpoint dependencies. Traditional handcrafted descriptors and modern deep learning matchers fail to bridge the physical domain gap between optical and acoustic imagery without 3D geometric constraints. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel geometry-driven framework for pixel-level opti-acoustic co-registration and view-invariant reflectivity mapping. Our method utilizes Structure-from-Motion (SfM) to reconstruct a dense 3D seafloor mesh, acting as a geometric anchor between the visual and acoustic domains. We introduce a First Bottom Return (FBR) extraction algorithm to dynamically correct non-linear altitude drift caused by uncalibrated SfM reconstruction. Furthermore, we apply an inverse Lambertian model and a dual-Gaussian weighting function to isolate the intrinsic seabed reflectivity, effectively neutralizing slant-range propagation loss and geometric view-dependence. By deterministically associating these isolated acoustic properties with optical pixels, our pipeline generates highly accurate, strictly co-registered multi-modal datasets. This automated, physics-guided approach eliminates the need for manual annotation and paves the way for advanced self-supervised learning in benthic habitat mapping.

</details>


### [179] [GeoWAM: Visual Geometry World Action Models for Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23486)
*Yiren Lu,Xin Ye,Jiaming Liu,Jin Yao,Yi-chung Chen,Liam Merino,Dhruva Dixith Kurra,Min Cai,Tom Lampo,Yu Yin,Danhua Guo,Burhan Yaman*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: GeoWAM是一种面向自动驾驶的视觉几何世界动作模型，通过预测未来场景的点云几何而非像素图像来学习场景演化，并利用几何条件化动作头预测未来自车轨迹，在开环和闭环评估中均优于基于图像的替代方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）主要在像素空间学习场景动力学，但像素将几何、运动与外观、纹理、光照纠缠在一起，迫使模型从二维观测中推断三维变换。作者认为点云表示的几何是驾驶更自然的状态空间，因为它显式捕获空间结构和刚体/非刚体变换，且与驾驶动作执行空间直接对齐。

Method: GeoWAM采用视觉几何世界动作模型范式：预训练阶段预测未来场景几何（点云）而非未来图像，从而获得同时编码空间结构与时序演化的表征；随后通过几何条件化动作头，利用学到的几何动力学预测未来自车轨迹。

Result: 广泛的开环和闭环评估表明，视觉几何世界建模相比基于图像的替代方案能产生显著更强的驾驶策略，确立了未来几何预测作为自动驾驶有效预训练目标的有效性。

Conclusion: 未来场景几何预测是自动驾驶中优于像素预测的预训练目标，GeoWAM证明了基于几何的状态空间能够更自然地建模驾驶动力学并提升驾驶策略质量。

Abstract: World action models (WAMs) have recently gained increasing attention as a framework for jointly modeling scene evolution and ego actions in autonomous driving. Most existing WAMs learn scene dynamics in pixel space by combining a video-generation backbone for future-observation prediction with an action head for ego-trajectory prediction. Pixels, however, provide only an indirect representation of these dynamics: they entangle geometry and motion with appearance, texture, and illumination, forcing the model to infer three-dimensional transformations from two-dimensional observations. We argue that geometry, represented by point clouds, offers a more natural state space for driving because it explicitly captures spatial structure and the rigid and non-rigid transformations that govern scene evolution while directly aligning with the space in which driving actions are executed. Building on this insight, we introduce \textbf{GeoWAM}, a visual geometry world action model for autonomous driving. Rather than predicting future images, GeoWAM is pretrained to forecast future scene geometry, yielding representations that jointly encode spatial structure and temporal evolution. A geometry-conditioned action head then leverages these learned geometric dynamics to predict future ego trajectories. Extensive open-loop and closed-loop evaluations show that visual geometry world modeling yields substantially stronger driving policies than image-based alternatives, establishing future-geometry prediction as an effective pretraining objective for autonomous driving.

</details>


### [180] [SVD-Based Typicality Maps for Out-of-Distribution Detection in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23499)
*Aldo Sean Sartor,Leandro de Souza Rosa,Andriy Enttsel,Mauro Mangia,Riccardo Rovatti*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种利用Vision Transformer (ViT)内部参数几何结构来分析其内部表征的方法。通过SVD分解仿射层权重矩阵，将激活投影到主要右奇异向量上，获得紧凑的层级内在表征。在每个层上拟合类条件密度模型，生成"典型性图谱"(typicality maps)，并从中衍生出两种无需训练或OOD数据暴露的后验OOD检测分数：原型对齐分数(PAS)和多层软投票分数(MLSV)。在CIFAR-100上微调的ViT-B/16上取得了有竞争力的检测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 旨在理解ViT内部表征如何编码类别信息，并利用这种理解进行高效的OOD检测，无需重新训练模型或接触OOD样本。

Method: 1) 对每个仿射层权重矩阵进行SVD分解；2) 将激活投影到前导右奇异向量获得紧凑的层内表征；3) 每层拟合类条件密度模型，生成每类的典型性分数；4) 跨层堆叠形成典型性图谱；5) 从图谱中提取两种OOD检测分数：PAS（与类别原型模式对齐）和MLSV（跨层共识投票）。

Result: 在ViT-B/16 (CIFAR-100微调)上，所提出的PAS和MLSV分数在无需重训练或OOD数据暴露的情况下，达到了有竞争力的OOD检测性能。

Conclusion: 利用ViT参数的内在几何结构可以有效分析内部表征并用于OOD检测，且无需额外的训练开销或OOD数据。

Abstract: We present a method for analyzing the internal representations of Vision Transformers (ViTs) exploiting the geometry of their learned parameters. Each affine layer's weight matrix is factored via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), and activations are projected onto the leading right singular vectors to obtain compact, layer-intrinsic representations.
