### [421] [From Detrimental to Beneficial: Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22522)
*Adrian Nyakairu,Hongfu Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: DIVE是一个新颖的数据估值与编辑框架，在批次级别动态估计样本价值，并通过在优化层面反转有害样本的梯度方向，将有害数据转化为有益贡献，从而提升分类性能、数据效率与优化稳定性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据估值研究主要关注如何分类训练样本的有益性或有害性，但对估值结果进行后续数据干预的探索不足。传统方法通常直接丢弃或降低有害样本权重，导致数据资源未充分利用。

Method: DIVE在批次级别动态估计样本价值，同时不修改原始数据，而是在优化层面通过策略性地反转有害样本的梯度方向，将有害样本转化为有益贡献，与标准训练流程无缝集成，开销极小。

Result: 大量实验表明DIVE能持续提升分类性能、最大化数据效率、稳定优化过程，并有效推广到大语言模型微调任务中。

Conclusion: DIVE证明了有害训练样本不必被简单地丢弃或降权，通过梯度反转的策略可以在优化层面将它们转化为有价值的数据贡献，为数据估值与干预提供了一个高效且可扩展的新方向。

Abstract: Data valuation is a cornerstone of data-centric learning, where prior efforts primarily focus on designing algorithms to classify training samples as either beneficial or detrimental for the learning task. However, leveraging these valuation estimates for subsequent data intervention remains underexplored; conventional approaches typically discard or downweight harmful samples, thereby underutilizing available data resources. In this paper, we present Dynamic Influence-based Valuation and Editing (DIVE), a novel and efficient framework that dynamically estimates sample values at the batch level and transforms detrimental data into beneficial contributions. Rather than altering the raw data, DIVE operates at the optimization level by strategically reversing the gradient directions of harmful samples during training, ensuring seamless integration with standard learning procedures with minimal overhead. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that DIVE consistently improves classification performance, maximizes data efficiency, stabilizes optimization, and effectively generalizes to large language model fine-tuning.

</details>


### [422] [Stress Testing Unlearning Algorithms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22527)
*Noam Diamant,Ethan Fetaya,Neta Glazer*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了WMDP++基准，它是WMDP的扩展版本，针对大语言模型机器遗忘评估中的两个关键缺陷进行改进：(1)主动测试遗忘信息是否仍可被强制提取；(2)评估模型在边界问题（与遗忘内容语义相近的良性查询）上的性能保持。该基准为LLM遗忘提供了更严格和信息量更大的评估框架。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的机器遗忘基准存在两个关键不足：一是没有主动测试遗忘信息是否仍能被强制提取，二是没有评估边界问题上的性能保持（即与遗忘内容语义接近但属良性的查询）。这些缺陷导致对LLM遗忘的安全性和实用性评估不够全面。

Method: WMDP++作为WMDP的扩展，通过两个核心策略解决上述问题：(1)设计针对性的遗忘信息提取测试，主动尝试强制提取已遗忘的信息；(2)系统性地构建和评估边界问题，这类问题与遗忘内容在语义上相近但属于良性查询，用以衡量模型在遗忘过程中的性能保持程度。

Result: WMDP++构建了一个比WMDP更严格、信息量更大的基准，能够更全面地反映LLM在安全性和实用性方面的遗忘表现，包括信息被强制提取的抵抗能力以及边界问题上的性能保持。

Conclusion: WMDP++弥补了现有遗忘基准在强制提取测试和边界问题评估方面的空白，为LLM机器遗忘方法提供了更具说服力和区分度的评测工具，有望推动遗忘方法在安全性与实用性之间的更好平衡。

Abstract: Recently, machine unlearning, the removal of specific training data influence from a model, has gained increasing attention. In large language models (LLMs), unlearning is particularly challenging due to the ambiguity of inputs and outputs. Con- sequently, rigorous evaluation is critical for assessing both safety and utility, and for driving progress in unlearning meth- ods. We identify two key shortcomings in existing unlearning benchmarks: (1) they do not actively test whether unlearned information can still be forcibly extracted, and (2) they fail to evaluate performance preservation on boundary questions, be- nign queries that are semantically close to the unlearned con- tent. Here we introduce WMDP++, an extension of WMDP that addresses these gaps by incorporating targeted extrac- tion of unlearned information and systematic evaluation on boundary questions. WMDP++ provides a more stringent and informative benchmark for evaluating unlearning in LLMs.

</details>


### [423] [BLADE: Bilevel Low-rank Augmented-Lagrangian Erasure for LLM Unlearning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22557)
*Md Toufikuzzaman,Ahmad Mousavi,Dongwon Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出BLADE，一个约束双层优化框架，通过钳制熵遗忘损失、非对称增广拉格朗日乘子以及仅限LoRA适配器的双层结构，实现平滑可控的大语言模型遗忘优化，在多个基准上提升6%-9%的复合分数，并在4倍缩放和4次连续遗忘下保持稳定。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM遗忘方法缺乏鲁棒性：无界遗忘损失导致模型连贯性退化；固定权重平衡无法适应训练中保持难度变化；在特定基准上有效的方法在缩放或重复应用时失效。

Method: 提出BLADE约束双层框架，包含三个机制：(1) 钳制熵遗忘损失，当token达到足够不确定性时梯度精确归零；(2) 非对称增广拉格朗日，在任何违反后永久提高保持保护；(3) 仅限LoRA适配器的双层结构，在每次遗忘步骤前修复保持损伤。

Result: 在三个基准家族上全面占优：TOFU平均复合分数提升6%，MUSE Books提升9%，KnowUndo提升7%；在MUSE News上，4倍缩放和4次连续遗忘步骤下仍保持稳定，而最强竞争方法完全崩溃。

Conclusion: BLADE通过约束双层框架解决了LLM遗忘的鲁棒性问题，证明该方法在不同基准、规模扩展和重复应用中均能保持稳定性能，优于现有最强基线。

Abstract: Existing LLM unlearning methods struggle with robustness: unbounded forget losses degrade model coherence, fixed-weight balancing cannot adapt as retain difficulty shifts mid-training, and methods that work on one benchmark falter under scaling or repeated application. We propose BLADE, a constrained bilevel framework whose three mechanisms give smooth, predictable control over the optimization landscape: a clamped-entropy forget loss whose gradient is exactly zero once a token reaches sufficient uncertainty; an asymmetric augmented Lagrangian that permanently ratchets retain protection after any violation; and a bilevel structure confined to LoRA adapters that repairs retain damage before each forgetting step. BLADE dominates across three benchmark families, improving average composite scores over the strongest baselines by $6$% on TOFU, $9$% on MUSE Books, and $7$% on KnowUndo, and it remains stable under $4\times$ scaling and $4$ sequential unlearning steps on MUSE News where the best competing method collapses entirely.

</details>


### [424] [Clinical Graph-JEPA: Predictive Patient-State Knowledge Graphs for Cognitive Decision Support](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22583)
*Kushagra Yadav,Nalin Prabhath,Amit Lamba,Goeun Han,Yining Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个临床知识图谱构建与精炼框架，结合多智能体关系提案、本体感知归一化、确定性证据评分和JEPA潜在空间精炼，将临床知识图谱视为预测性患者状态表征而非静态提取产物。实验表明，在相同队列和评估协议下，实体锚定的出院小结注记注入可将留一法的MRR相对提升31%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床记录中包含丰富的患者状态证据，但将其转化为可靠的结构化知识图谱面临诸多挑战：提取错误、本体不匹配、关系缺失和时间歧义等问题会传播到下游系统。现有方法将临床知识图谱视为静态提取产物，缺乏对图谱质量的精炼机制。

Method: 该框架包含四个核心组件：1) 多智能体关系提案机制用于提出候选临床关系；2) 本体感知的归一化处理以解决本体匹配问题；3) 确定性证据评分用于评估关系可靠性；4) JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）基于潜在空间精炼，将知识图谱视为预测性患者状态表征。框架从MIMIC-IV结构化记录构建证据评分图，并学习从未标注的图上下文中恢复被略去的临床关系。评估采用无泄漏的留一法边恢复和批量掩码评估，并对比无注记注入与有注记注入两种配置。

Result: 在相同队列和评估协议下，仅向注记实体注入真实出院小结表征的配置相比无注记配置，在留一法边恢复任务中MRR实现了31%的相对提升，验证了出院小结上下文对知识图谱精炼的重要贡献。

Conclusion: 将临床知识图谱视为预测性患者状态表征而非静态提取产物是有效的，且出院小结注记的实体锚定注入能够显著提升图谱精炼性能，为临床知识图谱构建提供了一种更可靠的新范式。

Abstract: Clinical records contain rich evidence about patient state, but converting that evidence into reliable, structured knowledge graphs remains difficult because extraction errors, ontology mismatch, missing relations, and temporal ambiguity can propagate into downstream systems. We propose a clinical knowledge graph construction and refinement framework that combines multi-agent relation proposal, ontology-aware normalization, deterministic evidence scoring, and JEPA-based latent refinement. Rather than treating a clinical knowledge graph as a static extraction artifact, we treat it as a predictive patient-state representation. For each admission, the system constructs an evidence-scored graph from structured MIMIC-IV records and inferred clinical cross-links, then learns to recover held-out clinical relations from the observed graph context. We evaluate the refiner with leakage-free leave-one-out edge recovery (MRR and Hits@k) and held-out batch-mask evaluation (AUC and MRR). To isolate the contribution of discharge-note context, we compare a note-embedding-free configuration with a note-augmented configuration that injects real discharge-note representations only into note-grounded entities. Under the same cohort and evaluation protocol, entity-grounded note injection improves overall leave-one-out MRR by 31% relative improvement.

</details>


### [425] [GCA: Global Centroid Alignment in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22593)
*Jong-Ik Park,Harry Jiang,Logan Blakely,Georgios Fragkos,Shamina Hossain-McKenzie,Carlee Joe-Wong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出了一种名为Global Centroid Alignment (GCA)的联邦学习协议，通过潜在代码作为媒介而非传输自编码器参数或梯度，实现客户端之间的协调，大幅降低通信开销并增强对训练数据提取攻击的防御能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于自编码器的联邦学习在客户端本地数据有限时对异常检测很有吸引力，但传统联邦学习交换AE参数或梯度会产生显著通信开销，且由于AE被优化为重构输入，可能暴露训练数据信息，存在隐私泄露风险。

Method: GCA协议每轮包含三步：(1)客户端使用重构更新训练本地AE并上传少量编码器潜在代码；(2)服务器池化这些代码，拟合聚类模型，仅广播全局潜在质心及其支持计数；(3)每个客户端通过将本地潜在代码与最近质心对齐来更新编码器，使用逆计数权重强调全局代表性不足的模式。通信成本取决于潜在维度和上传代码数/返回质心数，而非AE模型大小。

Result: 在5个表格和2个视觉基准上，GCA在全部21个对比中比FedAvg、FedProx和FedNova获得更高的重构误差（更难被提取攻击）和更低的余弦相似度（20/21），防御能力与DP-FedAvg相当，测试准确率最高提升5.76%，每轮通信量最高降低99.15%。

Conclusion: GCA通过潜在代码中介的通信机制，同时解决了传统联邦自编码器学习中的通信开销和数据隐私问题，是一种高效且安全的联邦异常检测方案。

Abstract: Autoencoder (AE)-based federated learning (FL) is attractive for anomaly detection when clients have limited local data. However, conventional FL exchanges AE parameters or gradients, incurring substantial communication overhead and potentially exposing input training data information, since AEs are explicitly optimized to reconstruct their inputs. We introduce \emph{Global Centroid Alignment (GCA)}, a latent-code-mediated FL protocol that coordinates clients without transmitting AE parameters or gradients. In each round, (1) clients first train their local AEs using a \emph{reconstruction} update and upload a small subset of encoder latent codes to the FL server. (2) The server pools these codes, fits a clustering model, and broadcasts only \emph{global latent centroids and their support counts}. (3) Each client then updates its encoder by aligning its local latent codes with the \emph{nearest} centroid using \emph{inverse-count} weighting to emphasize globally underrepresented patterns. Steps (1)--(3) repeat over communication rounds. Because GCA exchanges only sampled latent codes and centroid statistics, its communication cost depends on latent dimensionality and the numbers of uploaded codes and returned centroids rather than on AE model size. Across five tabular and two vision benchmarks, GCA yields higher reconstruction error under a server-side client data extraction attack in all 21 comparisons and clearly lower cosine similarity in 20 of 21 comparisons with FedAvg, FedProx, and FedNova, showing its ability to protect training data. It even improves test accuracy over FedAvg by up to $5.76\%$. GCA achieves extraction defense comparable to DP-FedAvg, remains effective when DP-FedAvg does not reduce target resemblance, and lowers per-round communication by up to $99.15\%$.

</details>


### [426] [Tabular foundation models for non-tabular tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22594)
*Goran Nakerst,John Brennan,Wouter Beugeling,Masudul Haque*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文探讨了表格基础模型(TabPFN v3)能否超越传统表格任务，应用于非表格分类问题。作者将MNIST手写数字识别、法德单词语言识别和Tiny ImageNet图像分类这三个问题转化为表格形式，通过预测缺失标签进行分类，在无额外训练/微调的情况下，TabPFN v3在某些任务上取得了与专门方法相当甚至接近的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 表格基础模型(TFM)被认为是表格数据机器学习的新范式，能够跨数据集泛化而无需任务特定训练。由于许多机器学习数据集都可以表示为表格，一个自然的问题是：TFM的能力是否能够扩展到传统上不被视为表格的任务？这个问题对于理解TFM的适用范围和边界具有重要意义。

Method: 使用TabPFN v3处理三个非表格分类问题：(1) MNIST手写数字识别；(2) 法德单词语言识别；(3) Tiny ImageNet图像分类。将原始数据表示为表格行，分类被表述为预测缺失标签。评估性能随上下文样本数量变化的函数，不对模型进行额外训练或微调。

Result: 尽管TabPFN v3无法显式访问数据中蕴含的空间或序列结构，但在某些情况下其准确率可与专门针对相应任务设计的模型或方法相媲美。

Conclusion: 表格基础模型的能力可以扩展到传统表格任务之外，即使在没有显式结构信息的情况下也能在图像和文本等非表格任务上展现竞争力，这为理解TFM的泛化能力和应用边界提供了新的视角。

Abstract: Tabular foundation models (TFMs) have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for machine learning on tabular data, offering the ability to generalize across datasets without task-specific training. Since many machine learning datasets can be represented as tables, this raises the question: does TFM capability extend beyond tasks traditionally regarded as tabular? We address this question by using TabPFN v3 on three non-tabular classification problems: handwritten digit recognition on MNIST, language identification of French and German words, and image classification on Tiny ImageNet. In each case, the original data are represented as rows of a table and classification is formulated as prediction of a missing label. We evaluate performance as a function of the number of context samples provided to the pretrained model, with no additional training or fine-tuning. Despite having no explicit access to the spatial or sequential structure characterizing the data, TabPFN v3 in some cases achieves accuracies comparable with that of models or methods geared specifically toward the corresponding tasks.

</details>


### [427] [Adversarial Agents on Topology Optimization: Understanding the Fragility and Robustness of Deep Learning-based and Physics-Based Design Models under Adversarial Perturbation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22606)
*Hoang Anh Nguyen,Yuan Hong,Hongyi Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于力学原理的可靠性评估框架，通过对抗性代理攻击深度学习拓扑优化代理模型。研究发现，仅对初始密度通道引入有界扰动，即可使代理模型生成的拓扑结构发生灾难性力学失效（柔度增加多个数量级）。此外，更丰富的物理梯度条件并不能保证代理家族的鲁棒性单调提升。物理在环的恢复实验表明，用扰动拓扑初始化经典SIMP优化器可缓解性能退化。结论是学习代理应作为物理验证的初始化器，而非完全替代物理求解器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习代理模型在拓扑优化中因生成速度快而被广泛采用，但其在输入扰动下的脆弱性尚未被系统评估。本文旨在揭示这些代理模型的安全隐患，为网络制造系统中弹性生成设计代理的可靠性提供保障。

Method: 提出了一个力学基础的可靠性评估框架，构建对抗性代理攻击生成设计模型。采用严格非侵入式威胁模型：仅向初始密度通道注入有界扰动，保持物理边界条件、柔度梯度通道、网络架构和求解器不变。在U-Net、卷积和生成式架构上评估不同物理梯度条件深度的代理模型，并进行物理在环的SIMP优化器恢复实验。

Result: 1) 有界初始化噪声可导致灾难性力学失效，柔度增加多个数量级，表现为载荷路径断裂和支撑断开。2) 更丰富的物理梯度条件并不保证跨代理家族鲁棒性的单调提升。3) 物理在环恢复实验中，用扰动拓扑初始化SIMP优化器可高概率将柔度恢复到接近基线水平。

Conclusion: 学习代理模型应作为物理验证的初始化器而非完全替代物理求解器，以构建弹性的网络制造系统。提出的对抗性攻击代理为未来训练抗噪和抗针对性扰动的生成设计代理奠定了基础。

Abstract: Topology optimization, using both physic-based approaches and deep learning surrogates, serves as a cornerstone for generative design agents in cyber-manufacturing systems. While deep learning surrogates have gained widespread adoption due to their speed in online design generation, this work demonstrates their vulnerability under input perturbations. In this work, we present a mechanics-grounded reliability evaluation framework that formulates an adversarial agent targeting the generative design models. We investigate a strictly non-intrusive threat model where bounded perturbations are introduced exclusively to the initial-density channel, while physical boundary conditions, compliance-gradient channels, network architectures, and solver routines remain intact. Evaluating surrogate models across U-Net, convolutional, and generative architectures with varying physics-gradient conditioning depths demonstrates that bounded initialization noise can cause catastrophic mechanical failure, increasing compliance by multiple orders of magnitude through severed load paths and disconnected supports. Furthermore, we discover that incorporating richer physics-gradient conditioning in the deep learning surrogates does not guarantee monotonic robustness across surrogate families. Finally, physics-in-the-loop recovery demonstrates that initializing the classical SIMP optimizer with perturbed topologies mitigates design performance degradation, having a high probability of restoring compliance to near-baseline levels across tested instances. These findings demonstrate that learned surrogates should serve as physics-verified initializers instead of replacing physics-based solvers entirely in a resilient cyber-manufacturing system. Moreover, the proposed adversarial agent provides a foundation for future training generative design agents robust against noise and targeted perturbations.

</details>


### [428] [Mitigating Explanation Leakage in Financial Fraud Detection Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22607)
*Muhammad Waleed Gul,Elaheh Homayounvala*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DP-FedSHAP架构，在联邦学习中仅对TreeSHAP解释向量应用客户端级差分隐私，以抵御成员推理攻击（MIA），并对比了权重级DP基线在欺诈检测场景下的隐私-保真度-性能权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统集中式欺诈检测模型存在数据隐私风险；联邦学习虽分散了数据处理，但金融监管要求模型透明（需XAI工具如TreeSHAP），而共享高保真SHAP解释会使联邦网络暴露于成员推理攻击之下，存在隐私泄露隐患。

Method: 提出DP-FedSHAP架构，仅对post-hoc TreeSHAP向量应用客户端级差分隐私；同时设置Weight-Level DP基线（直接扰动训练后的模型）进行对比实验，使用高度不平衡的IEEE-CIS欺诈检测数据集进行评估。

Result: 测量了DP-FedSHAP与Weight-Level DP基线在解释保真度、隐私保护程度以及AUPRC（精确率-召回率曲线下面积）三者之间的权衡关系。

Conclusion: DP-FedSHAP提供了一种在联邦学习框架下兼顾模型可解释性、隐私安全与欺诈检测性能的可行方案，为金融欺诈检测中的隐私保护与透明性冲突提供了解决方案。

Abstract: Financial fraud detection relies heavily on centralized machine learning models. This creates serious data privacy risks. Federated Learning (FL) decentralizes data processing, but financial regulations still require models to be transparent. This means using Explainable AI (XAI) tools such as TreeSHAP. Recent cybersecurity research shows a problem with this approach. Sharing high-fidelity SHAP explanations exposes the federated network to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs). This dissertation proposes and evaluates DP-FedSHAP. It is a new architecture that applies client-level differential privacy only to post-hoc TreeSHAP vectors. It is compared against a Weight-Level DP baseline, which perturbs the trained model directly instead. Using the highly imbalanced IEEE-CIS Fraud Detection dataset, this study measures the trade-off between explanation fidelity, privacy preservation, and the model's Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC).

</details>


### [429] [What AstroPT knows about galaxies, and what that can teach us about LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22614)
*UniverseTBD,:,Kshitij Duraphe,Aman Kumar,Michael J. Smith,Shashwat Sourav*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用天文学数据（AstroPT，基于数百万张星系图像训练的Transformer）作为校准测试平台，来验证语言模型可解释性研究中的概念涌现顺序和线性探针恢复结构的主张。研究发现星系属性按已知难度顺序涌现——直接编码在像素中的属性（如波段星等）早训练浅层即可解码，而推断属性（如红移、恒星形成率）较晚较深层才涌现，且该顺序对不同训练目标不变，随模型容量在幅度上缩放而非顺序上改变。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型中的可解释性主张（如概念何时涌现、线性探针是否恢复真实结构）难以验证，因为语言缺乏概念间的地面真值排序和关系。需要一个具有已知概念难度排序和关系的领域作为校准测试床。

Method: 使用AstroPT（在数百万星系图像上训练的Transformer），在检查点、层、模型大小和训练目标等多个维度上探测冻结表示。通过线性探针测试各种星系属性的可解码性，并分析探针方向是否恢复已知的物理结构。

Result: 星系属性按固定顺序涌现，与已知难度一致：像素中直接可见的量（波段星等）早期且在浅层即可解码，多波段/光谱推断量（红移、特定恒星形成率）晚期且在深层才涌现。该顺序对训练目标不变，随模型规模在幅度上放大但顺序不变。线性探针方向恢复了星系属性间的已知物理关系。

Conclusion: 天文学为校准LLM可解释性方法提供了一个受控的实验环境，使得"概念何时涌现"和"探针是否恢复真实结构"等主张可以得到地面真值验证，弥补了纯语言场景中无法验证的缺陷。

Abstract: Interpretability research increasingly asks when concepts emerge during training and whether linear probes recover real structure, but in language models these claims are hard to validate because language offers little ground-truth ordering of concepts or relationships among them. We propose the use of astronomical ground truth through AstroPT, a transformer trained on millions of galaxy images, as a calibration testbed. AstroPT is an LLM-like model trained within a domain where the difficulty ordering of concepts and the relations among them are known in advance. Probing frozen representations across checkpoints, layers, model sizes, and objective choices, we find that galaxy properties emerge in a fixed order that tracks their known difficulty---quantities written almost directly into the pixels (band magnitude) become decodable early in training and shallow in the network, while multiband/spectra based and inferred quantities (such as redshift and specific star formation rate) emerge later and deeper. This order is invariant to our tested training objectives, and scales in magnitude but not in sequence with capacity. Our linear probe directions further recover the known physical structure among galaxy properties. Our findings suggest that astronomy offers a controlled sandbox for calibrating mechanistic interpretability methods we otherwise apply to LLMs blind.

</details>


### [430] [KMGen: A Skill-based Approach for Synthetic Individual Patient Data Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22618)
*Jalen Jiang,Chufan Gao,Ethan Rasmussen,Stephen Z. Xie,Jimeng Sun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: KMGen是一个端到端框架，首次同时解决两个问题：全自动从发表图表中提取Kaplan-Meier曲线（无需人工数字化），以及从公共临床试验注册记录生成合成个体患者的不良事件（AE）时间轨迹。在32图基准上达到IAE 0.0151的KM提取精度，在三项独立肿瘤试验中生成的患者数据在KM曲线、人口统计学特征和AE恢复方面均表现良好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床试验的个体患者数据（IPD）是生存建模、荟萃分析和安全研究的核心投入，但IPD极少被公开发布。现有工作只解决了问题的一半：从发表图中重建KM曲线通常需要人工数字化或人机交互校正，且完全没有机制生成构成患者记录另一半的不良事件流。这阻碍了大规模、自动化的基于IPD的二次研究。

Method: KMGen由两阶段组成：(i) 提取阶段：一个全自动的agentic流水线，由代理自动生成代码来提取KM曲线中的每个步骤；(ii) IPD生成阶段：将患者原型提取与统计采样解耦——LLM将试验记录提炼为各臂统计量、不良事件、患者人口统计学特征和风险乘数；一个机制性采样器通过临床原型、基于bootstrap秩相关耦合到经验KM曲线（精确保持边际生存分布）、以及带诱导/维持划分的基于周期的AE调度来生成患者事件。

Result: 提取阶段在涵盖干净、边界和对抗条件下的32图基准上达到平均IAE 0.0151。生成阶段在三项保留的肿瘤试验（队列规模相差一个数量级）中，30次独立再生平均KM积分绝对差异≤0.051，5/6个人口统计学槽位的性别/ECOG JSD≤0.013，且以单一固定参数集按精确MedDRA术语恢复了≥71%的前15个不良事件。

Conclusion: KMGen是首个同时解决KM曲线自动提取和合成AE轨迹生成的端到端框架，以与人类引导工具相当的精度实现了全自动处理，并以开源形式发布。这为大规模基于IPD的生存建模、荟萃分析和安全研究提供了可行的数据基础。

Abstract: Individual patient data (IPD) from clinical trials is the substrate for survival modeling, meta-analysis, and safety research, yet IPD is rarely released. Prior work has addressed only half of this gap: reconstructing Kaplan-Meier (KM) curves from published plots -- typically requiring manual digitization or human-in-the-loop correction -- while offering no mechanism for generating the adverse-event (AE) streams that constitute the other half of a patient record. We introduce KMGen, the first end-to-end framework that (i) fully automates KM curve extraction at accuracy competitive with human-guided tools, and (ii) generates synthetic per-patient AE trajectories from public trial registry records. The extraction stage is a fully automated agentic pipeline -- an agent generates code to extract each step in the KM curve -- achieving a mean Integrated Absolute Error (IAE) of 0.0151 on a 32-plot benchmark spanning clean, edge-case, and adversarial conditions. The IPD generation stage decouples patient archetype extraction from statistical sampling: an LLM distills the trial record into arm-specific statistics, adverse events, patient demographics, and risk multipliers. A mechanistic sampler generates patient events via clinical archetypes, bootstrap rank-correlation coupling to the empirical KM curve (preserving the marginal survival distribution exactly), and cycle-based AE scheduling with an induction/maintenance split. Across three held-out oncology trials spanning an order of magnitude in cohort size and 30 independent regenerations per trial, KMGen achieves mean integrated KM absolute difference $Δ_{\text{KM}}\,{\leq}\,0.051$, sex/ECOG JSD ${\leq}\,0.013$ on 5 of 6 demographic slots, and recovers ${\geq}\,71\%$ of the top-15 AEs by exact MedDRA term under a single fixed parameter set. The pipeline is released as open source at https://github.com/chufangao/kmgen.

</details>


### [431] [Learning Generalizable Behaviors for Terminal Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22631)
*Yihang Yao,Bo Pang,Xuan Phi Nguyen,Ding Zhao,Shafiq Joty,Semih Yavuz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究强化学习如何提升终端智能体（terminal agents）的性能，提出"智能体组合泛化假设"：RL主要塑造高层决策行为，组合和路由预训练/SFT阶段获得的低层技能，而非从头学习新领域技能。基于此洞察提出River训练方案，通过过滤低质量环境和引入过程级行为正则化来提升奖励信号质量，在多个终端智能体基准上取得SOTA效果，且仅用TMax不到30%的训练环境即实现显著RL增益提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 终端智能体是LLM的重要应用场景，RL是提升其能力的关键技术。但真实用户交互数据稀缺，合成环境存在领域差距和保真度有限的问题。现有工作主要扩展合成环境的数量和多样性，却忽略了奖励信号质量和泛化机制这一未被充分探索的关键维度。

Method: 提出两点核心方案：(1) Agentic Compositional Generalization假设，认为RL主要是组合和路由已有低层技能，而非学习新技能；(2) River训练方案，包含过滤低质量环境以及用过程级行为正则化增强结果奖励两条具体措施，以提升奖励质量。

Result: River训练的RL代理在四个终端智能体基准上取得开源8B模型中最佳成绩；仅用TMax不到30%的训练环境，在2B到27B模型上分别将RL增益平均提升106%（Terminal-Bench-Lite）和30%（Terminal-Bench-v2.1）。方法跨模型家族、规模、智能体框架和RL目标均表现良好的泛化性。

Conclusion: 验证了奖励质量比环境数量或多样性更重要的观点，表明提升验证器质量是改善RL训练终端智能体的关键杠杆，为未来合成环境的构建和RL训练策略提供了新方向。

Abstract: Terminal agents are a compelling application of large language models (LLMs), with the potential to integrate deeply into users' daily workflows. Reinforcement learning (RL) is a key technique for improving their capabilities, making scalable training environments a central challenge. Since public real-user interaction data are scarce, synthetic environments provide a practical alternative, but often suffer from domain gaps and limited fidelity, leading to poor generalization. Existing work mainly scales the quantity and diversity of synthetic environments, while reward-signal quality and the mechanisms governing generalization remain under-explored. We study how RL improves terminal agents and propose the Agentic Compositional Generalization hypothesis: rather than teaching new domain-specific skills from scratch, RL primarily shapes high-level decision-making behaviors that compose and route low-level skills acquired during pre-training and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). This account is consistent with our empirical results and suggests that verifier quality, which determines which behaviors are reinforced, is more important than simply increasing environment quantity or diversity. Motivated by this insight, we propose River, a simple training recipe that improves reward quality by filtering low-quality environments and augmenting outcome rewards with process-level behavior regularization. Using this recipe, our RL-trained agent achieves the best performance among evaluated open-source RL-trained 8B models across four terminal-agent benchmarks. River also generalizes across model families, scales, agent harnesses, and RL objectives. Using fewer than 30% of the TMax training environments, River improves RL gains by 106% and 30% on average for models ranging from 2B to 27B on Terminal-Bench-Lite and Terminal-Bench-v2.1, respectively.

</details>


### [432] [Q-Learning with Stable Infinite-Dimensional Linear Function Approximation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22636)
*Shengbo Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个稳定的无限维线性函数逼近框架用于Q-learning，从单条马尔可夫行为策略轨迹中学习。学习变量是紧致潜在度量空间上的连续系数场，通过非扩张的重建和压缩算子确保潜在贝尔曼映射的压缩性，并提出了两种随机逼近算法，其收敛界的前导项为Õ(n^{-1/2})，且算法对度量ρ的选择是agnostic的，能自动适应光滑性和几何结构。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统的Q-learning与线性函数逼近结合时可能不稳定，因为任意逼近架构不需要保持贝尔曼压缩性。需要一个能够保证稳定性和收敛性的函数逼近框架。

Method: 构建无限维线性函数逼近框架：学习变量为紧致潜在度量空间(C(L),ρ)上的连续系数场θ∈C(L)；使用重建算子将θ映射为连续Q函数，压缩算子将贝尔曼更新映射回潜在坐标；两者的非扩张性诱导出C(L)上的压缩潜在贝尔曼映射，具有唯一不动点。提出两种随机逼近(SA)算法并推导上确界范数收敛界。

Result: 两种SA算法的收敛界前导项均为Õ(n^{-1/2})；压缩映射的光滑性被系数场和SA迭代继承，使得一致估计误差可通过(L,ρ)的覆盖数来控制而非C(L)的维度；SA算法对ρ的选择是agnostic的，可自动适应光滑性和几何结构。

Conclusion: 该无限维框架为识别统计困难度的结构提供了强大抽象，并通过Q-测度学习和冻结预训练网络下的输出层神经权重训练两个实例展示了框架的实用性。

Abstract: Q-learning with linear function approximation can be unstable because an arbitrary approximation architecture need not preserve the Bellman contraction. We develop a stable infinite-dimensional linear function approximation framework for Q-learning from a single Markovian behavior-policy trajectory. The learning variable is a coefficient field $θ\in C(\mathbb L)$ on a compact latent metric space $(\mathbb L,ρ)$. The framework uses a reconstruction operator that maps $θ$ to a continuous Q-function and a compression operator that maps Bellman updates back to latent coordinates. Nonexpansiveness of both operators induces a contractive latent Bellman map on $C(\mathbb L)$, with a unique fixed point $θ^*$ whose reconstruction approximates the optimal Q-function up to representation error. We propose two stochastic approximation (SA) algorithms and establish their sup-norm convergence bounds with a leading term of order $\widetilde O(n^{-1/2})$. The infinite-dimensional formulation provides a powerful abstraction for identifying the structures that govern statistical difficulty. Smoothness of the compression map in $ρ$ is inherited by $θ^*$ and the SA iterates, allowing uniform estimation errors to be controlled through covering numbers of $(\mathbb L,ρ)$ rather than the dimension of $C(\mathbb L)$. Remarkably, the SA algorithms we propose are agnostic to the choice of $ρ$, and thus can automatically adapt to both the smoothness and the geometry. We further illustrate the framework through Q-measure-learning with linear density approximation and output-layer neural weight training under a frozen pretrained network.

</details>


### [433] [Mol-JEPA: A multimodal Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture for Molecules](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22642)
*Florian Rottach,Sebastian Schieferdecker,William Rudman,Randall Balestriero,Carsten Eickhoff*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Mol-JEPA是一个可扩展的分子世界模型学习框架，通过模态掩码（modality masking）而非次优的分子扰动，整合分子结构、细胞表型、结合亲和力、ADMET特征和量子化学模拟等多模态药物发现数据，在潜在空间进行预测学习，从而克服了现有分子基础模型中化学无效增强、模态崩溃和生化环境表征不完整等局限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有分子基础模型存在三大缺陷：化学无效的数据增强、模态崩溃（modality collapse）、以及对生化环境的表征不完整，这些限制了模型对分子世界的全面理解。

Method: 提出Mol-JEPA框架，采用模态掩码策略替代传统的分子扰动方法，从分子结构、细胞表型、结合亲和力、ADMET谱、量子化学模拟等多模态药物发现数据中提取信息，并通过潜在空间预测（latent space prediction）学习分子世界模型。

Result: 在多个基准测试上，Mol-JEPA学习到的分子表征表现出优异的性能，验证了通过潜在空间预测融入生化上下文信息的有效性。

Conclusion: Mol-JEPA证明了利用多模态生化数据与潜在空间预测相结合的方式，能够学习到更强大、更全面的分子表征，为分子基础模型的发展提供了新方向。

Abstract: Despite recent advances in molecular foundation models, several limitations remain, such as chemically invalid augmentations, modality collapse, and incomplete representation of biochemical environments. To address these challenges, we present \textbf{Mol-JEPA}, a scalable framework for learning molecular world models. Rather than relying on suboptimal molecular perturbations, our model uses modality masking to exploit information from molecular structures, cellular phenotypes, binding affinities, ADMET profiles, quantum chemistry simulations and other drug discovery data. Across various benchmarks, we show that the representations learned by Mol-JEPA deliver strong performance, demonstrating the value of incorporating biochemical context through latent space prediction.

</details>


### [434] [Maximum-distance nonnegative matrix factorization for unmixing highly mixed grain-size distribution data: A generalization of AnalySize](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22681)
*Qianqian Qi,Zhongming Chen,Peter G. M. van der Heijden*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种最大距离非负矩阵分解（maximum-distance NMF）方法，用于解决高度混合的粒度分布数据分解问题，并开发了层次交替最小二乘算法进行优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有的NMF方法（如AnalySize）在处理低混合度的粒度分布数据时表现良好，但在高度混合的数据中，由于没有观测样本接近真实端元，AnalySize会遇到困难，需要一种新的方法来解决这一问题。

Method: 提出最大距离NMF，鼓励估计的端元尽可能彼此不同（最大化端元间距离），并设计了一个层次交替最小二乘（hierarchical alternating least squares）算法来优化该目标函数。该方法可视为AnalySize的推广，因为AnalySize是最小化端元间的距离，而本文方法则最大化该距离。

Result: 实验结果表明，该方法能够有效地分解高度混合的粒度分布数据，克服了AnalySize在此类场景下的局限性。

Conclusion: 最大距离NMF是对AnalySize的一种有效推广，在高度混合的粒度分布数据分解任务中展现出优越性能，为该领域提供了新的解决方案。

Abstract: Nonnegative matrix factorization (NMF) decomposes a nonnegative matrix into the product of two nonnegative matrices. This property makes NMF well suited for unmixing grain-size distribution data, which are inherently nonnegative and have row sums equal to one. Previous studies have shown that AnalySize, an NMF-based method, performs well on poorly mixed grain-size distribution data but struggles when the data is highly mixed, where no observed samples are close to the true end members. To overcome this limitation, we introduce a maximum-distance NMF that encourages the estimated end members to be as distinct as possible and develop a hierarchical alternating least squares algorithm for optimization. The proposed formulation can be regarded as a generalization of AnalySize, where AnalySize minimizes the distance among end members while the proposed method maximizes it. Experimental results demonstrate that the method effectively decomposes highly mixed grain-size distribution data.

</details>


### [435] [Spiking Neural Networks for Continuous Control: Neuromorphic Reinforcement Learning in Conventional Computing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22729)
*Jessica Hunter,Md Maruf Hossain Shuvo,Krishna Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了SANSAC（Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor-Critic），一种采用脉冲神经网络作为actor网络的最小化神经形态可行变体的SAC算法，在传统硬件上验证其与标准SAC在连续控制任务中具有近乎等效的性能，为未来神经形态强化学习研究建立基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管强化学习算法在过去十年取得了显著进展，但将其部署到神经形态硬件用于连续控制任务仍缺乏验证。目前尚不清楚用脉冲神经网络（SNN）替代传统actor网络是否会在硬件特定优势显现之前就影响智能体的性能，因此需要系统性的验证和基线建立。

Method: 提出SANSAC框架，用SNN替换SAC中的传统actor网络，形成最小化、神经形态可行的actor变体；在传统计算机上对SANSAC和传统SAC进行系统比较，并研究隐藏维度大小对性能的影响。

Result: SANSAC与SAC在连续控制任务中表现出近乎等效的性能，并分析了隐藏维度的影响；结果表明基于SNN的算法在复杂连续环境中具有可行性，在传统计算机上也能获得与传统神经网络相当的竞争性表现。

Conclusion: SANSAC验证了SNN算法在连续强化学习框架中的可行性，证明其性能与传统网络相当，为后续在神经形态硬件上部署和进一步探索SNN在连续RL框架中的应用奠定了坚实基础。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) algorithms have made strides over the past decade applying them to a wide range of problems and control tasks. However, the deployment of RL on neuromorphic hardware for continuous control tasks remains under-validated. Namely it is unclear whether replacing a conventional actor network with a spiking neural network (SNN) affects the performance of an agent before any hardware-specific benefits manifest. We provide a systematic validation of a minimal, neuromorphically viable spiking actor variant of Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) on conventional hardware, establishing a baseline for future neuromorphic RL research. In this paper, we propose the Spiking Actor Network Soft Actor Critic (SANSAC) to address the use of RL frameworks in continuous environments, designed as a framework that can be implemented on neuromorphic hardware. We compare a traditional Soft Actor Critic (SAC) network to SANSAC in a traditional computer. We demonstrate the near equivalent performance of SANSAC and SAC, while addressing the impact of hidden dimensions. Our results demonstrate the viability of SNN based algorithms in complex continuous environments, as well as competitive performance to traditional neural networks in traditional computers, providing a basis to continue exploring the use of SNNs in continuous RL frameworks.

</details>


### [436] [MOSH-WM: Mask-Grounded Soft-Hamiltonian Dynamics for Object-Centric World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22750)
*Zhekai Wang,Haoxiang Huang,Xiang Liu,Zhikang Chen,Yueqing Sun,Qi Gu,Shiji Zhou,Miao Liu,Sen Cui*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于掩码接地软哈密顿世界模型（method），用于目标中心视频预测。通过将类似于位置的隐状态显式依赖于槽位自身的图像支持区域，并利用空间矩形成规范状态Q、时间差分形成P，结合学习能量提供软方向偏置，实现了更好的长期视频预测效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的目标中心世界模型在预测未来视频时，受到动力学监督的变量通常是无约束的视觉特征，缺乏明确的物理或空间语义，导致长期预测时误差累积较快、预测质量下降。

Method: 1) 使用冻结的视频槽位编码器产生槽位和掩码；2) 通过掩码所属图像支持区域的空间矩形成规范状态Q，时间差分构成P；3) 学习能量为有界学习增量提供软方向偏置；4) 解码器相关的外观和身份信息单独存储在因果视觉上下文中；5) 通过门控合成器和有界残差将上下文与传播的相位状态结合，重建解码器兼容的槽位。

Result: 在OBJ3D数据集上，给定6帧观测并评估后续30帧，LPIPS降低25.0%，空间MSE降低33.7%（相对于最强目标中心基线）；在CLEVRER数据集上，给定6帧观测并评估后续10帧，LPIPS降低14.5%，空间MSE降低18.7%。整个30帧闭环展开过程中误差累积更慢。

Conclusion: 通过将动力学状态显式约束为与槽位图像支持相关的空间矩，并采用哈密顿力学风格的传播机制，该模型能够更稳定地进行长期目标中心视频预测，显著优于现有基线方法。

Abstract: Object-centric world models forecast future videos by evolving a set of entity slots, but the variables receiving dynamics supervision are often unconstrained visual features. We introduce \method{}, a mask-grounded soft-Hamiltonian world model that makes its position-like state explicitly depend on slot-owned image support. A frozen video-slot encoder produces slots and masks; spatial moments of mask-owned support form a canonical state $Q$, temporal differences form $P$, and a learned energy supplies a soft directional bias to a bounded learned increment. Decoder-relevant appearance and identity are stored separately in a causal visual context. A gated composer and bounded residual then combine this context with the propagated phase state to reconstruct decoder-compatible slots. On OBJ3D, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following 30 frames, \method{} reduces LPIPS by 25.0\% and spatial MSE by 33.7\% relative to the strongest object-centric baseline. On CLEVRER, given six observed frames and evaluated over the following ten frames, the corresponding reductions are 14.5\% and 18.7\%. Horizon-resolved visual and object-state measurements show that the complete model accumulates error more slowly throughout the 30-frame closed-loop rollout. Project page:https://github.com/moshwm-anon/-moshwm-anon.github.io.

</details>


### [437] [LpWM: A Case for Sparse Representations in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22764)
*Yilun Kuang,Yash Dagade,Quentin Le Lidec,Lucas Maes,Randall Balestriero,Yann LeCun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出LpWorldModel（LpWM），一种通过稀疏表示来简化联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）中动力学建模的方法。作者证明非线性Lipschitz动力学可以在足够高维的一热潜空间中由线性动力学任意逼近，并引入分布式稀疏表示作为实际放松方案。通过修正广义高斯分布匹配正则化（RDMReg），LpWM生成非负稀疏编码，在PushT任务上以较低预测器复杂度实现了优于稠密表示的规划性能，且学习到的稀疏表示具有"模式分解"结构，支持编码离散动力学区域，特征幅度捕获连续状态。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有JEPA方法通过将特征匹配到最大熵分布（如各向同性高斯）来避免表示坍缩，产生稠密表示。但稠密表示是否是最有利于动力学建模的几何结构尚不清楚。作者质疑稠密表示的适用性，探索稀疏表示是否能降低动作条件潜在动力学的建模难度，并揭示可解释的结构。

Method: 1）理论证明：非线性Lipschitz动力学可由高维一热潜空间中的线性动力学任意逼近，滚动误差随维度增大而消失。2）实际放松：引入分布式稀疏表示作为一热稀疏性的实用近似。3）提出LpWM：一种JEPA模型，使用修正分布匹配正则化（RDMReg）将编码器特征匹配到修正广义高斯分布，产生非负稀疏编码。4）实验验证：在PushT任务上比较稀疏LpWM与稠密LeWM、VICReg在不同预测器族的规划性能。

Result: 实验结果表明：1）稀疏性降低了成功规划所需的预测器复杂度，在中间预测器容量下，稀疏LpWM比稠密LeWM规划成功率高出57%。2）该优势超越高斯分布匹配，LpWM在多种预测器族上优于稠密VICReg表示。3）学习到的稀疏表示是模式分解的（mode-factored），支持编码离散动力学区域，特征幅度捕获区域内连续状态。

Conclusion: 稀疏表示能够降低控制所需的预测器复杂度，同时揭示可解释的动力学结构。这为JEPA架构中表示几何的选择提供了新视角，表明稀疏性不仅是降维工具，更是提升动力学建模效率和可解释性的重要设计原则。

Abstract: Joint-embedding predictive architectures (JEPAs) learn latent dynamics for planning and avoid representation collapse by matching features to maximum-entropy distributions such as isotropic Gaussians, yielding dense representations. However, it is unclear whether dense representations are the most favorable geometry for modeling dynamics. In this work, we ask whether a different geometry, sparse representations, can make action-conditioned latent dynamics easier to model, and what dynamical structure emerges from such representations. We first show that nonlinear Lipschitz dynamics can be approximated arbitrarily well by action-conditioned linear dynamics in a sufficiently high-dimensional one-hot latent space, with rollout error vanishing as the dimension grows. This motivates distributed sparse representations as a practical relaxation of one-hot sparsity. We introduce LpWorldModel (LpWM), a JEPA model regularized with Rectified Distribution Matching Regularization (RDMReg) to match encoder features to a Rectified Generalized Gaussian distribution, yielding non-negative sparse codes. Empirically, sparsity lowers the predictor complexity required for successful planning: on PushT, sparse LpWM outperforms dense LeWM by up to 57% in planning success at intermediate predictor capacities. This advantage also extends beyond Gaussian distribution matching, with LpWM outperforming dense VICReg representations across multiple predictor families. We further find that the learned sparse representations are mode-factored, with support encoding discrete dynamical regimes and feature magnitudes capturing continuous within-regime state. Together, these results suggest that sparse representations can reduce the predictor complexity required for control while revealing interpretable structure.

</details>


### [438] [Learning to Control Coupled-Dynamics Environments with Joint Markov Decision Processes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22765)
*Ege C. Kaya,Aliasghar Pourghani,Mahsa Ghasemi,Vijay Gupta,Abolfazl Hashemi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对耦合动力学环境下的联合马尔可夫决策过程（JMDP）发展了最优控制方法，定义了非参数分布Bellman最优性算子，并证明了在边际MDP具有唯一最优策略时，迭代在Wasserstein距离下收敛到最优联合回报分布；对于前两阶矩，在更弱条件下也建立了收敛性，并推导了用于神经近似的采样目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 耦合动力学环境暴露了在共同外生随机性下多个反事实动作的一步结果，但普通MDP形式仅允许推理每个动作的边缘分布，丢弃了这些反事实结果间的依赖关系。JMDP形式保留了这种依赖，但此前仅解决了固定策略下的联合矩评估问题，缺乏最优控制方法。

Method: 定义了JMDP的非参数分布Bellman最优性算子；证明当诱导的边际MDP具有唯一最优策略时，算子迭代在Wasserstein距离下收敛到最优联合回报定律；对前两阶矩，在允许多个均值最优动作（只要其平局决议共享二阶矩不动点）的更弱条件下建立收敛性；推导了用于神经近似的采样目标。

Result: 证明了分布Bellman最优性算子在唯一最优策略条件下的Wasserstein收敛性；建立了前两阶矩在更弱条件下的收敛性；给出了神经网络逼近的采样目标。

Conclusion: 本文填补了JMDP框架中缺乏最优控制方法的空白，为耦合动力学环境下保留跨反事实依赖的最优决策提供了理论基础与可实现算法。

Abstract: Coupled-dynamics environments expose the one-step outcomes that would follow from several possible counterfactual actions under a common realization of exogenous randomness. The ordinary Markov decision process formalism allows one to reason about the marginal law of each action but discards dependence across these counterfactual outcomes. The Joint Markov decision process (JMDP) formalism preserves that dependence. Prior work established the formalism and solved the fixed-policy joint moment evaluation problem in JMDPs. This paper develops optimal-control methods. We define a nonparametric distributional Bellman optimality operator for JMDPs, and prove that when the induced marginal MDP has a unique optimal policy, its iterates converge in Wasserstein distance to the optimal joint return law. For the first two moments, we establish convergence under a weaker condition that permits several mean-optimal actions as long as their tie resolutions share a second-moment fixed point. We also derive sampled targets for neural approximation.

</details>


### [439] [Neural Operator based Multi-Field Reconstruction of Inner Solar Boundary State](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22782)
*Vignesh Kumar Pandian Sathia,Reza Mansouri,Dustin J. Kempton,Pete Riley,Rafal A. Angryk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究利用算子学习（operator learning）从径向速度和径向磁场两个已知变量重构30个太阳半径处完整的太阳磁流体力学（MHD）多场多尺度状态，包括非径向速度、非径向磁场、电流密度、热力学密度和压力等，作为内边界条件用于日球层建模和太阳风预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 太阳风预测和日球层MHD模拟需要完整的内边界条件，但实际应用中往往只能直接观测到部分场变量（如径向速度和径向磁场）。这种从部分变量重构完整多场状态的映射具有高度非线性、空间耦合和多尺度特性，对数据驱动的科学机器学习构成挑战。

Method: 采用局部神经算子（Local Neural Operator, LocalNO），它能够在函数空间之间学习映射，同时保持局部性和分辨率感知能力，适用于物理系统中结构化场到场的变换，优于传统回归模型和自编码器模型。

Result: LocalNO能够学习从径向速度与径向磁场到非径向速度、非径向磁场、电流密度、密度和压力等多场变量的映射，输出结果可作为未来内日球层建模管线的边界条件变量。

Conclusion: 神经算子方法为太阳MHD多场状态重构提供了一种有效的数据驱动方案，生成的完整边界条件有望支持后续日球层建模和太阳风预测管线。

Abstract: The Solar wind is a continuous flow of charged particles emanating from the solar surface and governed by complex, interacting magnetohydrodynamic processes. Accurate specification of inner-boundary conditions is essential for heliospheric modeling and solar-wind prediction. In many practical applications, only a subset of interacting multi-field variables is directly available, but for a comprehensive view of solar wind prediction and downstream magnetohydrodynamic simulations, a more complete boundary state is required. In this work, we study the problem of learning the multi-field multi-scale solar magnetohydrodynamic state at 30 solar radii ($R_\odot$) using operator learning. Specifically, given the radial velocity and radial magnetic field, we aim to reconstruct the non-radial velocity and magnetic field components, radial and non-radial current density, thermodynamic density, and pressure components. This mapping is highly nonlinear, spatially coupled, and multi-scale, making it a challenging task for data-driven scientific machine learning.
  To address this problem, we employ a Local Neural Operator (LocalNO) that learns mappings between input and output function spaces while retaining locality and resolution-awareness. Unlike conventional regression models and autoencoder models, neural operators are better suited for learning structured field-to-field transformations arising from physical systems. The resulting predictions along with inputs are intended to serve as boundary condition variables for future inner-heliospheric modeling pipelines.

</details>


### [440] [ReCoG: Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22786)
*Rui Xue,Tianfu Wu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ReCoG（Reciprocal Co-Evolution），一种将图结构学习与多模态表示学习紧密耦合的新学习范式，通过端到端互惠交互机制同时优化拓扑结构和多模态语义表示，在多模态图学习基准上超越现有强基线方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态图学习方法将结构学习与表示学习分离：多模态GNN侧重在共享嵌入空间中对齐模态但使用固定或弱适应的图结构，而图结构学习方法仅从单模态表示推断拓扑，忽略了多模态交互。这种分离限制了GNN捕捉多模态场景中语义关系的能力，因为观测边往往存在噪声、不完整或与底层语义错位的问题。

Method: ReCoG包含两个核心组件：(i) 多模态图精炼器（multimodal graph refiner），利用跨模态语义证据推断和纠正图中的边；(ii) 耦合的跨模态消息传递机制，在精炼后的图上执行模态内和模态间的联合传播。两者通过端到端互惠交互形成动态耦合，使拓扑学习与表示学习相互促进。

Result: 在节点分类和链接预测等多个基准上，ReCoG持续优于强多模态图结构学习基线（包括图基础模型），证明了该方法的有效性和泛化能力。

Conclusion: 结构与语义的互惠协同进化对有效的多模态图学习至关重要，挑战了当前将拓扑学习与表示学习分离的主流做法。

Abstract: Multimodal graph learning requires jointly training over graph structure and heterogeneous node attributes, yet existing methods largely decouple these processes: prior multimodal graph neural networks (GNNs) focus on aligning modalities in a shared embedding space while operating on fixed or weakly adapted graph structures, and graph structure learning approaches infer topology from unimodal node representations without accounting for multimodal interactions. This separation fundamentally limits the ability of GNNs to capture semantically meaningful relationships in multimodal settings, where observed edges are often noisy, incomplete, or misaligned with underlying semantics. We propose ReCoG (Reciprocal Co-Evolution for Multimodal Graph Learning), a new learning paradigm that tightly couples graph structure learning and multimodal representation learning through end-to-end reciprocal interaction. Concretely, ReCoG integrates (i) a multimodal graph refiner that infers and corrects edges using cross-modal semantic evidence, and (ii) a coupled cross-modal message passing mechanism that performs joint intra- and inter-modality propagation over the refined graph. This unified design yields greater expressiveness than decoupled or two-stage formulations and allows dynamic interaction between topology and representation learning. Across diverse benchmarks for node classification and link prediction, ReCoG consistently outperforms strong multimodal graph structure learning baselines, including graph foundation models. Our results demonstrate that reciprocal co-evolution of structure and semantics is important for effective multimodal graph learning, challenging the prevailing separation between topology and representation learning.

</details>


### [441] [Contrastive Representation-Guided Genetic Minority Oversampling for Imbalanced Time-Series Classification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22804)
*Wenbin Pei,Yunrong Hao,Zhen Liu,Guan Wang,Bing Xue,Yiu-Ming Cheung,Qiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出FreMGP，一种基于频域表示引导的多树遗传编程过采样方法，用于处理不平衡时间序列分类问题。通过对比学习提取频域类判别特征，引导遗传编程进化搜索生成高质量少数类合成样本，实验证明其优于现有过采样方法并能一致提升多种分类器性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实世界的时间序列分类任务常存在严重的类不平衡问题，而现有采样方法（包括基于插值的过采样和深度学习生成模型）由于时间序列的复杂时序依赖性和少数类样本稀缺，通常面临泛化能力有限和生成样本多样性不足的问题。

Method: 提出FreMGP方法：(1) 基于频域表示的多树遗传编程过采样框架，每个个体代表一组少数类合成样本；(2) 基于对比学习的频域类判别表示模块，用于引导进化搜索朝向高质量合成样本的方向。

Result: 在不平衡时间序列数据集上的实验表明，FreMGP优于现有的过采样方法，并且能够一致性地提升不同分类器（包括通用机器学习和深度学习模型）的性能。

Conclusion: 频域表示引导的遗传编程过采样方法可以有效地解决时间序列不平衡分类中的泛化和多样性问题，为不平衡时间序列数据预处理提供了新的有效途径。

Abstract: Real-world time-series classification tasks often exhibit class imbalance, which can be extremely severe in some applications. To avoid training biased classifiers on imbalanced data, sampling is one of the most popular data pre-processing techniques because of its classifier-agnostic nature. However, due to the complex temporal dependencies in original time-series data and the scarcity of minority-class samples, existing sampling methods, including interpolation-based oversampling methods and deep learning-based generative models, usually suffer from limited generalization and poor diversity when generating new time-series samples. This paper proposes a Frequency-domain representation-guided Multi-tree Genetic Programming-based oversampling approach (FreMGP) to imbalanced time-series classification, where each individual represents a set of synthetic samples for the minority class. A frequency-domain class-discriminative representation module based on contrastive learning is also developed, guiding the evolutionary search toward high-quality synthetic time-series samples. Experiments on imbalanced time-series datasets demonstrate that FreMGP outperforms existing oversampling methods and consistently improves the performance of different classifiers, including both general machine learning and deep learning models.

</details>


### [442] [Change Detection in Probability Flow ODE: Online Testing in Diffusion Latent Spaces](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22807)
*Artem Kraevskiy,Artem Prokhorov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于条件扩散模型的时序变点检测方法。利用预训练的条件扩散模型通过概率流ODE建立确定性双射，将变点前的观测映射为标准高斯潜变量；变点后的观测经同一映射后偏离参考高斯分布。以最大均值差异（MMD）作为检验统计量，在零假设下推导其闭式解和退化U统计量的渐近分布，并采用Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序实现精确阈值校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 许多顺序数据任务（如金融市场趋势反转、视频音频自动分割、运动传感器方向变化检测）需要检测时间序列中的分布漂移。然而，当条件密度在未知时间发生切换且前后分布均无闭式表达时，经典似然比统计量无法适用，亟需一种无需参数假设的通用检测方法。

Method: 1) 在变点前的数据上训练条件扩散模型，附带冻结的上下文编码器；2) 通过概率流ODE构建确定性双射，将变点前观测映射为标准高斯潜变量；3) 将变点后观测经同一冻结映射处理，检测其偏离参考高斯的程度；4) 以MMD作为检验统计量，在高斯零假设下推导各成分闭式表达式并建立退化U统计量的渐近分布；5) 应用Shiryaev-Roberts在线检测程序，实现精确阈值校准。

Result: 该方法能够检测任意分布漂移，包括协方差旋转和更高阶的结构性断裂，且无需对两个阶段（变点前后）做任何参数假设。理论方面建立了统计量的渐近分布，实践方面提供了在线检测的精确阈值校准。

Conclusion: 该工作将扩散模型的表征能力与经典在线变点检测理论相结合，为无闭式分布假设下的分布漂移检测提供了一条无需似然比的通用路径，适用范围覆盖金融、视频音频处理、传感器数据分析等多个实际场景。

Abstract: A rapidly growing range of sequential data tasks, such as identifying trend reversals in financial markets, auto-segmenting video and audio recordings, detecting changes in movement direction from motion sensors cannot be fully addressed without detection of distributional shifts in time-ordered data. We consider a sequential change-point detection problem where the conditional density switches at an unknown time, yet neither the pre- nor post-change distribution admits a closed-form. Classical likelihood-ratio statistics are inapplicable in this settings.
  A conditional diffusion model, trained on pre-change-point data with a frozen context encoder, defines a deterministic bijection via the probability flow ODE. Pre-change observations are mapped onto standard Gaussian latent variables. Post-change observations, processed through the same frozen map, deviate from this reference. We employ the Maximum Mean Discrepancy as the test statistic, derive closed-form expressions for its components under the Gaussian null, and establish its asymptotic distribution as a degenerate U-statistic. Afterwards we apply an online detection procedure of Shiryaev--Roberts to the resulting statistic with exact threshold calibration.
  The method detects arbitrary distributional shifts, including covariance rotations and higher-order structural breaks, without parametric assumptions on either regime.

</details>


### [443] [SAGE: Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble Feature Selection for Explainable Postpartum Depression Risk Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22809)
*Md. Rokon Islam Emon,Syed Shariar Alam Shuvo,Shahriar Siddique Ayon,Abdullah Al Mamun,Ahnaf Atef Choudhury*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE系统，一种稳定性感知的图集成特征选择方法，结合局部可解释AI和遗传算法优化的神经网络（GA-ANN），用于产后抑郁症（PPD）预测。在766名产后女性队列中，SAGE仅用16个特征即达到87.96%准确率、86.32% F1分数和0.88 AUC，优于基线和现有特征选择方法。心理和社会经济因素（EPDS、PHQ-9得分、母职感受、虐待史）是主要预测因子，而人口统计学因素影响较小。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 产后抑郁症（PPD）对母婴健康造成重大负担，尤其是在中低收入国家（患病率超过19%）。现有机器学习PPD预测方法存在三大局限：全局解释缺乏患者层面的临床实用性、特征选择不稳定、类别不平衡下泛化能力差。因此需要更稳健、可解释且适用于资源受限环境的预测工具。

Method: SAGE结合多种技术：1) 信息论相关性、PCA结构分析和图交互特征，配合bootstrap稳定性加权，识别稳健且非冗余的预测因子；2) 使用遗传算法优化的人工神经网络（GA-ANN）进行预测；3) 采用GAN过采样处理类别不平衡；4) 基于LIME的局部可解释AI提供个体案例层面的特征洞察。

Result: 在766名产后女性队列中，SAGE使用仅16个特征达到87.96%准确率、86.32% F1分数和0.88 AUC，优于其他特征选择方法和基线。主要预测因子为EPDS评分、PHQ-9评分、对母职的感受和虐待史等心理与社会经济因素，人口统计学因素影响较小。

Conclusion: SAGE是一个可扩展、可解释且具有临床实用性的工具，能够在医疗资源有限的条件下实现PPD的早期识别。LIME提供的实例级解释支持个性化风险评估，使其成为面向资源受限医疗环境的有力临床决策支持系统。

Abstract: Postpartum depression (PPD) poses a major burden on maternal and child health, especially in low- and middle-income countries where prevalence exceeds 19%. Despite advancements in machine learning for PPD prediction, current approaches are limited by opaque global explanations that lack clinical usefulness at the patient level, unstable feature selection, and poor generalization under class imbalance. We propose SAGE, a Stability-Aware Graph-Based Ensemble feature selection system that incorporates both local explainable AI and a genetically optimized artificial neural network (GA-ANN). Using a primary cohort of 766 postpartum women, SAGE combines information-theoretic relevance, PCA-based structure, and graph-based interactions with bootstrap stability weighting to identify robust and non-redundant predictors. The GA-ANN architecture, optimized using a genetic algorithm and enhanced with GAN based oversampling, achieved strong performance with 87.96% accuracy, 86.32% F1 score, and 0.88 AUC using only 16 features, outperforming baseline and other feature selection methods. Psychological and socioeconomic factors such as EPDS score, PHQ-9 score, feelings about motherhood, and abuse history are the main predictors, while demographic factors have less influence. The LIME-based explanations allow instance-based insight into selected features from the graph, enabling personalized risk assessment. The findings make SAGE a scalable, interpretable, and clinical tool for early identification of PPD in health-care limited resources.

</details>


### [444] [Fairness-Aware Mixture-of-Experts via Subgroup Reweighting and Gate Regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22820)
*Sunhee Hwang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种端到端的混合专家（MoE）框架来修正"路由诱导偏差"（routing-induced bias），通过子群体重加权和门控熵正则化，在提升模型公平性的同时保持预测性能，并提供可解释的子群体专家分配视图。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习模型常因训练数据在敏感属性（如性别、年龄）上分布不均而产生跨人口群体的性能差异。现有的单阶段方法难以处理异质子群体分布，两阶段方法则可能导致公平目标与下游预测之间的错位，因此亟需一种端到端的公平性学习方法。

Method: 提出一个端到端的MoE框架：(1) 采用子群体重加权（subgroup reweighting）来纠正数据不平衡；(2) 引入门控熵正则化（gate entropy regularization）防止路由崩溃到子群体属性上，使专家利用既平衡又可解释。

Result: 实验结果表明，所提出的方法在提升公平性的同时保持了具有竞争力的预测性能。

Conclusion: 通过MoE框架中的路由分布，该方法不仅改善了公平性，还提供了子群体如何在专家间分配的可解释视图，为公平学习中的路由机制研究提供了新思路。

Abstract: Deep learning models often produce performance disparities across demographic groups, due to the training data imbalance with respect to sensitive attributes such as gender or age. To address this problem, existing work has explored fair representation learning, data re-sampling, and adversarial training, which can be broadly categorized into two main approaches. Single-stage methods typically learn a shared representation for fairness, but often struggle to handle heterogeneous subgroup distributions. Two-stage methods learn representations separately from the final prediction task, which can lead to misalignment between fairness objectives and downstream predictions. We identify routing-induced bias, a failure mode in which subgroup imbalance drives the gating network to route subgroups onto a few experts, and propose an end-to-end Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) framework that corrects it. Specifically, we apply subgroup reweighting to correct data imbalance, and introduce gate entropy regularization to prevent routing from collapsing onto subgroup attributes, keeping expert utilization both balanced and interpretable. Beyond improving fairness, the routing distribution offers an interpretable view of how subgroups are allocated across experts. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed approach improves fairness while maintaining competitive predictive performance.

</details>


### [445] [DIME: Query-Efficient Framework for Membership Inference on Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22824)
*Tue Do,Daniel Alabi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出DIME（Denoiser Ideal Membership Error）框架，一种理论严谨且查询高效的扩散模型成员推理攻击方法。通过精确刻画有限训练集上最优扩散去噪器，发现成员泄露由去噪器的隐式重构误差决定，该误差分解为偏差项（捕捉重构精度）和局部拥挤项（捕捉邻近训练样本的几何结构）。两项均可通过模型查询高效估计，实现仅需两次查询的实用攻击，在多个数据集上以更少查询成本显著超越现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有针对扩散模型的成员推理攻击大多基于启发式方法，且需要大量查询预算，缺乏理论支撑和高效性。

Method: 从理论出发，精确刻画有限训练集上的最优去噪器，揭示成员泄露由隐式重构误差决定；将该误差分解为偏差项和局部拥挤项，两者均可用少量模型查询高效估计，形成DIME攻击框架。

Result: 在CIFAR-10/100、STL10-U、CelebA和ImageNet上，DIME在1% FPR下TPR提升最高达3倍；其两查询变体即可超越现有30查询基线。

Conclusion: DIME提供了理论上严谨且查询高效的成员推理攻击方法，并进一步建议、讨论和评估了特定防御措施来对抗此类强大的成员测试。

Abstract: Membership inference attacks expose whether individual records were used to train a model, yet existing attacks on diffusion models are largely heuristic and can require substantial query budgets. We introduce DIME (Denoiser Ideal Membership Error), a theoretically grounded and query-efficient framework for membership inference on diffusion models. Our starting point is an exact characterization of the optimal diffusion denoiser for a finite training set, which reveals that membership leakage is governed by the denoiser's implicit reconstruction error. This error decomposes into two complementary signals: a bias term, capturing reconstruction accuracy, and a previously unexplored local crowding term, capturing the geometry of nearby training examples. Both admit efficient estimators using only model queries, yielding a practical attack with as few as two queries. Across CIFAR-10/100, STL10-U, CelebA, and ImageNet, DIME consistently outperforms prior attacks at comparable or substantially lower query cost, improving TPR at 1% FPR by up to $3\times$; remarkably, its two-query variant can outperform existing 30-query baselines. Finally, we suggest, discuss, and evaluate specific defenses to counteract such powerful membership tests.

</details>


### [446] [Hierarchy-Aware Supervised Uncertainty Estimation for Black-box LLM Taxonomic Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22839)
*Shuting Xie,Nathaniel Lesperance,Graham W. Taylor*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究黑盒LLM在长尾生物多样性监测流水线中，针对层级分类学推理的不确定性估计问题。通过开源工具LLM提取代理特征，训练层级感知监督式估计器预测各分类级别的正确性，相比token似然基线显著提升性能（micro AUROC从0.57提升至0.75-0.80），其中rank-specific multi-head设计（H3）效果最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM越来越多地用于科学决策支持，但在黑盒场景下可靠的置信度估计仍然困难。现有方法难以处理层级分类学推理中的不确定性，且黑盒LLM无法访问内部token概率等信息。

Method: 使用开源工具LLM提取代理特征，训练轻量级监督式估计器，采用层级感知监督（hierarchy-aware supervision）来预测rank-wise的正确性。设计了rank-specific multi-head架构（H3），在统一全局拒绝阈值下进行选择性预测。

Result: 在三个工具LLM上，监督式估计器在micro区分度和统一全局拒绝阈值下的选择性预测方面持续优于token似然基线，micro AUROC从0.57提升到0.75-0.80。rank-specific multi-head设计（H3）取得最佳效果。

Conclusion: 考虑层级输出结构对于需要统一弃权规则的不确定性估计很重要，rank-specific multi-head架构是有效的设计方案。代码已公开。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for scientific decision support, yet reliable confidence estimation remains difficult in black-box settings. We study uncertainty estimation for hierarchical taxonomic reasoning generated by a black-box LLM in a long-tailed biodiversity monitoring pipeline. Using proxy features extracted by an open-source tool LLM, we train lightweight supervised estimators with hierarchy-aware supervision to predict rank-wise correctness. Across three tool LLMs, the supervised estimators consistently outperform a token-likelihood baseline for micro discrimination and selective prediction under a single global rejection threshold, improving micro AUROC from 0.57 to 0.75--0.80. The best results are achieved by a rank-specific multi-head design (H3), suggesting that accounting for hierarchical output structure is important when a unified abstention rule is required. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/uoguelph-mlrg/hierarchy-aware-llm-uq

</details>


### [447] [RIBOSPAN: A Long-Context RNA Foundation Model for Versatile RNA Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22849)
*Ziyuan Wang,Bohao Tang,Fei Zhang,Shuo Han,Pengfei Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RIBOSPAN是一个16.1亿参数的RNA基础模型，原生在长达10,240个核苷酸的上下文长度上进行预训练，结合双向自注意力、单核苷酸token化和注意力隔离序列打包技术，实现了完整长RNA的单核苷酸分辨率建模，并在此基础上开发了多维条件离散扩散框架用于全长mRNA生成与设计。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RNA基础模型的预训练上下文长度往往小于全长RNA（特别是mRNA）的长度，导致无法以单核苷酸分辨率对整个转录本进行建模。作者希望通过原生长上下文预训练来解决这一限制，实现完整转录本的表示学习与mRNA设计。

Method: 1) 构建16.1亿参数的双向RNA基础模型，原生预训练支持10,240nt上下文；2) 采用密集双向自注意力、单核苷酸token化、注意力隔离序列打包技术；3) 通过核苷酸重建、受控长上下文表示基准和冻结RNA类型表示分析进行多维度评估；4) 在此基础上开发多维条件离散扩散框架用于全长mRNA生成与同义密码子扩散的蛋白质保守CDS优化。

Result: 原生10K预训练在10,240 token下保持强重建能力；40%掩码的持续预训练在重度损坏下提升恢复能力且保持表示质量；长上下文基准显示原生10K模型保持强上下文响应性和上下文特异性表示分离，且扰动引起的表示变化高度局部化；YaRN推理时缩放能恢复部分直接外推短上下文模型丢失的上下文组织，但引起更大远端表示扩散；在冻结表示评估中实现SOTA，在多样化RNA类型上整体表现最强，并在长RNA上保持明显优势。

Conclusion: RIBOSPAN建立了一个强大的长上下文RNA基础模型，为跨RNA类型的可迁移表示学习和全转录本mRNA设计提供了有力基础，展示了原生长上下文预训练对完整RNA建模的关键价值。

Abstract: Full-length RNAs, particularly messenger RNAs, often exceed the context lengths used to pretrain existing RNA foundation models, limiting complete-transcript modeling at single-nucleotide resolution. We present RIBOSPAN, a 1.61-billion-parameter bidirectional RNA foundation model natively pretrained with context lengths up to 10,240 nt. RIBOSPAN combines dense bidirectional self-attention, single-nucleotide tokenization, and attention-isolated sequence packing to enable high-resolution modeling of complete long RNAs. We evaluate the model through nucleotide reconstruction, a controlled long-context representation benchmark, and frozen RNA-type representation analysis. Native 10K pretraining preserves strong reconstruction at 10,240 tokens, while continued pretraining with 40% masking improves recovery under heavy corruption while preserving representation quality. The long-context benchmark further shows that native 10K models maintain strong contextual responsiveness and context-specific representation separation while keeping perturbation-induced representation changes highly localized. Inference-time YaRN scaling recovers much of the contextual organization lost by direct extrapolation of short-context models, but induces substantially greater distal representation diffusion. Frozen-representation evaluations further demonstrate state-of-the-art RNA representation quality, with RIBOSPAN achieving the strongest overall performance across diverse RNA types and retaining a clear advantage on long RNAs. Building on the same backbone, we develop a multidimensionally conditioned discrete-diffusion framework for full-length mRNA generation and redesign, including synonymous-codon diffusion for protein-preserving CDS optimization. Together, RIBOSPAN establishes a powerful long-context foundation for transferable RNA representation learning and full-transcript mRNA design.

</details>


### [448] [Thinking at the Right Size: Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22854)
*Yan Zhou,Sara Kangaslahti,Jonathan Geuter,Nihal V. Nayak,Marco Fumero,Francesco Locatello,David Alvarez-Melis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出ADAPT框架，通过单次蒸馏运行同时沿"模型尺寸"和"后训练变体"两个维度摊销蒸馏成本，生成L个插值尺寸×K个后训练变体的L×K个模型，避免了为每个(变体,尺寸)组合单独训练的开销。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实际部署大语言模型需要多种后训练变体（指令微调、推理微调、对话模型）且每种变体需多个尺寸以满足不同延迟和内存预算。独立训练每个(变体,尺寸)组合成本过高，现有Boomerang蒸馏只能沿尺寸轴降低成本，仍将每个后训练变体视为独立优化对象。

Method: ADAPT包含两个组件：(1)两阶段蒸馏过程，通过预训练对齐和监督微调蒸馏构建后训练学生模型，实现尺寸-性能的平滑插值；(2)权重增量初始化，通过将蒸馏引起的权重变化从基础模型转移到从不同后训练变体初始化的学生模型，近似跨变体的构建过程。

Result: ADAPT能通过单次蒸馏运行生成L×K个模型。产生的插值模型连续体还支持推理时的自适应模型尺寸选择，在长形式推理任务上改善了计算-精度权衡。

Conclusion: ADAPT成功将蒸馏成本摊销扩展到"尺寸"和"后训练变体"两个维度，大幅降低构建多样化模型家族的成本，并额外带来推理时自适应尺寸选择的能力。

Abstract: Practical deployment of large language models (LLMs) requires families of post-trained variants---instruction-tuned, reasoning-tuned, and chat-style models---each at multiple sizes to meet diverse latency and memory budgets. Producing each (variant, size) pair independently is prohibitive, so model families typically span only a handful of coarse-grained sizes per post-trained variant. Boomerang distillation (Kangaslahti et al., 2026) reduces this cost along the size axis for base models. Through model size interpolation, it constructs models of intermediate sizes from a single teacher-student pair without additional training. However, it still treats each post-trained variant as a separate object of optimization. We introduce ADAPT---Amortized Distillation Across Post-Trained LLMs---a framework for amortizing distillation across both axes of a model family: size and post-training variant, producing $L \times K$ models for $L$ interpolated sizes across $K$ post-trained variants with a single distillation run. ADAPT combines two components. First, a two-phase distillation procedure constructs post-trained students through pre-training alignment and supervised fine-tuning distillation, enabling smooth size--performance interpolation on generation and reasoning tasks. Second, weight-delta initialization approximates this construction across post-trained variants by transferring the distillation-induced weight change from the base model to students initialized from different post-trained variants. The resulting continuum of interpolated models also enables adaptive model-size selection at inference time, improving the compute--accuracy trade-off for long-form reasoning tasks.

</details>


### [449] [Mapping the Concept Landscape: Structural Perception of Global Distributions for Transparent Data Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22858)
*Dongyue Wu,Tao Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出MCL（Mapping the Concept Landscape）框架，通过构建样本级和数据集级别的显式语义图来取代高维特征嵌入，实现透明且可解释的数据剪枝。该方法用贪心概念覆盖最大化算法选择样本，在多个基准上优于现有方法，同时提供可审计的选择过程。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有数据剪枝方法依赖高维特征嵌入来衡量样本重要性，但压缩向量会模糊细粒度的语义交互，导致罕见语义概念在剪枝子集中覆盖不足。

Method: 1) 将每个图像-文本对表示为包含实体、事件和属性的样本级显式图；2) 将个体图整合为数据集级图，刻画语义概念全局分布并量化其稀有度；3) 基于该结构化感知，设计贪心概念覆盖最大化算法，迭代选择能最大化高价值、低表示概念的边际增益的样本。

Result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，该方法在剪枝效率上优于最先进的方法，并能提供透明且可解释的选择过程审计轨迹。

Conclusion: MCL通过显式结构化语义图替代抽象嵌入，不仅提升了剪枝效率，还实现了可解释性和可审计性，为数据剪枝提供了新的结构化感知范式。

Abstract: Existing data pruning methods predominantly rely on high-dimensional feature embeddings to measure sample importance. However, these compressed vectors often obscure fine-grained semantic interactions, leading to suboptimal coverage of rare semantic concepts in the pruned subsets. In this paper, we propose Mapping the Concept Landscape (MCL), a novel structural perception framework for transparent data pruning. Instead of abstract embeddings, we represent each image-caption pair as an explicit sample-level graph comprising entities, events, and attributes. By integrating these individual graphs into a comprehensive dataset-level graph, we characterize the global distribution of semantic concepts and quantify their rarity across the entire corpus. Based on this structured perception, we develop a greedy concept-coverage maximization algorithm that iteratively selects samples to maximize the marginal gain of high-value, under-represented concepts. Experimental results on various benchmarks demonstrate that our method not only achieves superior pruning efficiency compared to state-of-the-art methods but also provides a transparent and interpretable audit trail for the selection process.

</details>


### [450] [Stochastic Separability of Embedding Manifolds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22874)
*Liqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了嵌入流形的随机可分性定理，通过两层级矩集中分析技术证明了高维神经空间中不同类别的对象嵌入流形在满足一定条件下可以以高概率线性分离，为神经科学和表示学习中观察到的实验现象提供了严格的理论基础。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经生物学和表示学习研究观察到，高维神经空间中同类别对象表征呈现低维流形特性，且不同对象流形可线性分离。然而这些实验观察到的现象至今缺乏严格的理论验证，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。

Method: 本文首先建立嵌入流形在一般条件下的投影测度集中定理，提出了一种新的两类矩集中分析技术，通过全期望定律统一两个估计界来推导测度集中不等式。基于该集中定理，进一步证明了两个不同类别嵌入流形的随机可分性定理。

Result: 证明了若两个数据集具有不同的均值和有界的总方差，在投影方向满足非奇异条件下，其样本能以高概率线性分离。研究成果包括：(1)利用两类尾部界不等式证明了高维空间中嵌入流形的投影集中性质；(2)识别了嵌入流形间随机可分性的非奇异条件，并严格证明了随机投影可分性定理。

Conclusion: 该定理不仅揭示了对象嵌入流形的几何和统计特性，还为深度网络中的表示学习提供了新的理论机制。

Abstract: Neurobiological studies and representation learning have observed that representations of objects belonging to the same category in high-dimensional neural spaces exhibit low-dimensional object manifold characteristics, and different object manifolds are linearly separable in these neural spaces. However, these experimentally observed phenomena lack rigorous theoretical validation to date.
  This paper proposes a new stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. First, we establish a projection measure concentration theorem for embedding manifolds under general conditions. We develop a new two-layer measure concentration analysis technique, which unifies two estimation bounds via the law of total expectation to derive measure concentration inequalities.
  Based on the measure concentration theorem, we further prove a stochastic separability theorem for embedding manifolds of two different object categories. If two datasets have distinct means and bounded total variances, their samples become linearly separable with high probability, provided that the projection direction satisfies a non-singularity condition.
  The main contributions of this paper are twofold:
  1. We prove the projection concentration properties of embedding manifolds in high-dimensional spaces by using two-lawyer tail-bound inequalities.
  2. We identify a non-singularity condition for the stochastic separability between embedding manifolds, and rigorously prove the stochastic projection separability theorem.
  The theorem not only uncovers geometric and statistical properties of the object embedding manifolds, but also provides a novel mechanism for representation learning in deep networks.

</details>


### [451] [The Mask Is Not the Model: Auditing Prefix Invariance in Attention, State-Space, and Hybrid Sequence Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22876)
*Taebong Kim,Youngsik Hong,Minsik Kim,Sunyoung Choi,Jaewon Jang,Minseo Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文形式化了前缀不变性（位置t的表示不能依赖未来输入），并提出一种轻量级审计方法：仅需两次前向传播、无需训练或梯度，即可精确定位因果关系破坏的位置。实验表明，注意力掩码检查不充分（泄漏可通过扫描或归一化发生），在192次注入故障试验中掩码检查全部漏检，而所提审计方法全部检出（192/192），并在Zamba2和Nemotron-H中发现真实缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有方法依赖注意力掩码检查来验证因果性，但掩码正确并不足以保证因果性——泄漏可能通过扫描操作或归一化等途径发生。因此需要一个更可靠、能精确定位因果破坏位置的审计方法。

Method: 提出"前缀不变性"的形式化定义，并设计一种轻量级审计方法：仅需两次前向传播（无需训练或梯度），通过比较不同输入配置下的表示变化来精确定位因果关系被破坏的具体位置。

Result: 在8个检查点上进行192次注入故障试验，掩码检查全部漏检（0/192），而所提出的审计方法全部准确定位（192/192），并在真实模型Zamba2和Nemotron-H中发现缺陷。

Conclusion: 注意力掩码检查不足以验证因果性；所提出的轻量级审计方法能够可靠、精确地检测和定位因果泄漏，可作为语言模型因果性验证的有效工具。

Abstract: We formalize prefix invariance: representations at position t must not depend on future inputs. We give a lightweight audit, two forward passes, no training or gradients, that localizes exactly where causality breaks. Attention-mask inspection is incomplete: leaks can occur via scans or normalization despite correct masks. Across 192 injected-fault trials on eight checkpoints, mask inspection found none, while our audit localized all 192/192, also finding a defect in Zamba2 and Nemotron-H.

</details>


### [452] [Safety Hacking in Constrained Best-of-$N$ Inference-time Scaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22915)
*Akifumi Wachi,Takumi Tanabe,Youhei Akimoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究推理时流水线（先采样多个输出，用学习到的安全模型过滤，再选最高奖励输出）中的"安全黑客"（safety hacking）问题：不安全但被代理模型误判为可行的输出可能在奖励最大化阶段被放大。作者推导了约束Beof-N采样下安全黑客的有限N上界，指出当不安全输出具有更重尾部时，随N增大安全黑客几乎必然发生，即使假阳性率和平均误差很小。并提出覆盖控制（coverage control）原则（如约束悲观采样）可在N无关的χ²散度界内限制放大，但不能修复被污染的可行集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法通常依赖安全模型的过滤与奖励模型的优选组合，但这一两阶段组合可能产生系统性失效：安全代理的缺陷污染可行集，奖励最大化又放大残留污染。作者希望量化这种失败机制并寻找缓解方法。

Method: 作者对约束Best-of-N采样推导有限N界，该界由代理可行集内安全与不安全输出的联合上尾奖励分布决定。随后证明与代理可行参考分布有边界χ²散度的策略存在N无关的安全黑客界，并将此覆盖控制原则实例化为约束悲观采样。

Result: 若代理可行集内不安全输出具有更重的奖励上尾，安全黑客随N增大渐近必然，即便假阳性质量和平均误差任意小。覆盖控制能限制放大但无法修复受污染的可行集；正则化选择并非对每个奖励代理都比约束Best-of-N更安全。玩具和语言模型实验验证了污染及其奖励尾放大效应。

Conclusion: 安全黑客是推理时扩展的根本性困难：安全代理的尾部行为决定风险，简单增加采样规模反而会增加风险。覆盖控制提供部分保护但本质局限使该问题难以完全解决。

Abstract: Inference-time pipelines often sample multiple outputs, filter them with a learned safety model, and return the proxy-feasible output with the highest learned reward. We show that this composition creates a two-stage failure: an imperfect safety proxy first contaminates the feasible set with unsafe outputs, and reward maximization can then amplify this residual contamination. We define \emph{safety hacking} as selecting an output that passes the learned constraint but violates the true safety criterion. For constrained Best-of-$N$ sampling, we derive finite-$N$ bounds governed by the joint upper reward tails of safe and unsafe outputs within the proxy-feasible set. If unsafe-but-feasible outputs have the heavier tail, safety hacking becomes asymptotically certain as $N$ grows, even when false-positive mass and average safety- and reward-proxy errors are arbitrarily small. We also show that policies within a bounded $χ^2$ divergence from the proxy-feasible reference distribution admit an $N$-independent safety-hacking bound, and instantiate this general coverage-control principle with constrained pessimistic sampling. Coverage control limits amplification but cannot repair a contaminated feasible set: admitted unsafe outputs may still be favored, and regularized selection is not necessarily safer than constrained Best-of-$N$ for every reward proxy. Toy and language-model experiments characterize both contamination and its reward-tail amplification, which exposes an inherent difficulty in inference-time scaling with learned safety models.

</details>


### [453] [A Momentum-Based Variance-Reduced Algorithm for Federated Multiobjective Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22945)
*Yong Zhao,Chunlin You,Minh N. Dao,Zai-Yun Peng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种基于动量的方差缩减算法用于联邦多目标优化（FMOO），通过动量驱动的梯度估计器降低随机梯度的方差，实现了O(T^{-2/3})的帕累托平稳性度量收敛速率，优于现有方法FSMGDA和FedCMOO的O(T^{-1/2})速率，并在基准测试中验证了其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统联邦学习被建模为单目标优化问题，仅关注模型效用最大化。然而实际应用中，机器学习模型往往需要同时优化多个可能冲突的目标。这促使研究者关注联邦多目标优化（FMOO），但现有方法（如FSMGDA和FedCMOO）的收敛速率仅为O(T^{-1/2})，仍有提升空间。

Method: 提出一种基于动量的方差缩减算法，在本地更新中引入动量驱动的梯度估计器来降低随机更新的方差，从而获得改进的收敛速率。

Result: 理论分析证明，随机选择的输出迭代点的期望帕累托平稳性度量以O(T^{-2/3})的速率衰减，显著优于现有方法FSMGDA和FedCMOO的O(T^{-1/2})速率。数值实验在联邦多目标优化基准上展示了所提算法的有效性和竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 基于动量的方差缩减方法能够有效加速联邦多目标优化问题的收敛，在理论上和实验上都验证了其优越性。

Abstract: Federated learning has traditionally been formulated as a single-objective optimization problem, primarily focused on maximizing model utility. In real-world applications, however, machine learning models often need to optimize multiple and potentially conflicting objectives simultaneously. This motivates federated multiobjective optimization (FMOO), which provides a natural framework for jointly handling multiple task-specific objectives in federated learning. In this paper, we propose a momentum-based variance-reduced algorithm for federated multiobjective optimization. The method incorporates a momentum-driven gradient estimator into the local updates to reduce the variance of stochastic updates, leading to an improved convergence rate. We establish theoretical guarantees showing that the expected Pareto stationarity measure of a randomly selected output iterate decays at a rate of $\mathcal{O}(T^{-2/3})$, improving upon the $\mathcal{O}(T^{-1/2})$ rates established for existing methods such as FSMGDA and FedCMOO. Numerical experiments on federated multiobjective optimization benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and competitive performance of the proposed algorithm.

</details>


### [454] [Stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22953)
*Nabil Kahalé*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文分析了一种带初始正则化的随机梯度下降（SGDIR）变体，推导了其在平方损失下期望过剩风险的无维度上界。在无噪声情况下，获得了均值和未均值SGDIR的新界；在有噪声情况下，证明了SGDIR的期望过剩风险在特定条件下不超过岭回归。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随机梯度下降（SGD）是机器学习中广泛使用的最优化方法，但其在正则化/早期停止策略下的理论收敛性质（尤其是维度无关的界）仍有待深入理解。本文旨在分析一种带初始正则化的SGD变体（SGDIR），在矩条件、源条件和容量假设下推导其期望过剩风险的精确上界和下界，并与经典的岭回归方法进行比较。

Method: 本文采用理论分析方法：1) 在无噪声情况下，分别对均值（averaged）和未均值（non-averaged）SGDIR推导期望过剩风险的维度无关上界，涉及矩、源和容量三组假设；2) 建立匹配的下界（在特定区域达到pologarithmic因子范围内的一致）；3) 在有噪声情况下，给出SGDIR与岭回归的基于实例（instance-based）比较，在一般假设和正则化参数的下界条件下，证明SGDIR的期望过剩风险不高于岭回归。最后通过合成数据与真实数据的数值实验验证理论结论。

Result: 1) 在无噪声情况下，对特定源参数值获得了阶为$m^{-2}\log^2 m$的界；对另一源参数值，当容量参数超过$\epsilon^{-1}$时，获得$m^{-3+\epsilon}$阶的界（对任意$\epsilon>0$）。2) 建立了与上界匹配（至多差对数因子）的下界。3) 在有噪声情形下，证明在一般假设和正则化参数温和下界条件下，SGDIR的期望过剩风险不超过岭回归（至多差pologarithmic因子）。数值实验与理论一致。

Conclusion: SGDIR在无噪声和有噪声情况下均展现出良好的理论保证，其收敛率在特定设定下优于一般SGD，并可媲美或超过岭回归的表现。维度无关的界表明SGDIR在高维场景下具有优势。

Abstract: We analyze a variant of stochastic gradient descent with initial regularization (SGDIR) and derive dimension-free upper bounds on its expected excess risk for the squared loss. In the noiseless case, we obtain new bounds for both averaged and non-averaged SGDIR under moment, source, and capacity assumptions. For a particular value of the source parameter, these bounds are of order $m^{-2}\log^{2}m$, where the number of training samples is of order $m$. For another value of the source parameter, we obtain, for any $ε>0$, bounds of order $m^{-3+ε}$, provided that the capacity parameter exceeds $ε^{-1}$. We also establish a lower bound that matches our upper bounds in certain regimes up to a polylogarithmic factor. In the noisy case, we provide an instance-based comparison between SGDIR and ridge regression. Under general assumptions and a mild lower bound on the regularization parameter, we show that the expected excess risk of SGDIR is no larger than that of ridge regression, up to a polylogarithmic factor. Numerical experiments on synthetic and real data are consistent with our theoretical findings.

</details>


### [455] [Do Time-Series Foundation Models Pay Off for Industrial Monitoring? A Cost-Aware Empirical Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22968)
*Guan-Hua Wen,Kuan-Yu Chen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文在三个工业监控场景（C-MAPSS退化风险、MIMII异常声音检测、BDG2预测残差诊断）中对时间序列基础模型（TSFM）与经典轻量级模型进行了协议感知的实证评估，发现TSFM在零样本冻结设置下并非默认替代品，仅在特定任务中具有部署价值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业监控模型需要满足目标特定的数据、校准和资源约束，而TSFM虽承诺可复用表示和零样本预测，但在任务定义异构且轻量基线有竞争力的情况下，其部署价值证据混杂，缺乏系统的协议感知评估。

Method: 在三个场景中评估六类方法：经典单类方法、紧凑神经自编码器、残差预测器、MOMENT-small、Chronos-T5和TimesFM 2.5。评估指标涵盖异常排序性能、风险时域敏感性、残差预测与扰动敏感性、本地实现成本，并采用折叠外验证、配对引擎簇自助置信区间和同设备测量等方法保证严谨性。

Result: C-MAPSS上TCN-AE达到折叠加权AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960，远超MOMENT重建的0.7310/0.3080；MIMII上OCSVM优于MOMENT重建；BDG2上TimesFM 2.5具有最低对齐预测误差和最高合成AUROC点估计，但合成AUPRC各模型相近；MOMENT在延迟、峰值VRAM和状态字典大小上均高于TCN-AE。

Conclusion: 在评估的冻结和零样本设置下，TSFM是任务依赖的部署选项而非轻量拟合模型的默认替代品；其价值需结合具体任务、资源约束和基线竞争力来综合判断。

Abstract: Industrial monitoring models must detect operationally relevant deviations while satisfying target-specific data, calibration, and resource constraints. Time-series foundation models (TSFMs) promise reusable representations and zero-shot forecasts, yet evidence for their deployment value remains mixed when task definitions are heterogeneous and lightweight baselines are competitive. This work presents a protocol-aware empirical assessment across three settings: a C-MAPSS degradation-risk proxy, normal-only training for anomalous-sound detection on MIMII, and BDG2 forecasting-residual diagnostics with synthetic target perturbations. We assess classical one-class methods, compact neural autoencoders, residual forecasters, MOMENT-small, Chronos-T5, and TimesFM 2.5 in terms of anomaly-ranking performance, risk-horizon sensitivity, residual forecasting and perturbation sensitivity, and local implementation cost. Across 100 C-MAPSS engines evaluated out of fold, TCN-AE reaches fold-weighted AUROC/AUPRC 0.9570/0.8960, compared with 0.7310/0.3080 for MOMENT reconstruction; paired engine-cluster bootstrap confidence intervals exclude zero for both differences. Across five matched MIMII pump evaluations, OCSVM also exceeds MOMENT reconstruction in AUROC and AUPRC. On a fixed 12-meter BDG2 panel, TimesFM 2.5 has the lowest aligned forecast error and the highest synthetic AUROC point estimate, although synthetic AUPRC is similar across TSFM and fitted residual models. Same-device measurements show that MOMENT incurs higher latency, peak allocated VRAM, and serialized state-dictionary size than TCN-AE. Under the evaluated frozen and zero-shot settings, TSFMs are task-dependent deployment options rather than default replacements for fitted lightweight models.

</details>


### [456] [Hierarchy-Aware Semantic Losses for Knowledge Graph Link Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22981)
*Filip Kronström,Ross D. King*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估了基于盒嵌入（box embeddings）的层级感知语义损失在知识图谱链接预测中的效果。在AIFB、CoDEx和BioKG三个基准数据集上，该方法相比基线GNN模型在MRR上分别提升7.6%、2.4%和15.5%，且持续优于将子类关系作为图边增强的方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 知识图谱通常伴随本体类层级结构，包含有价值的语义信息，但许多链接预测方法要么忽略这些层级，要么仅通过额外图边间接融入。此前层级感知GNN在生物回归任务中表现良好，但其在链接预测中的有效性尚未被研究。

Method: 将图神经网络编码器与基于盒嵌入的语义损失相结合，通过语义损失鼓励学习到的表示更好地满足本体派生的类层级关系，并与标准链接预测模型及将子类关系作为图边纳入的模型进行对比。
