Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in education, healthcare, policy advising, and other interactive settings, where users engage them as sustained social interlocutors rather than one-shot query engines. This shift makes jailbreaks a growing safety threat, yet most research emphasizes single-turn prompt optimization or iterative attack refinement, leaving psychologically grounded multi-turn vulnerabilities underexplored. We present PsychJail, a psychology-guided framework for red teaming aligned LLMs through theory-grounded, multi-turn persuasion. PsychJail maps established social-psychological persuasion techniques into a tactic-conditioned attack policy. It factorizes each attacker action into a Change-of-Meaning analysis, tactic selection, and victim-visible message, operationalizing the Persuasion Knowledge Model (PKM). The policy is refined with trajectory-level reinforcement learning using a PKM-gated reward that credits early jailbreak success only when every turn contains a well-formed Change-of-Meaning analysis. Across four aligned victim models, PsychJail achieves the highest average attack success rate (87.3%) and outperforms strong single-turn and multi-turn baselines on every model. We also measure susceptibility at the action that breaks each victim, revealing four distinct model-level fingerprints that identify which persuasion levers affect each model and how broadly. These fingerprints help explain cross-model transfer asymmetry. We interpret them as four candidate psychological profiles-rationalist, credibility-driven, narrative-monoculture, and broadly persuadable-while treating this interpretation as a conjecture requiring future validation. Our findings establish psychological jailbreaks as a distinct red-teaming frontier for increasingly interactive LLMs.

</details>


### [625] [Artificial Empathy: Towards a Framework for Unsupervised Agency Detection and Policy Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23030)
*Peter Kuhn,Chris Pang,Sonakshi Chauhan*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个框架，利用在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为先验，从纯观察中识别环境中其他智能体（代理检测）并重建其策略（策略重建），这比逆强化学习约束更少，是实现现实世界合作行为的关键能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实世界中AI需要从观察中识别并建模其他智能体以实现合作行为。这一问题比逆强化学习（IRL）约束更少，且尚未被充分探索。

Method: 提出一个框架，使用在独立任务上训练的强化学习智能体作为智能体动力学（agentic dynamics）的先验，用于执行代理检测和策略重建。

Result: （论文摘要未明确给出具体实验结果，主要提出了该框架和问题定义。）

Conclusion: 该框架展示了利用RL智能体作为先验来解决代理检测和策略重建这一欠约束问题的可行性，为AI系统理解环境中其他智能体提供了新的路径。

Abstract: We study how an AI system can identify and model other agents in its environment from observation alone, which is a capability necessary for cooperative behaviour in the real world. This problem is less constrained than inverse reinforcement learning and remains largely unexplored. We propose a framework that uses a reinforcement learning agent, trained on an independent task as a prior about agentic dynamics, to perform agency detection and policy reconstruction.

</details>


### [626] [MobilePA-Bench: Benchmarking Mobile Planner Agents on Complex Real-World Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23035)
*Yi Zhu,Xiongwei Wu,Qiyi Wang,Tingyu Qu,Jiajun Liu,Sihan Cao,Long Chen,Weigao Sun,Feida Zhu,Yiran Zhong,Steven Hoi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: MobilePA-Bench是一个交互式、有状态、以工具为中心的移动端agent基准测试框架，在可执行的沙盒环境中评估工具调用和规划能力，涵盖13个功能域和212个真实移动工具，并针对子代理协作、记忆使用和技能使用三个高级维度进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有移动端LLM agent基准测试存在两派且各有盲区：GUI-centric基准只测试表面屏幕操作而忽视后台工具使用和长程规划；静态函数调用基准依赖离线API匹配，脱离真实运行时约束。需要弥合这一差距的评测体系。

Method: 构建可执行沙盒环境，维护实时应用数据库并返回结构化反馈。除基础工具使用外，沿三个高级维度评估规划agent：子代理协作（任务分解与委派）、记忆使用（回忆存储记忆和用户偏好）、技能使用（调用预打包复合技能）。结合基于证据的验证机制。

Result: 实验表明当前前沿LLM在移动端场景中仍不可靠：在严格的工具排序、权限限制和意外运行时错误下性能急剧下降。

Conclusion: MobilePA-Bench既是实用的诊断基准，也是agentic强化学习的交互基础，可加速可靠移动agent的开发。

Abstract: As on-device LLM agents evolve into personal copilots, the mobile operating system has become a key testbed for this paradigm, making rigorous capability evaluation essential. Yet existing benchmarks fall into two camps, each with a critical blind spot: GUI-centric benchmarks test surface-level screen manipulation while overlooking background tool use and long-horizon planning, whereas static function-calling benchmarks rely on offline API matching that is detached from real runtime constraints. To close this gap, we present \textbf{MobilePA-Bench}, an interactive, stateful, and tool-centric benchmark for evaluating the tool-calling and planning abilities of mobile planning agents. MobilePA-Bench runs on an executable sandbox that maintains live application databases and returns structured feedback, spanning $13$ functional domains and $212$ realistic mobile tools. Beyond basic tool use, it evaluates a central planning agent along three advanced dimensions: \emph{(1)~Sub-agent Collaboration}---decomposing a complex task and delegating specialized work to capable sub-agents; \emph{(2)~Memory Usage}---recalling stored memories, user profiles, and past preferences to resolve implicit requests; and \emph{(3)~Skill Usage}---invoking pre-packaged composite skills instead of planning every step from scratch. Extensive experiments show that current frontier LLMs remain unreliable in mobile settings: performance drops sharply under strict tool ordering, permission limits, and unexpected runtime errors. By pairing an interactive function-calling sandbox with evidence-based verification, MobilePA-Bench serves as both a practical diagnostic benchmark and an interactive foundation for agentic reinforcement learning---accelerating the development of dependable mobile agents.

</details>


### [627] [From Inertia to Objectivity: Improving Deep Research Agents with Noise Isolation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23045)
*Xiangxin Zhang,Zhanwei Zhang,Zhihang Fu,Binbin Lin,Wenxiao Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出"惯性偏差"（inertia bias）这一概念，指LLM驱动的搜索智能体在评估自身先前行动后果时失去客观性的失败模式。作者构建IBIS基准来衡量该偏差，并提出NIS-Agent框架通过上下文隔离（在网页分类和最终答案验证两个决策点）来缓解此问题，同时训练了一个对惯性偏差更具抵抗力的8B模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度研究任务中，LLM搜索智能体存在一个反复出现的失败模式：一旦智能体产生了查询、计划或中间结论，它在后续评判同一行动后果时会变得不够客观。这种"自我行动历史扭曲后续判断"的系统性偏差需要被定义、测量并解决。

Method: 1) 提出惯性偏差概念并构建IBIS基准，通过控制搜索观察、变化模型是否评估自身先前行动的结果来量化偏差；2) 提出NIS-Agent框架，在网页分类（webpage triage）和最终答案验证两个最易受惯性偏差影响的决策点实施上下文隔离；3) 训练一个对惯性偏差内在抵抗力更强的8B模型。

Result: 研究发现模型在"拥有"先前搜索步骤时表现显著更差，证明自我撰写的行动历史会系统性地扭曲后续判断。惯性偏差还会传播为两种系统级退化：worker级别的搜索噪声和manager级别的上下文噪声。NIS-Agent在GAIA、WebWalkerQA、BrowseComp和BrowseComp-zh上取得有竞争力的性能，同时token成本降低33%。训练的8B模型在NIS-Agent框架下达到与GPT-4o相当的平均性能。

Conclusion: 惯性偏差是LLM搜索智能体面临的一个真实且可量化的系统性缺陷，NIS-Agent的上下文隔离策略能有效缓解该偏差，且更小的模型通过针对性训练也能在深度研究任务上获得强大性能。

Abstract: Web search agents powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) show strong promise, but deep research tasks expose a recurring failure mode: once an agent has produced a query, plan, or intermediate conclusion, it becomes less objective when later judging the consequences of that same action. We term this phenomenon \textbf{inertia bias}. To make it measurable, we introduce the IBIS benchmark, which controls the search observations while varying whether the model is evaluating the outcome of its own prior action. We find that models are substantially worse when they ``own'' the preceding search step, showing that self-authored action history can systematically distort subsequent judgment. We further show that this bias propagates into two forms of system-level degradation: search noise at the worker level and contextual noise at the manager level. To address this problem, we propose NIS-Agent, which applies context isolation at the two decision points most vulnerable to inertia bias: webpage triage and final-answer validation. Across GAIA, WebWalkerQA, BrowseComp, and BrowseComp-zh, NIS-Agent achieves competitive performance while reducing token cost by 33\% compared to our baseline. We further train an 8B model to be intrinsically more resistant to inertia bias; under the same NIS-Agent framework, it attains average performance comparable to GPT-4o on deep research benchmarks.

</details>


### [628] [LLM-based Agents for Forecasting and Prediction: Methods, Training, Evaluation, and Applications](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23058)
*Xiaogang Xu,Jiaqi Tang,Jianmin Chen,Yingying Yan,Zhenchao Tang,Xiangxin Zhou,Xiaobin Hu,Wei Wei,Jinfeng Wu,Qifeng Chen,Lu Zhou,Jiafei Wu,Zhe Liu,Jianwei Yin,Weimin Zheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文综述了基于大语言模型（LLM）的预测智能体系统，将架构分为三类：独立LLM工作流、工具/检索增强智能体、以及LLM与统计或基础模型结合的混合系统。文章还回顾了训练方法、评估协议及应用领域（金融、天气、健康、能源、运营），并强调测量是核心限制，提出未来需关注分布偏移下的校准、抗污染的实时评估等方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着LLM被广泛用于预测系统，需要系统性地整理和评估这些系统的架构多样性、证据强度及局限性，以指导未来研究方向。

Method: 采用系统综述方法，将LLM预测智能体架构归类为三类（独立工作流、工具/检索增强、混合系统），并同时审查训练方法、评估协议、正面与负面证据（如输入扰动敏感性、消融实验、基准污染），以及各应用领域的数据集与基准。

Result: 发现测量是当前研究的核心瓶颈；负面证据表明LLM组件有时并未提升预测精度，部分基准增益可能源于数据污染而非真正的时序推理能力。

Conclusion: 未来工作需要：分布偏移下的校准、抗污染的实时评估、成本与精度的联合报告，以及处理部署预测与结果之间反馈循环的方法。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) now support forecasting systems that combine language-based reasoning with temporal data, evidence retrieval, external tools, and iterative prediction. We investigate LLM-based forecasting agents, meaning systems in which a language model contributes to a scored prediction about a future or currently unobserved target. We organize architectures into three groups. Standalone LLM workflows operate on encoded time series or event context. Tool- and retrieval-augmented agents incorporate external evidence. Hybrid systems pair LLMs with statistical or foundation models. We then review training methods and evaluation protocols. We examine negative as well as positive evidence, including sensitivity to small input perturbations, ablations in which the LLM component does not improve accuracy, and benchmark gains that may reflect contamination instead of temporal reasoning. We cover applications in finance, weather, health, energy, and operations, and we summarize the benchmarks and datasets used for evaluation. The evidence indicates that measurement is a central limitation. Future work requires calibration under distribution shift, contamination-resistant live evaluation, explicit reporting of cost and accuracy together, and methods for handling feedback between deployed forecasts and the outcomes being forecast.

</details>


### [629] [Improving O-RADS Risk Stratification from Ultrasound Reports: A Comparative Evaluation of Hybrid versus End-to-End LLM Reasoning Strategies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23061)
*Xiaotong Tan,Chunli Qiu,Xin Liu,Qing Huang,Guangli Zhou,Bo Gao,Xiaoyan Song,Shuyan Wang,Xiuqin Wang,Wufeng Xue,Ruobing Huang,Dong Ni,Guowei Tao,Jun Cheng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究比较了8种大语言模型（LLMs）和三种推理策略在自动化O-RADS分类方面的表现。基于特征的混合架构（分离特征提取与规则分类）使用Gemini 3.6 Flash取得了最佳性能，准确率达99.2%，加权kappa=1.00，显著优于原始临床报告（87.7%）和端到端LLM策略（65.6%-95.9%）。该架构减少了误分类错误并缓解了过度分期倾向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自动化临床指南决策仍然面临可靠性、幻觉和可解释性有限等挑战，亟需探索更优的LLM推理策略来实现基于指南的自动化临床决策。

Method: 回顾性纳入310名女性共390个卵巢肿块患者。测试8种LLM，采用三种推理策略：隐知识端到端、规则引导端到端、以及基于特征的混合架构（将特征提取与基于规则的分类分离）。以专家共识建立的O-RADS分类为参考标准。

Result: 基于特征的混合架构使用Gemini 3.6 Flash表现最佳：准确率99.2%（387/390），加权kappa=1.00（95%CI: 0.99-1.00），超越原始临床报告（87.7%）和端到端LLM策略（65.6%-95.9%）。结构化特征提取方面，Gemini 3.6 Flash优于Claude Fable 5（98.9% vs 97.8%，P<0.001）。

Conclusion: 将临床特征提取与确定性指南执行分离的基于特征的混合LLM架构，能实现高准确率、可靠且可解释的自动化O-RADS分类，为标准化、基于指南的临床决策提供了有前景的方法。

Abstract: Background: Automating clinical guideline-based decision-making with large language models (LLMs) remains challenging because of reliability, hallucination, and limited interpretability. We compared the performance of LLMs and reasoning strategies for automated Ovarian-Adnexal Reporting and Data System (O-RADS) classification from free-text pelvic ultrasound reports. Methods: In this retrospective study, consecutive patients with ovarian masses who underwent pelvic ultrasound were included. Eight LLMs were tested with three reasoning strategies: implicit-knowledge end-to-end, rule-informed end-to-end, and a feature-based hybrid architecture that decoupled feature extraction from rule-based classification. The reference standard was O-RADS categorization established by expert consensus. Results: A total of 310 women with 390 ovarian masses were evaluated. The feature-based hybrid architecture using Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated the best performance, achieving an accuracy of 99.2% (387 of 390) and almost perfect agreement with the reference standard (weighted kappa = 1.00; 95% CI: 0.99-1.00). Its performance surpassed that of original clinical reports (accuracy, 87.7% [342 of 390]; weighted kappa = 0.94; 95% CI: 0.91-0.96) and end-to-end LLM strategies (accuracy range, 65.6% [256 of 390] to 95.9% [374 of 390]). For structured feature extraction, Gemini 3.6 Flash demonstrated higher overall accuracy than Claude Fable 5 (98.9% vs 97.8%; P < 0.001). The hybrid architecture reduced misclassification errors and mitigated the overstaging tendency observed in original reports. Conclusion: The feature-based hybrid LLM architecture that separates clinical feature extraction from deterministic guideline execution enables highly accurate, reliable, and interpretable automated O-RADS classification, providing a promising approach for standardized, guideline-based clinical decision-making.

</details>


### [630] [From Generation to Simulation: How Far Are World Models from Being True Simulators?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23070)
*Tong Wang,Huan Deng,Mucheng Yang,Yang He,Xiaohui Kuang,Gang Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一项基于能力的系统性研究，以传统模拟器的八项能力为标准，对2018年至2026年6月的200篇世界模型代表性工作进行映射分析，评估生成式世界模型替代传统模拟器的差距，并指出状态反馈是最被忽视的短板，提出六个未来研究方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着扩散模型和大规模视频生成的快速发展，生成式世界模型日益被期望替代物理引擎、游戏引擎和强化学习环境等传统模拟器，但"从生成到模拟"的距离缺乏系统性评估。

Method: 采用基于能力的研究框架，以传统模拟器的八项能力（资产构建、物理引擎、交互、可控性、稳定性、状态反馈、多样性、评估指标）作为外部标尺，追踪隐式动力学、视频生成、联合嵌入预测三条技术路线，对200篇论文进行能力映射分析。

Result: 世界模型在特定场景的交互和可控性上已实现功能替代，但在物理规律的正式保证、结构化状态反馈和可复现的长时序演化方面仍落后于传统模拟器；在163篇实现论文中仅6篇暴露了查询实体状态或物理参数的运行时接口，状态反馈是跨路线最被忽视的短板。

Conclusion: 提出六个研究方向：形式化物理、统一动作接口、一等公民状态反馈、长时序稳定性、下游效用评估和跨路线混合，以推动世界模型从生成走向真正可用的模拟器。

Abstract: With the rapid progress of diffusion models and large-scale video generation, generative world models are increasingly expected to replace traditional simulators, including physics engines, game engines, and reinforcement-learning environments. Yet the remaining distance from generation to simulation lacks a systematic assessment. We present a capability-based study using an external yardstick: eight capabilities of a traditional simulator, namely asset construction, physics engine, interaction, controllability, stability, state feedback, diversity, and evaluation metrics. We trace three main technical routes--latent dynamics, video generation, and joint-embedding prediction--and map exactly 200 representative works published from 2018 to June 2026 onto these capabilities. Our analysis shows that world models have achieved functional substitution in interaction and controllability for specific scenarios, but remain short of traditional simulators in formal guarantees of physical laws, structured state feedback, and reproducible long-horizon evolution. State feedback is the most neglected cross-route shortcoming: only 6 of 163 implementation papers expose a runtime interface for querying entity states or physical parameters. We identify six research directions: formalized physics, a unified action interface, first-class state feedback, long-horizon stability, downstream-utility evaluation, and cross-route hybridization. Project page: https://github.com/AtongWang/world-model-simulators

</details>


### [631] [AgentWeave: Routing Before Reasoning for Efficient Function Calling in Tool-Rich Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23078)
*Saurav Singla,Aarav Singla,Advik Gupta,Parnika Gupta*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AgentWeave是一个确定性的推理前路由层，通过资格、需求、能力和路由信号构建有界的模型可见动作空间，在冻结模型上使BFCL V4多函数任务成功率从0/48提升至6/48，同时减少70.18%的工具暴露、61.70%的输入token和50.95%的延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型日益需要处理大量工具、函数、API和智能体。随着候选动作空间增长，函数调用模型必须处理更多schema、消耗更多提示token，并区分越来越相似或不相关的备选项。现有方法通常聚焦于改进模型本身，而非在推理前减少候选工具集。

Method: AgentWeave作为确定性推理前路由层，在语言模型推理之前构造一个有界的模型可见动作空间。它利用四类信号：资格信号（eligibility）、需求信号（requirement）、能力信号（capability）和路由信号（routing），来筛选候选工具。评估中使用冻结的BFCL派生路由压力协议和公共MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b模型，不修改下游模型。

Result: 在48个BFCL V4多函数任务上：AgentWeave实现6/48（12.5%）原生BFCL成功，而all-tools、确定性随机top-8和语义top-8基线均为0/48。配对成功差异+12.5个百分点，bootstrap 95%置信区间为+4.17至+22.92，精确McNemar p=0.03125。相比全部工具暴露，AgentWeave减少70.18%工具、61.70%输入token，并降低50.95%平均本地模型延迟。

Conclusion: 候选空间构建能实质性影响固定模型的函数调用行为，且绝对任务成功率仍然较低。这提示应将路由（routing）视为模型推理之前的独立阶段进行评估，而不是仅关注模型本身的能力提升。该研究是刻意狭窄的BFCL派生路由压力研究，而非官方完整BFCL排行榜分数。

Abstract: Large language models increasingly operate over large collections of tools, functions, APIs, and specialized agents. As the candidate action space grows, a function-calling model must process more schemas, consume more prompt tokens, and distinguish among increasingly similar or irrelevant alternatives. We study a complementary systems strategy: reduce the candidate set before language-model inference while leaving the downstream model unchanged. We introduce AgentWeave, a deterministic pre-inference routing layer that constructs a bounded model-visible action space using eligibility, requirement, capability, and routing signals. We evaluate AgentWeave with a frozen BFCL-derived routing-pressure protocol using the public MadeAgents/Hammer2.1-1.5b model. On 48 fresh BFCL V4 multiple-function tasks, AgentWeave achieves 6/48 (12.5%) native BFCL successes, whereas all-tools, deterministic random top-8, and semantic top-8 baselines each achieve 0/48. The paired success difference is +12.5 percentage points with a 10,000-resample paired bootstrap 95% confidence interval of +4.17 to +22.92 points and exact McNemar p=0.03125. Relative to all-tools exposure, AgentWeave presents 70.18% fewer tools, uses 61.70% fewer input tokens, and exhibits 50.95% lower mean local-model latency. The result is deliberately narrow: this is a BFCL-derived routing-pressure study rather than an official full BFCL leaderboard score, and absolute task success remains low. The evidence nevertheless shows that candidate-space construction can materially affect a fixed model's function-calling behavior and motivates evaluating routing as a distinct stage before model reasoning.

</details>


### [632] [POOL: Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23086)
*Rounak Sharma,Ananya B. Sai,Soumyabrata Pal*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出POOL框架,一种基于群体检测思想的成本高效置信度估计方法,通过聚类查询茎、对代表性medoid进行评估、软传播置信度分数,并选择性评估高分歧案例。同时提出Hy@p混合估计器,结合口头置信度与基于负von Neumann熵的谱答案多样性。实验表明Hy@5在六个领域、五个黑盒LLM上取得更高AUROC,且POOL-Hy@5在保留93.5-97.9% AUROC的同时节省19.3-39.3%的生成成本。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有置信度估计器面临成本-质量权衡:口头置信度便宜但常过度自信,基于采样的不确定性更有信息量但成本随每查询样本数线性增长。需要一个能在保持高质量的同时降低成本的框架。

Method: 提出POOL框架,受群体检测思想启发,将查询茎聚类,在代表medoid上评估基础估计器,将置信度分数软传播到邻近查询,并选择性评估高分歧案例。同时提出Hy@p混合估计器,结合口头置信度与从采样答案嵌入的负von Neumann熵计算出的谱答案多样性。

Result: 在三个数据集六个领域、五个黑盒LLM上,Hy@5的平均AUROC高于口头置信度和Vn@10采样,且仅用Vn@10一半的样本。POOL-Hy@5保留93.5-97.9%的AUROC,节省19.3-39.3%的生成量。在释义密集工作负载上,生成节约达73-76%。

Conclusion: 语义冗余可以被利用来降低置信度估计成本,POOL框架有效平衡了置信度估计的质量与成本权衡,特别在存在语义相似查询的场景中收益显著。

Abstract: Black-box large language models need confidence scores that can separate likely-correct from likely-incorrect outputs, enabling systems to prioritize human review, route uncertain cases to stronger models, or choose abstention thresholds on development data. Yet existing confidence estimators face a cost-quality trade-off: verbal confidence is cheap but is often overconfident, while sampling-based uncertainty is more informative but scales linearly with the number of samples per query. We propose \textsc{POOL} (\emph{Propagated Uncertainty Over Lookalikes}),a cost-efficient framework that addresses this trade-off taking inspiration from group-testing.\textsc{POOL} clusters query stems with overlaps, evaluates a base estimator on representative medoids, softly propagates confidence scores to nearby queries, and selectively evaluates high-disagreement cases. We instantiate this framework with \textsc{Hy@}$p$, a hybrid estimator that combines verbal confidence with spectral answer diversity computed from the negative von Neumann entropy of sampled answer embeddings.Across six domains from three datasets and five black-box LLMs, \textsc{Hy@}5 achieves higher average AUROC than verbal confidence and \textsc{Vn@}10 sampling while using half as many samples as \textsc{Vn@}10. \textsc{POOL}-\textsc{Hy@}5 retains 93.5--97.9\% of its AUROC while saving 19.3--39.3\% of generations. On paraphrase-dense workloads, generation savings rise to 73-76\%, showing that semantic redundancy can be leveraged to lower confidence-estimation costs.

</details>


### [633] [Jiuge-Tuiqiao: An Interpretable Human-AI System for Classical Chinese Poetry Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23098)
*Yufeng Han,Lifan Deng,Cunliang Kong,Wenhao Li,Xin Cong,Yuzhuo Bai,Kangyang Luo,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Jiuge-Tuiqiao，一个交互式人机协作的古典诗词创作系统，围绕"用户驱动控制-古籍证据引导-AI辅助生成"的三元模型设计，将AI从自主生成器转变为辅助用户推敲润色的后台助手，支持用户锁定字词/诗句、实时获取格律反馈和可解释的改进建议，初步实验表明该系统提升了可控性、可解释性和用户参与度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 古典诗词创作历来重视"推敲"（字词、意象、格律的迭代精炼），但当前许多AI诗词系统采用一次性生成范式，将用户降级为提示提供者，削弱了用户的创作能动性。

Method: 设计了三元协作模型：(1) 用户驱动控制——用户可锁定字词或诗句；(2) 古籍引导证据——基于高频搭配、PPL排序的经典诗句以及从古典类书中提取的结构化知识提供可解释的改进建议；(3) AI辅助生成——实时格律反馈，AI作为后台助手而非自主生成器。

Result: 初步实验和用户反馈表明，Jiuge-Tuiqiao在古典诗词创作中提升了可控性、可解释性和用户参与度。

Conclusion: 将AI定位为辅助推敲的后台工具而非自主生成器，能够更好地支持用户在古典诗词创作中的主动性与创造性，为人机协作创作提供了新的范式。

Abstract: Classical Chinese poetry composition has long valued Tuiqiao, the iterative refinement of words, imagery, and prosody. However, many current AI poetry systems follow a one-shot generation paradigm, which reduces users to prompt providers and weakens their creative agency. We present Jiuge-Tuiqiao, an interactive human-AI collaborative system for classical Chinese poetry composition. The system is designed around a triadic model: user-driven control, ancient-guided evidence, and AI-assisted generation. Users can lock characters or lines, receive real-time prosody feedback, and obtain interpretable refinement suggestions grounded in high-frequency collocations, PPL-ranked classical lines, and structured knowledge extracted from classical encyclopedias. This design turns AI from an autonomous generator into a background assistant that supports the user's own process of poetic refinement. Preliminary experiments and user feedback suggest that Jiuge-Tuiqiao improves controllability, interpretability, and user engagement in classical poetry composition.

</details>


### [634] [AI emotional support is better only when chosen, but shifts preferences even when it is not](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23196)
*Yaoxi Shi,Cathy Mengying Fang,Guy LabanPattie Maes,Amit Goldenberg*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过三项实验（N=1,951）和一项为期28天的纵向研究（N=981），检验情感支持来源（人类vs AI）与个人选择一致性（一致/不一致）对支持评价和后续偏好的影响。结果发现AI支持仅在人们主动选择它时才被评价优于人类；但无论选择是否一致，与AI互动都会提高再次选择AI的意愿。28天日常对话研究显示，对话越个人化，偏好越从人类转向AI，表明情感支持选择具有路径依赖性，逐步远离人类联结。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有研究显示AI的共情信息评分与人类相当甚至更优，但这些研究要么由实验者指定支持来源，要么尊重参与者的选择，忽略了现实世界中人们想要的支持来源与实际获得的来源常常不一致的情况。作者旨在探究这种"选择-实际"不一致对支持评价和长期偏好变化的影响。

Method: 采用三项受控实验（N=1,951）：参与者先选择与人类或AI分享情感经历，然后被随机分配至一致或不一致的支持伙伴，评估支持质量及再次选择意愿。随后进行一项为期28天、与OpenAI的纵向日记研究（N=981），跟踪日常对话中偏好变化，并通过对话个人化程度进行调节分析。

Result: AI支持仅在参与者主动选择AI时才获得更优评价（选择一致性效应）。无论选择是否一致，与AI互动都提高了再次选择AI的意愿。28天纵向研究中，日常对话使偏好从人类转向AI，但这一效应仅在对话变得个人化时出现。

Conclusion: 情感支持的选择具有路径依赖性：使用AI会持续增加未来选择AI的可能性，逐渐将人从人际联结中引开。这一发现对AI共情研究的解读提出了重要修正——AI的表面优势依赖于选择情境，且使用行为本身会产生递增偏好的反馈循环。

Abstract: People increasingly face a novel decision when seeking emotional support: human or AI. In existing studies, AI's empathic messages are rated as well as or better than humans'. But these studies either assigned the support source or honored people's choice. In real life, support is often incongruent with choice, as people want one source and receive the other. Across three experiments (N = 1,951), participants chose whether to share an emotional experience with a human or an AI, then were randomly assigned to a congruent or incongruent partner. AI support was rated as superior only among those who had chosen it. Yet regardless of congruence, interacting with AI increased willingness to choose it again. In a 28-day study with OpenAI (N = 981), daily conversations shifted preferences toward AI and away from humans, but only when conversations turned personal. Emotional support choices are thus path-dependent, progressively redirecting away from human connection.

</details>


### [635] [Cognitive Profiling of LRMs' Reasoning Traces Using Bloom's Taxonomy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23205)
*Maria-Eleni Zoumpoulidi,Georgios Paraskevopoulos,Alexandros Potamianos*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个基于布鲁姆认知分类学的框架，用于自动标注大型推理模型（LRMs）推理步骤中的思维类型（如记忆、应用、评估等六个认知层级），并通过大规模跨模型、跨数据集分析揭示思维模式的异同，同时证明思维类型信息与推理正确性相关，为提升推理质量提供了细粒度的分析框架和可操作的见解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管大型推理模型的推理痕迹数据日益丰富，为研究模型行为提供了细粒度的机会，但目前对推理过程中所采用的思维类型（thinking types）的理解仍十分欠缺。理解思维类型对于洞察模型的推理模式和实现可操作的应用至关重要，因此本文旨在填补这一研究空白。

Method: 本文提出一个自动标注推理步骤思维类型的框架，该框架基于布鲁姆认知分类学（Bloom's Taxonomy），将思维分为六个认知层级（如记忆、应用、评估等）。作者利用该框架对多个模型和数据集进行了大规模分析，系统比较了不同模型和任务之间的思维模式异同。

Result: 大规模分析揭示了不同模型和任务在思维模式上的相似性与差异性；同时证明从推理痕迹中提取的思维类型信息与推理正确性存在相关性，为改进推理质量提供了新途径。

Conclusion: 本文建立了用于分析大型推理模型思维模式的细粒度框架，为理解模型推理行为提供了新视角，并为提升推理质量提供了可操作的实践指导。

Abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have revolutionized reasoning in LLMs, and the increasing public availability of reasoning traces creates valuable opportunities to study model behavior not only at the surface level but also at the granularity of individual reasoning steps. However, understanding the types of thinking employed during reasoning - which offers critical insights into models' reasoning patterns and enables actionable applications - remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce a framework for automatic annotation of reasoning steps through the lens of Bloom's Taxonomy, which classifies thinking into six cognitive levels, such as Remembering, Applying and Evaluating. Using this framework, we perform a large-scale analysis across models and datasets, revealing both similarities and differences in thinking patterns across models and tasks. Moreover, we demonstrate that thinking-type information derived from reasoning traces correlates with correctness, paving the way for improved reasoning. Our findings establish a fine-grained framework for analyzing thinking patterns in LRMs and provide actionable insights for enhancing reasoning quality.

</details>


### [636] [What is mathematics now, and what should it be?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23218)
*Jeremy Avigad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文从更广阔的视角审视AI在数学领域的潜力，提出超越神经定理证明器现有成就的乐观观点，探讨数学家与AI互动的新可能性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经定理证明器虽取得了令人印象深刻的进展，但这些成功掩盖了AI对数学更广泛的潜在贡献，以及数学家如何更深入地参与AI协作的愿景。

Method: 以论文/随笔形式提出更具扩展性和乐观性的观点，论述AI在数学中的更广泛可能性。

Result: 提出了一种更宏大且乐观的AI与数学关系框架，超越当前定理证明器的局限。

Conclusion: 作者主张应拓宽视野，看到AI在数学领域的更多可能性，鼓励数学家以更积极的方式参与AI的发展。

Abstract: Advances in neural theorem provers have been impressive, but the successes obscure a broader vision of what AI can do for mathematics and how mathematicians can engage with AI. This essay advances a more expansive and optimistic point of view.

</details>


### [637] [Is Next-Chunk Reasoning RL Really Better than SFT? Revisiting Training Strategies under no-CoT Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23256)
*Yinhao Tang,Youqing Fang,Yanan Sun,Jiangning Liu,Ziyi Wang,Xun Zhao,Weiming Zhang,Bin Liu,Kuikun Liu,Wenwei Zhang,Kai Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文通过对照实验回答了一个关键问题：next-chunk reasoning RL 的优势究竟来自RL公式本身，还是仅来自更好地暴露模型于no-CoT数据。研究发现，一个简单且此前被忽视的基线方法——Mixed SFT（在no-CoT和长CoT数据上联合进行单阶段有监督微调）——不仅在RLVR后性能上限上显著优于next-chunk reasoning RL，而且所需训练计算量少了60倍以上。这一优势在域内数学推理和域外推理任务中均一致成立。此外，研究还揭示pre-RLVR准确率与post-RLVR准确率并非单调对应，强调应在完整后训练流水线背景下评估no-CoT训练策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有对next-chunk reasoning RL的评估主要与常规SFT基线对比，无法区分性能提升是源于RL公式本身，还是仅仅因为该方法更有效地利用了no-CoT数据。作者希望厘清这一混淆因素，验证更简单直接的训练策略是否也能达到甚至超越该RL方法的效果。

Method: 采用受控对照实验设计，比较两种训练策略：(1) next-chunk reasoning RL——训练模型生成隐式推理轨迹，并根据其对下一块文本的预测能力给予奖励；(2) Mixed SFT——在no-CoT数据和长CoT数据上联合进行单一阶段的有监督微调。在相同数据条件下进行公平对比，并分别评估pre-RLVR和post-RLVR性能。

Result: Mixed SFT在post-RLVR性能上限上明显高于next-chunk reasoning RL，且训练计算成本低60倍以上。该优势在域内数学推理和域外推理任务上均保持一致。此外，pre-RLVR准确率与post-RLVR准确率之间不存在简单的单调关系。

Conclusion: next-chunk reasoning RL相比Mixed SFT并没有体现出在RL后训练环节的优越性，其增益可能更多来自对no-CoT数据的有效利用而非RL公式本身。研究呼吁在评估no-CoT训练策略时，应将其置于完整的后训练流水线（pre-RLVR和post-RLVR）中进行全面考量，而非孤立地衡量单一阶段的效果。

Abstract: Recent work proposes next-chunk reasoning RL for leveraging no-CoT data---corpora such as worked solutions and textbook derivations that contain reasoning-rich content but lack explicit chain-of-thought annotations. The method trains a model to generate implicit reasoning traces and rewards them by their ability to predict the next chunk of text. While promising, existing evaluations primarily compare against conventional SFT baselines, leaving open whether the gains come from the RL formulation itself or from more effectively exposing the model to no-CoT data. We address this question with a controlled study of next-chunk reasoning RL and a simple but previously overlooked alternative: Mixed SFT, a single supervised fine-tuning stage that jointly trains on no-CoT and long-CoT data. Despite its simplicity, Mixed SFT achieves a clearly higher post-RLVR performance ceiling than next-chunk reasoning RL while requiring over 60 times less training compute. The advantage is consistent across in-domain mathematical reasoning and out-of-domain reasoning tasks. Moreover, we show that higher pre-RLVR accuracy does not necessarily translate into higher post-RLVR accuracy, highlighting the need to evaluate no-CoT training strategies in the context of the full post-training pipeline.

</details>


### [638] [Automated Construction of FAIR Digital Object Knowledge Graphs from Flat Cultural Heritage Records](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23263)
*Zeyd Boukhers,Lingxiao Kong,Xenophon Zabulis,Georgios Toubekis*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将扁平化的Europeana记录转换为符合FDO规范的CIDOC-CRM知识图谱的流水线，利用大语言模型自动分类元数据值，将其路由到受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO）并链接到共享实体FDO。在637条考古记录上评估，流水线链接了86%的元数据槽位，解析了Europeana未富集值的58.5%，并合并了17/33个正确的跨语言表面形式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: FDO框架要求元数据属性值尽可能表示为持久标识符（PID），以构建完全机器可操作、每个引用都可解析的图。但Europeana数据模型设计早于FDO规范，大多数元数据值以纯文本存储，仅服务于人类浏览，自动化代理无法跨记录或集合追踪引用。因此需要将扁平化记录转换为FDO合规的知识图谱。

Method: 构建一个将Europeana记录转换为FDO合规知识图谱的流水线：1）按照FDO规范，将每个遗产实体建模为独立的FDO，包含自己的PID、类型、配置文件和元数据层；2）核心挑战是自动化区分哪些值必须成为PID引用（可解析实体）与哪些可保留为字面量（终端叶子，如注释、测量值和日期）；3）使用大语言模型对每个元数据值进行分类，将其路由到受控词表（Getty AAT、Wikidata、VIAF、PeriodO），并链接到共享实体FDO。

Result: 使用来自五个Europeana提供者的637条考古记录进行评估。流水线链接了86%的元数据槽位，解析了Europeana尚未富集值的58.5%。此外，它合并了字节完全匹配无法识别的跨语言表面形式，33个此类合并中有17个经人工审核正确。图连接性与字符串匹配并无差别，FDO图的独特之处在于每个节点都被类型化且可解析。

Conclusion: 该流水线成功将Europeana扁平记录转换为FDO合规的CIDOC-CRM知识图谱，通过LLM自动化实现了元数据值的PID路由和实体链接。FDO图的核心价值不在于提高图连接性，而在于每个节点被类型化且可解析，从而实现了真正的机器可操作性。

Abstract: The FAIR Digital Object (FDO) framework mandates that metadata attribute values be expressed as persistent identifiers (PIDs) wherever possible, to produce a fully machine-actionable graph in which every reference is resolvable. The Europeana Data Model was designed long before the FDO specification, and it stores most metadata values as plain text. This serves human browsing well enough, but gives an automated agent nothing to follow across records or collections. We present a pipeline that transforms flat Europeana records into an FDO-compliant knowledge graph structured with CIDOC-CRM. Following the FDO specification, we model every heritage entity as a discrete FDO with its own PID, type, profile, and metadata layer. The core technical challenge is automating the FDO-prescribed distinction between values that must become PID references (resolvable entities) and those that may remain literals (terminal leaves such as notes, measurements, and dates). We address this with a large language model that classifies each metadata value, routes it to a controlled vocabulary (Getty AAT, Wikidata, VIAF, PeriodO), and links it to a shared entity FDO. We evaluate using 637 archaeological records from five Europeana providers, processing each with the LLM. The pipeline links 86% of metadata slots, resolving 58.5% of values Europeana had not already enriched. It also merges cross-lingual surface forms that byte-identical matching keeps apart, where 17 of 33 such merges are correct on manual review. Graph connectivity does not separate this from string matching; what distinguishes the FDO graph is that every node is typed and resolvable.

</details>


### [639] [Hidden in the Request: Explaining Unethical LLM Compliance through Token Relevance](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23264)
*Or Biton,Tomer Krichli,Itai Allouche,Joseph Keshet*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文系统研究了大语言模型（LLM）在伦理行为上的失败模式，发现模型在"直接请求帮助"的任务形式下安全性能最差。通过Layer-wise Relevance Propagation（LRP）技术，作者发现模型存在"归因偏差"——过度关注良性的任务框架词（如"你能帮我..."），而忽视了指示不道德行为的线索词（如"不被抓住"）。作者提出两种LRP引导的解码方法来增强对线索词的关注，实验证明这些干预能促进更安全的响应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽然被对齐以同时优化有用性和无害性，但这两个目标可能冲突，导致对齐失败。现有研究缺乏对模型伦理行为失败机制的系统性理解，因此需要深入探究模型为何会在不道德场景下做出有害回应。

Method: 1) 提出一种探测方法，将不道德场景以三种结构模态呈现：客观分类任务、主观第一人称陈述、直接请求帮助；2) 使用Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) 追踪模型归因差异；3) 提出两种LRP引导的解码方法，引导生成朝向与线索词更相关的轨迹。

Result: 模型在基于请求帮助的形式下性能显著下降。LRP分析揭示了归因偏差：模型更关注良性任务框架词而非不道德线索词。提出的两种LRP引导解码方法能有效促进更安全的模型响应。

Conclusion: 研究证实了线索词归因不足是导致模型有害遵从的关键因素，LRP引导的干预可以缓解这一问题，为理解LLM对齐失败机制和开发更安全的解码策略提供了新视角。

Abstract: Although Large Language Models (LLMs) are aligned to optimize for both helpfulness and harmlessness, these dual objectives may conflict, inevitably leading to alignment failures. This work systematically investigates instances where LLMs fail to exhibit ethical behavior. To understand the underlying mechanics of these vulnerabilities, we introduce a probing methodology that presents unethical scenarios to LLMs in three distinct structural modalities: objective classification tasks, subjective first-person statements, and direct requests for assistance. We find that model performance degrades in the request-for-assistance-based form. Using Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP), we trace this discrepancy to an attribution bias: the model places greater emphasis on benign task-framing tokens (e.g., "Can you help me...") than on tokens signaling the underlying unethical behavior (e.g., "without getting caught"), which we term cue-tokens. We hypothesize that this under-attribution contributes to harmful compliance. To test this, we introduce two LRP-guided decoding methods that steer generation toward trajectories more relevant to cue tokens. Empirical evaluations show that these interventions promote safer responses, supporting cue-token attribution's role in compliance failures.

</details>


### [640] [Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23283)
*Apodex Team,B. An,B. Li,B. Wang,B. Zhang,B. L. Wang,C. Feng,C. Wei,C. Xue,C. Zhang,D. Ng,D. Ye,E. Min,F. Chen,F. Liu,F. Yang,F. Ye,H. Xu,H. Yang,H. Ye,H. Zhang,H. Zhao,J. Li,J. Lin,J. Xia,K. Jin,K. Wang,K. Yang,L. Bing,L. Lei,L. Su,Le. Wang,Lu. Wang,N. Wang,Q. Ren,Q. Yang,R. Li,S. Bai,S. Du,S. Li,S. Lin,S. Nie,S. Wang,S. Zhang,S. Z. Wang,Ta. Q. Fang,Ti. Q. Fang,W. Fang,W. Li,W. Zhang,X. Chen,X. Li,X. Tang,X. Wang,X. Xu,X. Zhang,X. Q. Wang,X. Y. Wang,Y. Deng,Y. Gao,Y. Hu,Y. Li,Y. Sui,Y. Wang,Y. Xiao,Y. Zhang,Z. Chen,Z. Cheng,Z. Feng,Z. Liang,Z. Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Apodex 1.1 通过环境扩展和智能体协调扩展两个维度开发"工作能力"（持续、可验证地向现实目标推进），在复杂专业工作中以较小的模型规模达到领先性能，其35B参数的Mini版本仍保持强劲的本地可部署能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用语言模型具备推理和知识综合能力，但复杂工作还需要与文件、信息源、可执行代码的持续交互，以及状态维护、故障恢复和可验证交付。作者将这些能力定义为"工作能力"，旨在构建面向雄心勃勃、长期运行任务的"Heavy-Duty Solver"。

Method: 沿两个互补维度开发工作能力：一是环境扩展（Environment Scaling），扩大可执行文件、搜索和代码环境的多样性与可验证性；二是智能体协调扩展（Agentic Coordination Scaling），训练智能体分解长期任务、委派并行工作、整合异步结果并重新规划。共享执行框架与AgentOS维护跨工具和智能体的任务状态与来源，训练将环境轨迹和协调痕迹转化为可靠行为。

Result: 在复杂专业工作、金融、科学研究、数学、编码和搜索等任务中，Apodex 1.1以明显小于许多前沿系统的模型规模达到领先性能；35B参数的Apodex 1.1 Mini在本地可部署形式下仍保持强工作能力。

Conclusion: 研究结果表明智能体智能可以建立在持续、可验证的有用工作之上，推进了构建用于雄心勃勃、长期任务的重型求解器的目标。

Abstract: General-purpose language models can reason and synthesize knowledge, but complex work also requires sustained interaction with files, information sources, and executable code, together with state maintenance, failure recovery, and verifiable delivery. We call this \emph{working capability}: sustained, verifiable progress toward a real-world objective. Apodex 1.1 develops this capability along two complementary dimensions. \emph{Environment Scaling} expands the diversity and verifiability of executable file, search, and code environments, while \emph{Agentic Coordination Scaling} trains agents to decompose long-horizon tasks, delegate parallel work, integrate asynchronous results, and replan. A shared execution harness and AgentOS maintain task state and provenance across tools and agents, and training turns environment trajectories and coordination traces into reliable behavior. Across complex professional work, finance, scientific research, mathematics, coding, and search, Apodex 1.1 reaches the leading performance band despite using a substantially smaller model than many frontier systems. The 35B-parameter Apodex 1.1 Mini further retains strong working capability in a locally deployable form. These results ground agentic intelligence in useful, verifiable work completed over time and advance our goal of building a \emph{Heavy-Duty Solver} for ambitious, long-running tasks.

</details>


### [641] [EviSafe: Evidence-Grounded Safety Evaluation for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23313)
*Xuetong Li,Gaofeng Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出EviSafe框架，一个基于证据的VLM安全评测框架，通过联合评估自然行为、文本与视觉证据的显式基础、以及对安全关键证据的反事实敏感性，揭示了现有VLM仅关注最终响应（拒绝/警告/合规）的评测盲区。EviSafeBench包含1,181个黄金图像-文本场景和2,452个反事实变体，覆盖八个安全领域。对11个VLM的评估显示，自然场景严重性准确率仅27.6%-52.8%，诊断一致性仅6.1%-29.3%，反事实转换成功率30.4%-58.4%，表明现有VLM并非因正确的多模态理由而安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLM安全基准只评估最终响应（是否拒绝、警告或合规），无法判断模型是否因正确的多模态原因而安全。安全表现可能源于关键词触发的拒绝、忽略视觉危害或过度拒绝良性敏感输入，需要更细粒度的证据层面评测。

Method: 提出EviSafe框架，包含三个探针协议：自然响应、证据报告和反事实响应提示，配合证据感知评分器。构建EviSafeBench基准，包含1,181个黄金图像-文本场景和2,452个反事实变体，覆盖8个安全领域和8种风险源类型，每个场景含黄金安全决策、证据标注、安全响应策略和反事实干预。

Result: 对11个VLM的评估显示：自然严重性准确率27.6%-52.8%，放宽后的诊断一致性6.1%-29.3%，不安全到安全的反事实转换成功率30.4%-58.4%。各指标间存在显著差距，表明模型安全行为的基础不可靠。

Conclusion: 被评估的VLM未能可靠地因正确的多模态理由而安全，评测应超越简单的拒绝计数，转向证据级的多模态安全评估。

Abstract: Vision-language model safety benchmarks typically evaluate only final responses: whether a model refuses, warns, or complies. This outcome-level view cannot tell whether a model is safe for the right multimodal reason. Safelooking behavior may reflect keyword-triggered refusal, missed visual hazards, or over-refusal of benign-sensitive inputs. We introduce EviSafe, an evidence-grounded framework for VLM safety that jointly evaluates natural user-facing behavior, explicit grounding in textual and visual evidence, and behavioral sensitivity to counterfactual changes in safety-critical evidence. EviSafeBench instantiates the framework as a controlled benchmark with 1,181 gold image-text scenarios and 2,452 targeted counterfactual variants across eight safety domains and eight risk-source types. Each scenario includes a gold safety decision, evidence annotations, a safe-response policy, and counterfactual interventions. The three-probe protocol queries models with natural-response, evidencereporting, and counterfactual-response prompts, then scores them using an evidence-aware judge. Across eleven evaluated VLMs, natural severity accuracy ranges from 27.6% to 52.8%, relaxed diagnostic consistency from 6.1% to 29.3%, and unsafe-to-safe counterfactual transition success from 30.4% to 58.4%. These gaps show that the evaluated VLMs are not reliably safe for the right multimodal reason and motivate evaluation beyond refusal counts.

</details>


### [642] [Agent-G$^2$: Gaussian Guidance for Agentic Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23318)
*Zixuan Wang,Yanrui Miao,Zhengxi Lu,Teng Pan,Yiwen Qiu,Hongxing Li,Peng Qiu,Ruiqing Zhang,Yongliang Shen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Agent-G²，一种基于高斯分布的提示深度（guidance depth）自适应框架，用于提示型强化学习（hint-based RL）中的稀疏奖励长时程智能体任务。与传统将提示深度视为确定性标量不同，Agent-G²将每任务的深度建模为高斯分布，其均值和方差从策略优化过程中已收集的rollout中在线估计，无需额外探测rollout或学习深度预测器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有提示型强化学习方法将提示深度视为确定性标量：固定调度方案对所有样本共享同一深度，忽略了任务间异质性；逐样本探测方法虽能单独估计深度，但代价高昂（需要额外rollout）。作者发现有效的提示深度实际占据一个"带"（band），其信息量分布近似呈高斯形状围绕带中心，而非集中于单一最优点，因此需要更灵活的自适应框架。

Method: 提出Agent-G²框架：1) 将每任务的提示深度从高斯分布中采样，该分布的中心和扩展范围在训练过程中基于已收集的rollout在线估计（无需探测rollout或深度预测器）；2) 分布中心结合全局基线与各聚类难度（per-cluster difficulty）；3) 分布扩展度跟踪簇内方差（within-cluster variance），从而动态反映任务难度的异质性。

Result: 在ALFWorld和WebShop上使用Qwen2.5-1.5B/7B-Instruct进行评估。在ALFWorld上，Agent-G²相比最强的hint-based、hint-free和Aux-RL基线分别提升2.3/3.9/7.4个百分点，且rollout成本仅为逐样本探测方法的不到三分之一。

Conclusion: Agent-G²验证了提示深度应被建模为分布而非标量的观点，以极低的额外成本实现了优于现有方法的效果，为提示型强化学习在长时程稀疏奖励任务中提供了更高效、更自适应的深度选择策略。

Abstract: Hint-based reinforcement learning addresses reward sparsity in long-horizon agentic tasks by retaining a prefix of an expert trajectory before each rollout, letting the policy explore from a state closer to success. Its effectiveness hinges on the guidance depth: how much of the trajectory to keep. Existing methods treat this depth as a deterministic scalar. Scheduled approaches share one value across samples and ignore per-task heterogeneity; per-sample probing estimates it separately at the cost of extra rollouts. We find that useful guidance occupies a band of depths whose informativeness profile is approximately Gaussian around the band center, rather than concentrating at a single optimal point. We propose Agent-G$^2$, a Gaussian guidance framework that draws the depth per task from a Gaussian whose center and spread are estimated online from rollouts already collected for policy optimization, requiring no probe rollouts or learned depth predictor. The center combines a global baseline with per-cluster difficulty, and the spread tracks within-cluster variance. We evaluate Agent-G$^2$ on ALFWorld and WebShop on Qwen2.5-1.5B / 7B-Instruct. Agent-G$^2$ outperforms the strongest hint-based, hint-free, and Aux-RL baselines on ALFWorld by 2.3 / 3.9 / 7.4 points at under one-third the rollout cost of per-sample probing.

</details>


### [643] [Walking on the DARKSIDE](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23370)
*Aldo Gangemi,Emanuele Bottazzi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出DARKSIDE，一种基于POLANYI++逻辑增强生成(LAG)框架之上的连贯性审计方法。它通过显式的排除轨迹数据结构与担保轴(将命名指称物分类为有担保/未证实/错误归属/伪造)，对LLM生成的知识图(XKG)进行"认知防火墙"审计，防止复杂无意义输入被具体化进知识图谱。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM虽然能识别模式，但无法原生追踪连贯话语所需的排除路径。当输入建立在伪造权威、错误机制或隐蔽类比之上时，LLM会将其当作有根据的内容处理，并将错误具体化到结构化输出中。即使POLANYI++通过启发式、本体和问题求解方法生成OWL2格式的扩展知识图(XKG)，也继承了这一漏洞——复杂的无意义输入会与合法三元组一起被具体化，且难以被自动化推理器检测。

Method: DARKSIDE在POLANYI++之上构建了一个连贯性审计层：(1)将排除轨迹形式化为一个随话语时间累积排除的显式数据结构；(2)引入担保轴，将每个命名指称物分类为Warranted、Unattested、Misattributed或Fabricated；(3)设置升级规则，当伪造率为正或未支持率超过阈值时，将DelegationRiskAssessment推至UNSAFE状态。将LLM前向传播包装在本体介导的负轨迹装置中。

Result: 在BSBench(100条跨软件工程、金融、医疗、物理和法律领域的复杂无意义对抗语料)上评估DARKSIDE作为Gemini 3上的引导层，以Claude Sonnet 4.6作为独立裁判。实证证据支持架构性主张：当LLM前向传播被包装在本体介导的负轨迹装置中时，结构性模式-路径差距可以得到部分支撑。

Conclusion: XKG充当缺失的记忆，担保轴作为认识论防火墙。论据表明，通过显式的排除轨迹数据和担保分类机制，可以在一定程度上弥合LLM模式识别与路径追踪之间的结构性差距，审计复杂无意义输入对知识图谱的污染。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) recognise patterns but do not natively track the path of exclusions that a coherent discourse demands. When an input rests on a fabricated authority, a misapplied mechanism, or a surreptitious analogy, an unsteered LLM tends to engage with it as if it were grounded, and to reify the misstep into any structured output it generates. Logic-Augmented Generation (LAG) with POLANYI++, an LLM-steering method that uses heuristics, ontologies and problem solving methods for tacit knowledge extraction, produces an Extended Knowledge Graph (XKG) in OWL2, but inherits the same vulnerability: a sophisticated nonsensical input is reified into the graph alongside the legitimate triples, and is hardly detectable by automated reasoners since the XKG is generated jointly with the wrong assumptions. We introduce DARKSIDE, a coherence auditing method on top of POLANYI++. It formalises the trail as an explicit data structure of accumulated exclusions over discourse time, complemented by a warrant axis that classifies each named referent as Warranted, Unattested, Misattributed or Fabricated, with an escalation rule that pushes the DelegationRiskAssessment to UNSAFE when the fabricated rate is positive or the unsupported rate exceeds a threshold. We evaluate DARKSIDE as a steering layer over a Gemini 3 on BSBench, a 100-item adversarial corpus of sophisticated-sounding nonsense across software engineering, finance, healthcare, physics and law, with Claude Sonnet 4.6 as an independent judge. The empirical evidence supports an architectural claim: when an LLM forward pass is wrapped in an ontology-mediated negative-trail apparatus, the structural pattern-vs-path gap can be partially scaffolded. The XKG functions as the missing memory, and the warrant axis as an epistemic firewall.

</details>


### [644] [Modalities Should Talk to Each Other: Dual-Stream Multimodal Learning for Long-Horizon Influenza Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23373)
*Seyed Mohammad Hossein Hashemi,Mohsen Hooshmand,Parvin Razzaghi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出Dual-Stream Attention (DSA)，一种多模态深度学习框架，通过双向交叉模态注意力机制融合数值流行病学信号与文本新闻标题，实现12周前瞻的流感样疾病（ILI）预测。在Time-MMD数据集上，DSA的测试MSE为0.416，相比iTransformer、TaTS和GPT4MTS分别降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%的均方误差，并在所有baseline中排名第一。消融实验和扰动分析验证了双向注意力的有效性和可解释性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长程流感样疾病（ILI）预测对公共卫生准备至关重要，但现有的公开监测数据通常将数值流行病学信号与嘈杂、松散结构、间接相关且滞后的文本信息配对。如何有效融合这两种模态成为挑战，需要精心设计的多模态融合方法。

Method: DSA框架包含两个独立编码器：基于Transformer的数值编码器和领域自适应的标题编码器，分别编码数值信号和文本新闻标题。通过双向交叉模态注意力（CMA）机制让两种模态相互条件化——文本影响数值信号的解读，数值信号也影响文本的解读。CMA输出经因果时序模型进行12周前瞻预测。

Result: 在十个随机种子的评估中，DSA达到0.416的测试MSE中位数，相比iTransformer（0.668）、TaTS（0.607）和GPT4MTS（0.851），均方误差分别降低54.95%、37.29%和67.23%。配对效应量Cohen's d分别为0.555、0.337和0.345，在100%的bootstrap抽样中排名第一，且最坏窗口误差显著低于所有baseline。在外部地理数据集中同样排名第一。消融实验表明优势不依赖于文本编码器选择或语言模型微调，双向注意力优于任一方向。扰动分析显示学习的CMA在针对性掩码下具有功能性信息，文本到数值方向的效果更强。

Conclusion: DSA通过双向跨模态条件化设计有效融合了数值与文本两种监测信号，在长程ILI预测任务上显著优于现有方法。研究证明了双向注意力机制的必要性，并通过忠实性分析展示了模型的可解释性，为多模态公共卫生监测预测提供了有力工具。

Abstract: Forecasting long-range influenza-like illness (ILI) matters for public health readiness. Publicly available surveillance datasets typically pair numeric epidemiological signals with textual information that is noisy, loosely structured, only indirectly related to near-term trends, and often lagged relative to the numeric signal. Fusing the two therefore requires careful design. We propose Dual-Stream Attention (DSA), a multimodal deep learning framework that forecasts 12-week-ahead ILI activity from a 36-week multimodal history by letting the numerical and textual streams condition each other. Using the Time-MMD health-domain dataset, DSA separately encodes the two modalities with a Transformer-based numerical encoder and a domain-adapted headline encoder, then couples them through a bidirectional Cross-Modal Attention (CMA) mechanism: the text (news headlines) conditions the interpretation of the numeric signal and vice versa. The CMA output then passes to a causal temporal model for forecasting. Evaluated across ten random seeds, DSA achieves a median test MSE of 0.416, versus 0.668, 0.607, and 0.851 for iTransformer, TaTS, and GPT4MTS, corresponding to mean-error reductions of 54.95%, 37.29%, and 67.23%, with paired Cohen's d of 0.555, 0.337, and 0.345, respectively, and ranks first in 100% of bootstrap draws. It also has substantially lower worst-window error than all baselines. On an external-geography dataset, DSA again ranks first among nine evaluated baselines. Ablations show the advantage does not depend on text-encoder choice or language-model fine-tuning, and that bidirectional attention outperforms either direction alone. Finally, perturbation-based faithfulness analysis shows the learned CMA is functionally informative under targeted masking, with a stronger effect in the text-to-numerical direction.

</details>


### [645] [MediSkill-Evo: Process-Constrained Self-Evolution for Evidence-Grounded Clinical Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23397)
*Ruoyu Wu,Shenfu Xie,Yinqian Sun,Haibo Tong,Feifei Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出MediSkill-Evo，一个无需微调骨干网络即可进化受治理的过程知识的临床智能体，通过四类经验银行和过程约束偏好框架，在诊断准确率、治疗意图覆盖率和关键失败率等指标上显著优于基线AgentClinic。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在部分可观测性条件下，交互式临床智能体必须收集决定性证据并将其转化为有依据的行动。仅仅做出正确的最终诊断并不能证明智能体遵守了证据和护理过程约束，因此需要一种能够显式治理和进化临床过程知识的方法。

Method: MediSkill-Evo将经验分为四类银行：临床技能、过程规则、符号模式、测量程序。通过来源追踪、支持验证、回放和控制器定义的安全检查来管理对冻结测试时快照的发布。过程约束偏好框架将证据绑定到其来源，拒绝控制器无效候选，并使用安全优先的临床过程评判器对行动排序。

Result: 在300个隔离的Qwen遭遇中，诊断准确率从61.33%提升到69.00%，治疗意图覆盖率从33.62%提升到66.44%，自动评分的严重失败率从31.00%降至16.33%。在180个硬隔离条件下，目标恢复率在患者行为压力下达93.61%，时间证据下达100.00%，分诊红旗下达92.22%。

Conclusion: 研究提供了完整系统在固定评估套件上的描述性端到端证据，证明MediSkill-Evo能有效提升临床过程遵守和诊断性能，但结果不代表单个银行组件具备因果证据，也不构成对自动评判器的临床验证。

Abstract: Interactive clinical agents must gather decisive evidence and convert it into grounded actions under partial observability. A correct final diagnosis alone does not show that an agent respected evidence and care-process constraints. We introduce MediSkill-Evo, a clinical agent that evolves governed process knowledge without backbone fine-tuning. It separates experience into four typed banks for clinical skills, process rules, symbolic schemas, and measurement procedures. Provenance, support, replay, and controller-defined safety checks govern publication to a frozen test-time snapshot. A Process-Constrained Preference Harness binds evidence to its source, rejects controller-invalid candidates, and ranks actions with a safety-prioritized Clinical Process Critic. We evaluate complete agent systems across two backbone endpoints and six controlled stress dimensions under the same Doctor-turn limit. On 300 held-out Qwen encounters, MediSkill-Evo improves diagnosis accuracy from 61.33 percent to 69.00 percent and treatment-intent coverage from 33.62 percent to 66.44 percent, while reducing automatically scored critical failures from 31.00 percent to 16.33 percent relative to AgentClinic. On 180 hard-isolation conditions derived from 30 cases, target recovery reaches 93.61 percent under patient-behavior pressure, 100.00 percent for temporal evidence, and 92.22 percent for triage red flags. An exploratory 100-case MedSAM comparison evaluates request-gated tool-interface feasibility. These results provide descriptive end-to-end evidence for the complete system on fixed evaluation suites, not causal evidence for an individual bank or clinical validation of the automatic judge.

</details>


### [646] [SkillAlchemy: Open-World Agent Skill Creation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23417)
*Hengjun Wang,Shuyue Wei,Boyi Liu,Jun Yang,Yongxin Tong*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出SkillAlchemy框架，从开放世界材料中创建技能。它通过对比证据发现隐含需求，基于证据支持的范畴接受候选程序，并将接受的内容编译为语法引导的技能包。在87个任务上，SkillAlchemy比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点，比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能可与人工策划技能媲美。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有技能创建依赖人类作者、模型先验或执行轨迹，这些来源对陌生任务往往不可用，因此需要从开放世界材料中创建技能。

Method: SkillAlchemy采用接纳为中心的框架：通过对比证据识别隐含需求，根据证据支持的范畴接纳候选程序，并将接纳内容编译成语法引导的技能包。

Result: 在87个SkillsBench v1.1任务上，相比无技能执行提升19.9个百分点，相比最强自动化基线提升8.6个百分点，性能与人工策划技能相当。

Conclusion: 从开放世界材料创建技能是可行的，SkillAlchemy能够实现接近人工水平的技能创建性能。

Abstract: Agent skills are reusable procedural artifacts that extend language agents with specialized workflows, tool conventions, and domain behaviors at inference time. However, creating reliable skills still depends largely on human authorship, model priors, or execution traces. These sources are often unavailable for unfamiliar tasks, suggesting the need to create skills from open-world materials. In this paper, we study open-world skill creation: given an underspecified skill brief and a source-access specification, a creator must discover behavior-relevant requirements omitted by the brief and determine how broadly each source-derived procedure is justified. We propose SkillAlchemy, an admission-centered framework for source-grounded skill creation. SkillAlchemy identifies implicit requirements through contrastive evidence, admits candidate procedures based on evidence-supported scope, and compiles the admitted content into a grammar-guided skill package. Extensive experiments across 87 SkillsBench v1.1 tasks demonstrate that SkillAlchemy improves pass rate over no-skill execution by 19.9 percentage points and the strongest automated baseline by 8.6 percentage points, while achieving performance comparable to human-curated skills.

</details>


### [647] [Characterizing Necessary Losers to Explain Tournaments Losers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23446)
*Contet Clément,Umberto Grandi,Jérôme Mengin*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究形式化解释"候选人为何未在锦标赛规则中被选中"的问题，通过识别子锦标赛（在该子锦标赛中，无论剩余部分如何补全，候选人都必输）来提供解释。作者定义了"破坏性最小支持集"，对应于可解释AI中的溯因解释。针对六种常见锦标赛规则（maximin、未覆盖集及其加权变体、top-cycle、Copeland和Borda），给出了必要失败者和可能获胜者的特征刻画，确定了最小破坏性支持集的大小，并提供了多项式时间算法（Borda规则除外，怀疑为NP完全）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在锦标赛规则中，解释一个候选人为何落选是重要的可解释性问题。现有工作缺乏对"落选原因"的形式化解释框架，本文旨在通过识别候选人在其中必然失败的最小子锦标赛来提供溯因解释，从而填补这一空白。

Method: 作者将"破坏性最小支持集"形式化为溯因解释，对六种锦标赛规则分别刻画了必要失败者与可能获胜者的条件，分析了最小破坏性支持集的规模，并设计了相应的计算算法（多项式时间），对Borda规则则给出了NP完全性怀疑的分析。

Result: 对六种锦标赛规则提供了完整的特征刻画；确定了最小破坏性支持集的大小；除Borda规则外均给出了多项式时间算法，Borda规则疑似NP完全。

Conclusion: 该工作为锦标赛规则提供了形式化的可行解释框架，涵盖了多种经典规则，并明确区分了可有效计算的规则与计算上困难的规则（Borda），为后续可解释锦标赛理论的研究奠定了基础。

Abstract: We study the problem of formally explaining why a candidate was not selected by a given tournament rule, by identifying sub-tournaments in which the candidate loses independently of how the rest of the tournament is completed. We define destructive minimal supports as any minimal sub-tournaments satisfying this property, which in formal explainable artificial intelligence correspond to abductive explanations for the question "Why does the loser lose the tournament?". For six common tournament solutions (maximin, uncovered set and its weighted variant, top-cycle, Copeland, and Borda) we provide characterizations of when a candidate is either a necessary loser or a possible winner, we determine the size of the smallest destructive minimal supports, complemented by polynomial-time algorithms for their computation except for the case of the Borda rule which is suspected to be NP-complete.

</details>


### [648] [StrategyBench: Evaluating Explicit Strategy Induction in Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23475)
*Jinghan Tan,Yuanzheng Wang,Lu Chen,Zijun Chen,Yuqian Wang,Maosong Sun*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出了StrategyBench基准，用于评估大型语言模型从少量示例中归纳任务策略（抽象规则）的能力，并沿策略质量和下游效用两个维度进行评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 直接ICL对示例构造敏感，因为它未显式抽象任务规则；而人类学习者会先总结规则再应用。现有研究缺乏对这种"策略归纳"能力的系统性评估。

Method: 从BIG-Bench中挑选可策略归纳的任务，构建参考策略，定义策略质量和下游效用两个评估维度；并从任务变体、模型配置、适应设置三个视角（类别差异、生成器-执行器选择、示范设计、SFT适应）分析策略归纳。

Result: 实验表明显式策略效用在不同任务类别间差异显著，且同时依赖于策略生成与执行两方面的条件。

Conclusion: 策略归纳能力是LLM在数据稀缺场景下任务适应的重要维度，StrategyBench为系统评估该能力提供了基准框架。

Abstract: As large language models are increasingly used in data-scarce and evolving task scenarios, few-shot in-context learning (ICL) has become a key paradigm for task adaptation. However, direct ICL often uses a small set of examples without explicitly abstracting task rules, making it sensitive to example construction. In contrast, human learners often reduce such sensitivity by first summarizing task rules from examples and then applying them to new instances. To evaluate this ability, we propose StrategyBench, which selects strategy-inducible tasks from BIG-Bench, constructs reference strategies, and defines evaluation metrics along two dimensions: strategy quality and downstream utility. We further analyze strategy induction from three perspectives: task variation, model configuration, and adaptation setting, covering category-wise differences, generator-executor choices, demonstration design, and SFT-based adaptation. Experiments show that explicit strategy utility differs substantially across task categories and depends on both strategy generation and execution conditions. The benchmark is released at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/StrategyBench-D53C.

</details>


### [649] [Multi-Modal Semantic Expansion with Constrained LLM Reranking for Conversational Music Recommendation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23484)
*Naman Garg,Sarika Jain,George Fazekas*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文介绍了Team Semiintelligencn在ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData挑战赛中的解决方案，采用三阶段流水线的多模态个性化对话推荐系统，最终获得Blind B综合得分0.3213。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对话式音乐推荐需要融合多模态信息（文本、音频、视觉）与个性化用户特征，本文旨在通过多模态检索与轻量级重排序构建高效的会话式推荐系统，参与RecSys挑战赛。

Method: 三阶段流水线：(1) 多模态检索——在七个稠密嵌入空间（track/user级CF-BPR、Qwen3元数据/歌词/属性、CLAP音频、SigLIP视觉）构建衰减加权质心，辅以BM25词法检索和艺术家子串匹配信号，通过加权RRF融合；(2) 轻量级重排序（历史过滤、流行度平滑、目录多样性惩罚）；(3) 使用GPT-4o-mini进行个性化响应生成。RRF权重通过差分进化优化。

Result: 在500会话开发集上通过差分进化优化RRF权重，MRR提升+19.5%。无约束LLM引导注入导致nDCG下降-18.9%，而保守注入在9个会话上取得最佳Blind A nDCG。最终提交系统Blind B综合得分0.3213。

Conclusion: 多模态检索融合与差分进化权重优化有效提升推荐性能；LLM引导注入需谨慎控制范围以避免性能灾难性下降；因成本与复杂度限制，部分组件（GPT-4.1提示、XGBoost LambdaMART等）未部署到最终提交。

Abstract: We present Team Semiintelligencn's solution for the ACM RecSys 2026 TalkPlayData Challenge, addressing conversational music recommendation through a multi-modal and personalized conversational recommender system. Our submitted system employs a three-stage pipeline: (1) multi-modal retrieval constructing decay-weighted centroids across seven dense embedding spaces - track- and user-level CF-BPR, Qwen3 (metadata, lyrics, attributes), CLAP audio, and SigLIP visual - supplemented by BM25 lexical retrieval and an artist substring-match signal, all fused via weighted Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF) with optimized signal weights; (2) lightweight reranking (history filtering, popularity smoothing, and catalog diversity penalization); and (3) persona-diversified response generation using GPT-4o-mini. Beyond this submitted configuration, we report development-time experiments with additional components - constrained LLM-guided artist injection, album continuation signals, XGBoost LambdaMART, and a superior GPT-4.1 response prompt - that were not deployed to Blind B due to cost and complexity constraints. We optimize RRF weights on a 500-session development split via differential evolution, improving MRR by +19.5%. On Blind A, we observe that unconstrained LLM-guided injection across 54 sessions causes catastrophic nDCG regression (-18.9%), while conservative injection on only 9 sessions yields the best observed Blind A nDCG - a finding we present as a Blind A observation warranting further validation. The submitted system achieves a Blind B composite score of 0.3213.

</details>


### [650] [SRPO: Self-Reflective Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23493)
*Jialong Liu,Yuling Shi,Ning Yang,Xiaodong Gu,Zuchao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: SRPO是一个让LLM通过自我反省将稀疏的最终反馈转化为密集的token级训练信号的框架，无需外部评判器、奖励模型或更大规模的教师模型，在数学推理和智能体任务上达到最先进性能且数据效率极高。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类学习中自我反省是强大的信用分配机制，能将稀疏的结果反馈转化为可操作的指导。然而LLM训练后阶段的自我反省潜力尚未被充分探索，作者希望将这种能力内化到LLM中。

Method: SRPO让LLM分析自身完成的轨迹，将错误综合为简洁的"反思补丁"，然后利用反思条件化的教师评分对学生的on-policy rollout作为密集的token级训练信号，将稀疏的最终监督转化为密集的token级学习信号。

Result: 在Qwen3-8B模型上，AIME'24达到73.3%（仅用SFT 8%的训练FLOPs）；WebShop成功率64.7%，ALFWorld 76.8%，SWE-Bench-Lite 31.2%，均达到最先进水平。

Conclusion: SRPO证明了自我反省机制可以有效内化到LLM中，实现了无外部依赖的高数据效率训练，在数学推理和长程智能体任务上均取得优异表现。

Abstract: Self-reflection is a powerful mechanism for credit assignment in human learning, converting sparse outcome feedback into actionable guidance. However, its potential for post-training Large Language Models (LLMs) remains underexplored. We propose Self-Reflective Policy Optimization (SRPO), a framework that internalizes this capability. SRPO enables LLMs to analyze their own completed trajectories, synthesize errors into concise "reflection patches," and use reflection-conditioned teacher scores on student on-policy rollouts as dense token-level training signals. This process effectively transforms sparse terminal supervision into dense, token-level learning signals without requiring external critics, separate reward models, or larger teacher models. We demonstrate that SRPO achieves state-of-the-art performance across mathematical reasoning and long-horizon agentic benchmarks with exceptional data efficiency. Using a Qwen3-8B base model, SRPO attains 73.3% on AIME'24 using only 8% (0.08x) of the training FLOPs required by scaled supervised fine-tuning, while significantly improving success rates on WebShop (64.7%), ALFWorld (76.8%), and SWE-Bench-Lite (31.2%). Code is available at https://github.com/Galleons2029/SRPO

</details>


### [651] [Mitigating Reasoning-Induced Misalignment via Safety-Direction Penalty](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23497)
*Yipeng Zhao,Qishun Yang,Shenzhe Zhu,Shu Yang,Di Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文研究了"推理诱导的错位"（RIM）现象，即在不含有害内容的推理数据（数学、代码、链式思考问题）上微调会导致LLM产生有害行为。作者通过表征空间分析揭示了推理能力方向与安全行为方向之间的耦合机制，并提出了"安全方向惩罚"（SDP）训练方法，在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上恢复安全性同时保持推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RIM现象对LLM推理安全性构成严重挑战，现有工作仅归因于神经元级纠缠，但未揭示表征空间的几何结构，也未提出训练时的修复方案。作者旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 1) 表征空间分析：从激活空间中提取两个方向——编码推理能力的方向和编码安全行为的方向，发现两者耦合：改进推理的微调会移动安全表征。2) 使用CKA距离比率和探针定位安全决策层。3) 基于耦合机制设计SDP方法，惩罚沿安全方向的位移，并根据层定位设置初始惩罚范围，必要时迭代扩展。

Result: 跨架构、跨规模、跨数据集验证RIM并非总是出现。SDP方法在Qwen2.5-3B和7B上能恢复安全性，同时保持基准推理性能。

Conclusion: RIM的表征空间耦合机制为理解和修复推理错位提供了几何解释，SDP作为训练时修复策略有效解决了安全性与推理性能之间的权衡问题。

Abstract: Reasoning-Induced Misalignment, where fine-tuning on reasoning data containing no harmful content, including mathematics, code, and problem-solving with chain-of-thought traces can induce harmful behaviors of LLM, posing a serious challenge to the safety of LLM reasoning. Cross-architecture, cross-scale, and cross-dataset checks show that RIM does not always emerge. Previous work attributed RIM to neuron-level entanglement, but did not identify the geometry of the representation space underlying this entanglement or propose a training-time fix. We provide both: a representation-space analysis of RIM and the Safety-Direction Penalty (SDP), which penalizes movement along a learned safety direction during reasoning fine-tuning. The analysis extracts two activation-space directions, one encoding reasoning ability and the other safety behavior. These directions are coupled: fine-tuning that improves reasoning shifts safety representations, and prompts with larger shifts show larger safety degradation. CKA distance ratios and probes locate the safety-decision layers where this shift is most relevant. These findings guide the design of SDP: the coupling motivates penalizing displacement along the safety direction, and the layer localization sets the initial scope. When the initial scope leaves compensatory shifts beyond the penalized layers, the same diagnostics guide iterative expansion. On Qwen2.5-3B and 7B, SDP restores safety while preserving benchmark reasoning performance.

</details>


### [652] [EarthVerse: Benchmarking Scientific Agents Across Dynamic Earth Systems and Natural Hazards](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23525)
*Zhiqing Cui,Xinxiang Yin,Yihong Tang,Xinglang Zhang,Yuanzhe Hu,Siru Zhong,Weidong Tang,Yuxuan Liang,Weijia Li,Ming Jin,Shirui Pan,Yuhao Kang,Dingyi Zhuang,Jinhua Zhao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文介绍EarthVerse，一个用于评估科学智能体在地球系统分析中能力的基准。它包含405个可复现任务，基于199个记录事件和19个灾害家族。评估了25个模型和智能体系统，发现最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅为34.81%，表明当前智能体在保持跨证据、尺度、单位和物理解释的一致推理链方面存在不足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 地球系统分析需要从来源、规模、时间和模态各异的观测中重构变化的物理过程。自然灾害使这项工作至关重要，因为不完整的证据可能改变对严重程度、暴露和机制的估计。现有基准无法评估智能体在异构证据整合与端到端科学可靠性方面的能力。

Method: 构建EarthVerse基准：包含405个可复现任务，基于199个文档事件和19个灾害家族。智能体需检查异构事件包、选择兼容证据、执行透明计算、调和来源差异、在最终答案中保留出处。提供可执行的真值（细粒度答案单元）和任务特定评分标准，允许多种有效路径。采用受控工具使用协议评估25个模型和智能体系统，并通过受控研究定位失败环节。

Result: 在所有评估系统中，最佳平均答案单元准确率为84.65%，但最高Strict@95仅为34.81%。通过受控研究定位了证据访问、工具选择、记忆、推理、交互和科学执行等环节的失败。

Conclusion: 当前智能体往往能完成单个步骤，但无法在证据、尺度、单位、计算和物理解释之间保持一致的推理链。EarthVerse为测量动态地球系统中端到端科学可靠性提供了可复现的基准基础。

Abstract: Earth-system analysis reconstructs changing physical processes from observations that differ in source, scale, timing, and modality. Natural hazards make this work consequential because incomplete evidence can change estimates of severity, exposure, and mechanism. We introduce EarthVerse, a benchmark that evaluates scientific agents through package-scoped investigations. Its 405 reproducible tasks are grounded in 199 documented events and 19 hazard families. Agents inspect heterogeneous event packages, choose compatible evidence, execute transparent calculations, reconcile source differences, and preserve provenance in the final answer. We provide executable ground truth that decomposes each task into fine-grained answer units, together with task-specific rubrics that assess the supporting research process while allowing multiple valid paths. We evaluate 25 model and agent systems under a controlled tool-using protocol, then use controlled studies to locate failures in evidence access, tool selection, memory, reasoning, interaction, and scientific execution. Across systems, the best mean answer-unit accuracy is 84.65%, while the highest Strict@95 is only 34.81%. The gap shows that current agents often complete individual steps without maintaining a consistent chain across evidence, scales, units, calculations, and physical interpretation. EarthVerse provides a reproducible basis for measuring end-to-end scientific reliability in dynamic Earth systems.

</details>


### [653] [Correcting a learned physical invariant improves world-model rollouts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23526)
*Richard Bao*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文测试了冻结的DreamerV3世界模型是否能在仅有摆锤视频训练的情况下，学习到一个被其自身潜在状态转移近似守恒的标量。无标签搜索在独立训练的保守模型中恢复了相同的能量类不变量，而在阻尼模型中找不到类似不变量。但在自主推演中该量会发生漂移，将潜在状态投影回初始水平集可减少三种保守模型的推演误差，而随机约束通常会增大误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 世界模型虽然能够预测视频，但可能并未真正学习到其所预测的动态学中被可靠保持的物理约束。作者希望区分一个"动态上有意义的不变量"与"仅可解码的相关量"，揭示世界模型是否真的在隐空间中编码了物理守恒律。

Method: 1) 使用冻结的DreamerV3仅基于摆锤视频训练；2) 通过无标签搜索在潜在空间中寻找被模型自身潜在转移近似守恒的标量；3) 比较独立训练的保守模型与阻尼模型中是否出现相同不变量；4) 在自主推演中测量该量的漂移；5) 将潜在状态投影回初始水平集（与随机约束对比）以验证其对推演误差的影响。

Result: 三个独立训练的保守模型均恢复出相同的能量类不变量，而阻尼模型中无类似不变量。该不变量在自主推演中发生漂移。将潜在状态投影回初始水平集可降低三种保守模型的推演误差，而随机约束通常增大误差。

Conclusion: 世界模型可以从像素中学习到物理约束（能量不变量），但在前向想象中却违反该约束。这揭示了一个具体的失败模式：模型学会了物理约束却在推理时违背它，说明"可解码的相关量"与"动态上有意义的约束"之间存在实质区别。

Abstract: World models can predict video without learning dynamics that they reliably preserve. We test whether a frozen DreamerV3 trained only on pendulum video learns a scalar that its own latent transition treats as approximately conserved. A label-free search recovers the same energy-like invariant across independently trained conservative models, while the same procedure finds no comparable invariant in matched damped models. During autonomous rollouts, this quantity drifts. Projecting the latent state back toward its initial level set reduces rollout error in all three conservative models, whereas matched random constraints usually increase it. These results distinguish a dynamically meaningful invariant from a merely decodable correlate and reveal a concrete failure mode: a world model can learn a physical constraint from pixels yet violate that constraint when it imagines forward.

</details>


### [654] [How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23543)
*Shang Wu,Catarina G Belem,Shuyuan Fu,Mark Steyvers,Padhraic Smyth*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本研究通过受控的逻辑谜题实验，探讨AI辅助在短期内提升任务表现但长期可能损害技能发展的张力。研究发现低成本AI辅助会导致更频繁的使用，且使用AI的参与者在移除辅助后表现更差，其无辅助表现会被高估。通过贝叶斯潜在能力模型，研究证实独立推理努力与技能增长正相关，AI替代独立推理会削弱技能发展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AI辅助虽能在短期内提升任务表现，但可能长期损害技能发展。现有研究缺乏对这种"短期收益与长期代价"张力的系统实验验证，尤其是AI请求成本如何影响使用频率以及这如何影响技能习得与后续表现。

Method: 采用受控逻辑谜题实验，实验分三个阶段：AI可用前、AI可用期间、AI移除后。通过操纵AI请求成本（实验变量）来影响使用频率。使用贝叶斯潜在能力模型（Bayesian latent ability model）分离初始能力、AI后能力和个体特定的技能变化，并估计AI可用期间的独立推理如何关联技能发展。

Result: 低成本辅助导致更频繁的AI使用；请求AI辅助的参与者在辅助移除后表现更差；从AI辅助期间的表现预测后续无辅助表现会产生高估；更大的独立问题解决努力与更大的潜在能力增长相关联，支持AI替代独立推理会削弱技能发展的解释。

Conclusion: AI辅助虽提升短期表现，但会削弱长期技能发展，尤其在AI替代而非增强独立推理时。研究强调在AI系统设计中需要权衡短期绩效与长期学习收益，并为理解人机协作中的技能习得机制提供了因果证据。

Abstract: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. The results show that greater independent problem-solving effort is associated with larger gains in latent ability, consistent with the interpretation that skill development is weaker when AI assistance substitutes for independent reasoning.

</details>


### [655] [Prime Agent: A Self-Improving RLM Harness](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23552)
*Seth Karten,Alex L. Zhang,Kevin Thomas,Sebastian Müller,Elie Bakouch,Daniel Auras,Mika Senghaas,Fares Obeid,Konstantin Dunas,Johannes Hagemann,Sami Jaghouar*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Prime Agent是一个开源的长时序智能体评测与编码工作流工具框架。其核心创新包括持久化IPython REPL（基于递归语言模型抽象实现程序化上下文处理与测试时计算）、持续框架（跨越轨迹保存历史、记忆、技能、提示与子代理规格）、递归子代理间的直接通信，以及供人类监控的后台会话管理界面。该框架将执行、恢复、验证与资源核算标准化，使测量更接近模型真实的最大底层能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型本质上是顺序处理器，但长时序智能体行为需要超越模型权重和活动上下文的外部信息与计算。现有框架未能充分隔离工作流故障与模型本身能力的局限，导致测量结果不能反映模型真实的最大潜力。

Method: Prime Agent采用三层设计：(1) 基于递归语言模型抽象的持久化IPython REPL，实现程序化上下文处理和测试时计算；(2) 持续框架（Continual Harness）在轨迹间保留历史、记忆、技能、提示和子代理规格；(3) 递归子代理通过直接代理间通信协调工作，并提供Agents View界面供人类检查和管理后台会话。整体框架标准化执行、恢复、验证与资源核算，但将策略构建完全留给模型。

Result: 在ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1上从30%提升到95.5%；在长上下文编码、GPU内核生成、模拟器构建和自主nanoGPT速度跑等任务上达到或超过原生框架及主流框架的表现。在Factorio任务中，精炼机制支持连续技术进步，专用子代理实现并行化工作。

Conclusion: Prime Agent作为一种低摩擦、高表达力的"膜"（membrane），能有效防止框架故障转化为模型故障，显著提升长时序智能体评估的准确性，展示了"模型能力"与"工作流工程质量"分离的价值。

Abstract: Language models are sequential processors, but long-horizon agency requires external information and computation beyond model weights and active context. Prime Agent is an open-source harness for long-horizon evaluation and coding-agent workflows. A persistent IPython REPL follows the Recursive Language Model abstraction for programmatic context processing and test-time compute, while Continual Harness preserves histories, memories, skills, prompts, and subagent specifications across trajectories. Recursive subagents coordinate through direct agent-to-agent communication, and the Agents View lets humans inspect and manage daemon-backed sessions. Prime Agent standardizes execution, recovery, verification, and resource accounting while leaving strategy construction to the model. This low-friction, expressive membrane prevents harness failures from becoming model failures and pushes measurement toward the model's true maximal underlying capability. Prime Agent raises ARC-AGI-3 RHAE Best@1 from 30% to 95.5% and matches or exceeds native and popular harnesses across long-context coding, GPU-kernel generation, emulator construction, and autonomous nanoGPT speedruns. On Factorio, we find refinement allows for continuous technology progression and dedicated subagents enable parallelized work. Code is available at https://github.com/PrimeIntellect-ai/prime-agent.

</details>


### [656] [ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.23565)
*Zhifei Chen,Luozhou Wang,Guibao Shen,Dongyu Yan,Shuai Yang,Tianshuo Xu,Yihua Du,Wei Wang,Tianyi Gui,Lianghua Huang,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: ReWorld 提出了一种分离控制与记忆的交互式世界模型，通过混合逐头注意力窗口（多数头关注近期、少数全局头关注全部历史）加随机头路由，在推理时用固定预算（有界KV缓存+位姿索引地标库）将整个过去压缩存储。配合度量尺度对齐的数据引擎和LoRA蒸馏，能以4步采样实时生成704x1280视频，在动作跟随、长时记忆召回和生成质量上优于六种现有交互世界模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式世界模型面临结构性矛盾：控制需要短视界（保证实时响应与动作跟随），而记忆需要无界视界（记住已展示的场景）。两者在训练时冲突、推理时难以兼顾，现有方法要么牺牲控制精度要么耗尽内存。

Method: 1) 训练阶段：混合逐头注意力窗口，多数头限近期、少数全局头覆盖全部历史；随机头路由防止能力绑定到特定头；随机块丢弃使稀疏历史在分布内。2) 推理阶段：有界KV缓存 + 位姿索引地标库，检索当前位姿最近的地标。3) 数据引擎：将八种来源（Unreal渲染飞行、游戏漫游、真实视频）对齐到同一物理动作尺度，回文轨迹提供重访证据。4) 推理加速：分布匹配蒸馏到LoRA适配器，压缩到4步采样，一个骨干同时服务高保真多步模式与实时交互模式。

Result: 在三轴协议（动作跟随、长时程召回、视频质量）下，对比六种近期交互世界模型，ReWorld取得最佳控制保真度（11.95°旋转误差、最佳相机运动一致性）和最佳生成质量。在64秒、384潜在步的分钟级往返滚动中，固定12块缓存仍能重建起始视图，而滑动窗口早已驱逐证据、全KV注意力则内存耗尽。

Conclusion: ReWorld 通过训练/推理两阶段的分离设计，成功化解了交互式世界模型中控制与记忆的结构性张力，在实时性、长时记忆与生成质量之间取得了标杆性的平衡，证明有界预算下的地标检索足以支撑分钟级场景重建。

Abstract: An interactive world model must follow the user's actions, remember the places it has shown, and stream in real time. The tension is structural: control wants a short horizon, memory wants an unbounded one. ReWorld separates the two during training and bounds them at inference. Mixed per-head attention windows confine most heads to the recent past while a small set of global heads attends over the entire history, and random head routing keeps either capability from binding to particular heads; random chunk dropping makes sparse histories in-distribution. At inference the whole past lives under a fixed budget: a bounded KV cache backed by a pose-indexed landmark bank, from which the model retrieves the landmarks nearest the current pose. A metric-scale-aligned data engine places eight sources -- Unreal-rendered fly-throughs, game roaming, and real-world footage -- on one physical action scale, so the same key press moves the camera the same distance in every source, and palindrome trajectories supply the revisit evidence that memory training needs. Distribution-matching distillation confined to a LoRA adapter then compresses sampling to four steps: one backbone serves both a high-fidelity multi-step mode and a real-time interactive one, streaming 704x1280 video across photorealistic, game-style, and stylized worlds. Under a three-axis protocol covering action following, long-horizon recall, and video quality, against six recent interactive world models it attains the best control fidelity ($11.95^\circ$ rotation error and the best camera-motion consistency) and the best generation quality; and on minute-long out-and-back rollouts ($64$\,s, $384$ latents), its fixed 12-chunk cache still regenerates the starting view -- at rollout lengths where a sliding window has long evicted the evidence and full-KV attention runs out of memory.

</details>


<div id='cs.MA'></div>

# cs.MA [[Back]](#toc)

### [657] [OptiMAS: Automatically Optimize Multi-Agent System](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.21918)
*Yuxin Cheng,Chang Liu,Hanxin Yu,Haochen Tan,Taiqiang Wu,Weiqiang Jin,Jie Ran,Kaibo Wang,Xiaoguang Li,Haoli Bai,Graziano Chesi,Ngai Wong*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出OptiMAS，一种任务无关的智能体优化器，通过统一的ReAct基础设施和连续数据驱动的优化范式，克服了现有搜索式多智能体系统（MAS）演化方法在优化范围与稳定性之间的权衡，并在多个基准上取得优越性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于搜索的MAS演化方法存在根本性权衡：扩大优化范围会加剧演化不稳定性，而离散的分支-丢弃式搜索则会隔离不同谱系之间的见解，导致优化效果受限。

Method: 提出连续、数据驱动的优化范式，建立在统一的ReAct基础设施之上；OptiMAS利用文本交互轨迹和任务反馈作为端到端MAS演化的损失信号，并配备新颖的双轨记忆机制以在长时间优化过程中维持性能提升。

Result: 在四个异构智能体基准和三种不同规模及可访问性的LLM骨干上，OptiMAS一致性地达到或超越了领域特化的手工系统和现有演化方法的准确率。

Conclusion: 该工作为稳健、自动化的MAS演化建立了实践里程碑，展示了跨规模、跨可访问性LLM的通用性与有效性。

Abstract: Automated evolution of Multi-Agent Systems (MAS) holds significant potential for reducing the manual effort required to design and optimize LLM-based agent architectures. However, extant search-based paradigms face a fundamental trade-off, where an expanded optimization scope exacerbates evolutionary instability, while discrete branch-and-discard search isolates insights across lineages. To address these limitations, we propose a continuous, data-driven optimization paradigm built upon a unified ReAct-based infrastructure that reconciles a broad optimization scope with operational stability. Under this paradigm, we present OptiMAS, a task-agnostic agentic optimizer that leverages textual interaction trajectories and task feedback as loss signals for end-to-end MAS evolution. Equipped with a novel dual-track memory mechanism, OptiMAS sustains performance improvement over extended optimization horizons. Evaluation on four heterogeneous agentic benchmarks with three varying scale and accessibility LLM backbones, demonstrates that OptiMAS consistently achieves competitive or superior accuracy relative to both domain-specialized hand-crafted systems and existing evolutionary methods. Our work establishes a practical milestone toward robust, automated MAS evolution.

</details>


### [658] [Opinion-Guided Layered Strategies for Decentralized Coordination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.22104)
*Shuhao Qi,Zhiyong Sun,Siep Weiland,Sofie Haesaert*

Main category: cs.MA

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种全新的"观点引导策略"（opinion-guided strategy），使自主智能体能够在与任意其他智能体交互时协调到任何可接受的联合行为。该方法利用非线性观点动力学在分层实现中引导智能体在运行时响应对方行为，无需通信即可协调，并能打破对称性，在一般和博弈中也能保证收敛到某个均衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统策略存在两难：当两个智能体偏好不同的联合行为时，独立策略可能互相不兼容导致协调失败；而当它们偏好相同（或运行相同策略）时，又无法在需要时区分各自角色、打破对称性。理想情况是智能体能与其遇到的任何智能体协调，无论对方想实现哪种可接受的联合行为。

Method: 提出观点引导策略，将所有可接受的联合行为保持开放，将选择推迟到执行阶段；利用非线性观点动力学（opinion dynamics）构建分层实现架构，根据对方智能体的演化行为动态引导自身收敛到共同的联合行为，整个过程无需通信。

Result: 形式上建立了策略对对方任何偏好都保持鲁棒的条件；三个不同应用场景的案例研究表明，该策略能与随机遇到的每个智能体协调（只要对方愿意实现某一种可接受的联合行为），其中包含一个一般和博弈场景，确保双方收敛到某个由运行时交互决定的均衡。

Conclusion: 观点引导策略克服了传统策略的局限：既能与不同偏好的智能体协调，又能让运行相同策略的智能体在需要时打破对称性；在一般和博弈中，不需要像传统方法那样预先求解唯一的纳什均衡，而是将每个均衡保持开放，由运行时交互自然决定。

Abstract: Autonomous agents increasingly interact with other independent agents, and such interactions typically admit multiple joint behaviors. When two agents prefer different ones, their independent strategies may be mutually incompatible and fail to reach a coordinated outcome; when they are identical, neither can differentiate its role when needed. Ideally, an agent should coordinate with any agent it encounters, regardless of which admissible joint behavior that agent aims to realize. We therefore propose a new form of strategy, the opinion-guided strategy, which keeps all the admissible joint behaviors available and postpones the selection to execution time, when the other agent's behavior reveals which one to realize. To realize this, nonlinear opinion dynamics are leveraged in a layered realization to guide the agent to a common admissible joint behavior in response to the other agent's evolving behavior, even without communication. We formally establish the conditions under which the strategy remains robust to every preference the other agent may hold. This robustness has an important implication: two agents running identical strategies can break symmetry when needed, a capability that conventional strategies lack. Three case studies across different applications show that the opinion-guided strategy coordinates with every randomly encountered agent, as long as it is willing to realize one of the admissible joint behaviors.
